-- ---------- personal records: one per UserId -----------------------
-- Schema (DataStore "JadeThrustEconomy_v2", key "player_<UserId>"):
--   { Lifetime     = <total connecting thrusts ever; ONLY rises;
--                     unlocks zones, ranks, titles, Susanoo stages>,
--     SpendBalance = <the wallet: an INDEPENDENT stored value,
--                     credited per counted thrust and by bonus
--                     grants; the only field spending subtracts>,
--     TreeHits = <of Lifetime, the hits that landed on the Tree>,
--     Witnessed = { ["100"] = true, ... } milestone celebrations,
--     Inventory = { SakuraSeed = 3, ... } shop goods,
--     WeaponVariant = "Wood" -- COSMETIC METADATA ONLY. Written for
--     the record, read by no counting, ranking, or reward code. }
-- Legacy records (Spent / Bonus fields, balance computed) are
-- migrated ONCE on load: SpendBalance starts at the old computed
-- balance, Lifetime is carried across untouched, and the legacy
-- fields are never written again.
local balanceOf -- forward declaration; defined with the economy APIs
local personal = {}   -- [player] = record table
local dirty = {}      -- [player] = true if record changed since save
local lastCounted = {} -- [player] = os.clock() of last counted thrust

local function loadPersonal(player)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			if type(data) == "table" then
				local function count(v)
					return math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(v) or 0))
				end
				local lifetime = count(data.Lifetime)
				local spend = data.SpendBalance ~= nil and count(data.SpendBalance)
					or math.max(0, lifetime + count(data.Bonus) - count(data.Spent))
				return {
					Lifetime = lifetime,
					SpendBalance = spend,
					TreeHits = count(data.TreeHits),
					Witnessed = type(data.Witnessed) == "table" and data.Witnessed or {},
					Inventory = type(data.Inventory) == "table" and data.Inventory or {},
					Pets = type(data.Pets) == "table" and data.Pets or {},
					WeaponVariant = tostring(data.WeaponVariant or "Wood"),
				}
			end
			return { Lifetime = 0, SpendBalance = 0, TreeHits = 0,
				Witnessed = {}, Inventory = {}, Pets = {}, WeaponVariant = "Wood" }
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	return nil -- load failed: this session counts locally, saves never
end

local function savePersonal(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record or player:GetAttribute("ThrustSaveDisabled") then return end
	record.WeaponVariant = player:GetAttribute("SpearVariant") or record.WeaponVariant
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, record)
	end)
	dirty[player] = nil
end

local function publishPersonal(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return end
	-- Server-set attributes other systems read: Script 15 ranks from
	-- ThrustTotal; Script 14 displays from the RemoteEvent below.
	player:SetAttribute("ThrustTotal", record.Lifetime)
	player:SetAttribute("ThrustBalance", balanceOf(record))
	player:SetAttribute("TreeHits", record.TreeHits)
	local folder = player:FindFirstChild("BlossomStats")
	if folder then
		folder.Lifetime.Value = record.Lifetime
		folder.Balance.Value = balanceOf(record)
		folder.TreeHits.Value = record.TreeHits
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Thrusts") then
		stats.Thrusts.Value = record.Lifetime
	end
	local nextM = nextMilestone()
	treeEvent:FireClient(player, displayTotal(), record.Thrusts,
		nextM and nextM.Name or "All milestones bloomed",
		nextM and nextM.At or displayTotal())
end

-- ---------- counting: the ONLY door thrusts enter through -----------
local VALID_SOURCES = { Tree = true, Husk = true, Arena = true }
local lastPairCount = {} -- ["attackerId:targetId"] = clock, arena anti-farm

-- ---------- thrust multipliers (Robux passes, Chapter 21) ------------
-- One-time Game Passes: while owned, each connecting thrust REGISTERS
-- as N thrusts toward BOTH of the player's counts: Lifetime and
-- the independent Spend Balance, credited side by side at this
-- single registration point. Design decisions, all deliberate:
-- * HIGHEST OWNED APPLIES. Factors never stack or multiply together:
--   owning 2x and 10x is 10x, not 20x. One number, auditable.
-- * The factor is applied HERE, at the single registration point,
--   by the server, from ownership re-verified against Roblox's own
--   records (UserOwnsGamePassAsync) -- never from a client value,
--   an attribute a client can influence, or Script 10's say-so.
-- * The GLOBAL Tree total counts raw physical thrusts (1 per thrust)
--   whatever the thruster's factor: communal milestones measure what
--   the world actually did, and the Tree sign stays literally true.
-- * Multipliers touch nothing else: not damage (Script 2 never reads
--   them), not zone gates directly (gates read Lifetime, which grows
--   faster -- disclosed in Chapters 20 and 21), and NEVER the
--   exclusive spirit form, which has no interaction with this system.
local MULTIPLIER_PASSES = { -- highest first
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 10 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 5 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 3 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 2 },
}
local multiplierCache = {} -- [player] = factor (server-verified)

local function refreshMultiplier(player)
	local factor = 1
	for _, pass in ipairs(MULTIPLIER_PASSES) do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			local ok, owns = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, pass.Id)
			end)
			if ok and owns then
				factor = pass.Factor
				break
			end
		end
	end
	multiplierCache[player] = factor
	player:SetAttribute("ThrustMultiplier", factor)
	return factor
end

function balanceOf(record)
	-- The wallet is its own stored value -- read directly, never
	-- derived from Lifetime. (Name kept: callers ask for a balance.)
	return record.SpendBalance
end

local function checkMilestones(before, after)
	for _, m in ipairs(MILESTONES) do
		if before < m.At and after >= m.At then
			celebrate(m)
			-- Witness reward: BONUS balance thrusts for everyone
			-- online -- credited to Balance only. It does not touch
			-- Lifetime, the global total, ranks, or titles: a gift
			-- is not a thrust, and this economy never pretends it is.
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				local rec = personal[p]
				if rec and not rec.Witnessed[tostring(m.At)] then
					rec.Witnessed[tostring(m.At)] = true
					rec.SpendBalance += 25
					dirty[p] = true
					publishPersonal(p)
				end
			end
			refreshSign()
		end
	end
end

-- Script 2 calls this once per connecting thrust.
-- source: "Tree" | "Husk" | "Arena". targetPlayer: arena opponent.
function _G.JadeCountThrust(player, source, targetPlayer)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
	if not VALID_SOURCES[source] then return end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then return end

	local now = os.clock()
	if lastCounted[player] and now - lastCounted[player] < MIN_COUNT_INTERVAL then
		return
	end
	if source == "Tree" then
		if not hitbox or (root.Position - hitbox.Position).Magnitude > TREE_RANGE then
			return -- claimed a Tree hit from somewhere else entirely
		end
	elseif source == "Arena" then
		-- Pair cap: trading hits with one partner counts at most
		-- once per second, however fast the two of you thrust.
		if typeof(targetPlayer) == "Instance" and targetPlayer:IsA("Player") then
			local key = player.UserId .. ":" .. targetPlayer.UserId
			if lastPairCount[key] and now - lastPairCount[key] < 1 then return end
			lastPairCount[key] = now
		end
	end

	lastCounted[player] = now
	local before = displayTotal()
	local factor = multiplierCache[player] or 1
	record.Lifetime += factor
	record.SpendBalance += factor -- the wallet is credited too --
	-- independently: from here the two values live separate lives.
	if source == "Tree" then record.TreeHits += factor end
	dirty[player] = true
	globalPending += 1 -- raw thrusts only, whatever the factor (above)
	if source == "Tree" then treeReact(displayTotal() % 100 == 0) end
	checkMilestones(before, displayTotal())
	publishPersonal(player)
	refreshSign()
end

-- ---------- economy APIs: how thrusts leave and arrive --------------
-- Spending NEVER touches Lifetime: ranks, titles and milestones are
-- a record of what a player has done, and a record cannot be spent.
function _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, amount, _reason)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	amount = math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0)
	if amount <= 0 then return false end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record or record.SpendBalance < amount then return false end
	record.SpendBalance -= amount -- the wallet, and ONLY the wallet
	dirty[player] = true
	publishPersonal(player)
	return true
end

function _G.JadeGrantBonus(player, amount, _reason)
	-- Bonus thrusts credit Balance only (quests, milestone witness
	-- gifts). Clamp keeps any future caller honest: no single grant
	-- may exceed 500, and bonuses never enter Lifetime or ranks.
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	amount = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0), 0, 500)
	if amount <= 0 then return false end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return false end
	record.SpendBalance += amount
	dirty[player] = true
	publishPersonal(player)
	return true
end

function _G.JadeGrantItem(player, itemKey, count)
	-- Inventory lives inside the player's economy record, so a seed
	-- or a pet is saved by the same write that saves their thrusts.
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return false end
	count = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(count) or 0), -1000, 1000)
	record.Inventory[itemKey] = math.max(0, (record.Inventory[itemKey] or 0) + count)
	dirty[player] = true
	publishPersonal(player)
	return true
end

function _G.JadeGetLifetime(player)
	-- The zone gates' only key (Chapter 20). Lifetime is read from
	-- the record itself -- not from an attribute, not from Balance.
	local record = personal[player]
	return record and record.Lifetime or 0
end

function _G.JadeGetItem(player, itemKey)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return 0 end
	return record.Inventory[itemKey] or 0
end

-- Pet records (Chapter 23): pets are INDIVIDUALS, not counts, so
-- they live in their own table inside the same economy record and
-- are saved by the same write. Script 22 owns pet rules; this pair
-- of functions is the only door, and Set sanitises whatever it is
-- handed before it can reach the DataStore.
function _G.JadeGetPets(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record then return {} end
	local copy = {}
	for id, pet in pairs(record.Pets) do copy[id] = pet end
	return copy
end

function _G.JadeSetPets(player, pets)
	local record = personal[player]
	if not record or type(pets) ~= "table" then return false end
	local clean, count = {}, 0
	for id, pet in pairs(pets) do
		count += 1
		if count > 200 or type(id) ~= "string" or type(pet) ~= "table"
			or type(pet.Species) ~= "string" or #pet.Species > 40 then
			return false
		end
		clean[id] = {
			Species = pet.Species,
			Radiance = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pet.Radiance) or 0), 0, 2),
			Bond = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pet.Bond) or 0), 0, 1000000),
			Soulbound = pet.Soulbound == true,
		}
	end
	record.Pets = clean
	dirty[player] = true
	return true
end

function _G.JadeGetBalance(player)
	local record = personal[player]
	return record and balanceOf(record) or 0
end

-- ---------- persistence: batched global flush -----------------------
local function flushGlobal()
	if globalPending <= 0 then return end
	local delta = globalPending
	local ok, newTotal = pcall(function()
		return store:UpdateAsync("global_total", function(old)
			return (tonumber(old) or 0) + delta
		end)
	end)
	if ok and tonumber(newTotal) then
		globalKnown = tonumber(newTotal)
		globalPending -= delta
		refreshSign()
	end
	-- On failure the pending thrusts stay pending and the next flush
	-- retries them: counted thrusts are never silently dropped, and
	-- UpdateAsync means two servers can never overwrite each other.
end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(FLUSH_SECONDS)
		flushGlobal()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if dirty[p] then savePersonal(p) end
			publishPersonal(p) -- keeps displays honest across servers
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()

	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		savePersonal(p)
	end
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 15_Leaderboard.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Leaderboard
-- What it does: the public thrust leaderboard (Chapter 18) -- an
-- in-world board by the Great Blossom Tree (top 10) and a UI feed of
-- the top 100, both ranked by LIFETIME thrusts from Script 13's
-- records, persisted through an OrderedDataStore.
--
-- INTEGRITY MODEL:
-- * The OrderedDataStore is written ONLY here, ONLY from Script 13's
--   server-side records (read via the ThrustTotal attribute Script 13
--   sets from its own DataStore-backed record). No client sends a
--   number: the UI's RemoteFunction takes no arguments and returns
--   a cached, read-only table. An exploiter can ask "what are the
--   rankings?" as often as they like. That is the entire surface.
-- * Writes are throttled: a player's entry is rewritten at most once
--   per REFRESH_SECONDS and only when their lifetime has grown, so
--   the board cannot be used to burn the DataStore budget.
-- * NOBODY is special-cased. There is no allowlist, boost, seed, or
--   family entry anywhere in this Script: the daughter's name
--   appears exactly when her own counted thrusts put it there, at
--   the rank those thrusts earn, under the same title ladder as
--   every other player. That is the design, stated in Chapter 18.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ranks = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("JadeThrustRanks_v1")
local REFRESH_SECONDS = 60
local BOARD_ROWS = 10
local UI_ROWS = 100

local TITLES = { -- by lifetime thrusts; shared with Chapter 18
	{ At = 25000, Title = "Eternal Guardian" },
	{ At = 10000, Title = "Blossom Legend" },
	{ At = 5000,  Title = "Jade Master" },
	{ At = 2500,  Title = "Petal Storm" },
	{ At = 1000,  Title = "Blossom Knight" },
	{ At = 500,   Title = "Spear Dancer" },
	{ At = 250,   Title = "Bloom Keeper" },
	{ At = 100,   Title = "Petal Thruster" },
	{ At = 0,     Title = "Sprout" },
}

local function titleFor(thrusts)
	for _, t in ipairs(TITLES) do
		if thrusts >= t.At then return t.Title end
	end
	return "Sprout"
end

local nameCache = {} -- [userId] = display name
local function nameFor(userId)
	if nameCache[userId] then return nameCache[userId] end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	name = ok and name or ("Player " .. userId)
	nameCache[userId] = name
	return name
end

local boardCache = {} -- ranked rows: {UserId, Name, Thrusts, Title}
local cacheClock = 0

local function rebuildBoard()
	local ok, pages = pcall(function()
		return ranks:GetSortedAsync(false, UI_ROWS)
	end)
	if not ok or not pages then return end
	local rows = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
		local userId = tonumber(entry.key)
		local thrusts = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.value) or 0))
		if userId and thrusts > 0 then
			table.insert(rows, {
				UserId = userId,
				Name = nameFor(userId),
				Thrusts = thrusts,
				Title = titleFor(thrusts),
			})
		end
	end
	boardCache = rows
	cacheClock = os.clock()
end

	if os.clock() - cacheClock > REFRESH_SECONDS then rebuildBoard() end

local lastWritten = {} -- [userId] = lifetime last written to the store

	end
end

-- Jade Spirit | 16_ArenaSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ArenaSystem
-- What it does: everything about the Blossom Arena EXCEPT the thrusts
-- themselves (Chapter 17). Script 2 decides whether a thrust lands --
-- including its rule that player targets only count inside the arena
-- cylinder. This Script owns: entry healing, spawn protection, KO
-- credit, arena respawn, and the session KO/fall tallies.
--
-- FAIR-PLAY INVARIANTS (they hold because of where code lives):
-- * Damage, range, cooldown, and knockback are constants in
--   Script 2. This Script cannot change them, the shop cannot sell
--   anything that changes them, and no attribute set by any
--   monetization Script is read by either. A Golden spear and a
--   Wood spear are the same weapon here; only the picture differs.
-- * KOs mint NOTHING. No thrusts (the thrusts that landed were
--   already counted by Script 13 when they connected), no currency,
--   no items. The tally below is a session scoreboard, not a bank.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local ARENA_RADIUS = 55
local PROTECTION_SECONDS = 3

local function arenaCenter()
	local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaCenter")
	return center and center:IsA("BasePart") and center or nil
end

local function inArena(root)
	local center = arenaCenter()
	if not center or not root then return false end
	local offset = root.Position - center.Position
	return math.sqrt(offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z) <= ARENA_RADIUS
		and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 25
end

local tallies = {} -- [player] = { KOs = n, Falls = n }

local function publish(player)
	local t = tallies[player]
	if not t then return end
	player:SetAttribute("ArenaKOs", t.KOs)
	player:SetAttribute("ArenaFalls", t.Falls)
end

local function watchCharacter(player, character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	-- Entering the arena (teleported in by the gate pad, Script 6's
	-- destinations include Spawn_ArenaLobby; the bowl entry pad is
	-- below) starts every fight at full health with protection on.
	task.spawn(function()
		local wasIn = false
		while character.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			local isIn = inArena(root)
			if isIn and not wasIn then
				humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
				player:SetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil", os.clock() + PROTECTION_SECONDS)
			end
			player:SetAttribute("InBlossomArena", isIn)
			wasIn = isIn
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		player:SetAttribute("InBlossomArena", false)
	end)

	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if not inArena(root) then return end
		local t = tallies[player]
		if t then
			t.Falls += 1
			publish(player)
		end
		-- KO credit: read the creator tag Script 2 stamped on this
		-- Humanoid with its last connecting thrust. It must name a
		-- DIFFERENT living player; anything else credits nobody.
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
		local killer = tag and tag.Value
		if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player
			and tallies[killer] then
			tallies[killer].KOs += 1
			publish(killer)
		end
		-- Respawn at the arena lobby, not the Grove: flag it, and
		-- the CharacterAdded path below moves the new character.
		player:SetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby", true)
	end)
end

local function setupPlayer(player)
	tallies[player] = { KOs = 0, Falls = 0 }
	publish(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		watchCharacter(player, character)
		if player:GetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby") then
			player:SetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby", false)
			local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_ArenaLobby")
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			if lobby and root then
				task.wait(0.2)
				root.CFrame = lobby.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	tallies[player] = nil
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 18_ThrustShop.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ThrustShop
-- What it does: the in-game shop, where the ONLY currency is thrusts
-- (Chapter 19). Item stands are Parts in the world named
-- "ThrustShop_<ItemKey>"; each gets a ProximityPrompt showing its
-- price in thrusts. Gardens: Parts "GardenPlot_1" .. "GardenPlot_4",
-- where seeds are planted, grow, and are harvested for bouquets.
--
-- HOW A PURCHASE WORKS (and why it cannot be cheated):
-- * The prompt handler re-checks distance on the server (Script 6's
--   lesson), looks the price up in the server CATALOG below -- the
--   client names nothing but which stand it touched, and it does
--   not even do that: the handler is bound to the Part itself.
-- * Payment is Script 13's JadeSpendThrusts, which checks the
--   player's Balance (Lifetime + Bonus - Spent) and moves Spent.
--   Lifetime is never reduced, so buying can never cost a player a
--   rank, a title, a zone, or a milestone (Chapter 20).
-- * Unlock gates read Lifetime via JadeGetLifetime: some goods
--   cannot be bought before the player has DONE enough, however
--   rich their unspent balance is. Money (Robux) appears nowhere
--   in this Script; Robux passes live in Scripts 10/11 and sell
--   different, cosmetic-only goods.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local CATALOG = {
	-- Pets are NOT sold here any more: Chapter 23 gives them eggs,
	-- events, merges, and one dedication grant instead. A pet with a
	-- price tag was the old design; this catalogue sells goods.
	-- Seeds (consumable -- the economy's repeat sink)
	SakuraSeed  = { Label = "Sakura Seed",            Price = 150,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Seed" },
	JadeMelonSeed = { Label = "Jade Melon Seed",      Price = 600,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Seed" },
	PearlSeed   = { Label = "Pearl Seed",             Price = 900,   Gate = 100000, Kind = "Seed" },
	MoonflowerSeed = { Label = "Moonflower Seed",     Price = 1800,  Gate = 50000,  Kind = "Seed" },
	StormSeed   = { Label = "Storm Seed",             Price = 4500,  Gate = 500000, Kind = "Seed" },
	EternalSeed = { Label = "Eternal Seed",           Price = 12000, Gate = 1000000, Kind = "Seed" },
	-- Cosmetics (own once)
	GroveTrail  = { Label = "Grove Trail",            Price = 500,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	PetalHat    = { Label = "Petal Hat",              Price = 800,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	SakuraScarf = { Label = "Sakura Scarf",           Price = 1200,  Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	BlossomWings = { Label = "Blossom Wings",         Price = 6000,  Gate = 2500,   Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	GoldenCrown = { Label = "Golden Crown",           Price = 15000, Gate = 5000,   Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	-- Consumables
	SpiritIncense = { Label = "Spirit Incense",       Price = 25,    Gate = 0,      Kind = "Consumable" },
	BouquetBox  = { Label = "Bouquet Box (decor)",    Price = 300,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Consumable" },
}
-- Garden plots are sold by their own prompts below, not stands:
local PLOTS = { -- [plotNumber] = {Price, Gate}
	[2] = { Price = 2500, Gate = 500 },
	[3] = { Price = 6000, Gate = 2500 },
	[4] = { Price = 14000, Gate = 10000 },
}

local function near(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end


local SEED_ORDER = { "EternalSeed", "StormSeed", "MoonflowerSeed", "HollowSeed", "PearlSeed", "JadeMelonSeed", "SakuraSeed" }
local SEED_COLORS = {
	SakuraSeed = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203),
	JadeMelonSeed = Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165),
	PearlSeed = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 235),
	MoonflowerSeed = Color3.fromRGB(170, 190, 255),
	HollowSeed = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 190), -- Hollow drop only; never sold
	StormSeed = Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 255),
	EternalSeed = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90),
}
local GROW_SECONDS = 300

local function ownedCount(player, key)
	return _G.JadeGetItem and _G.JadeGetItem(player, key) or 0
end

-- ---------- item stands ---------------------------------------------
for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and string.sub(part.Name, 1, 10) == "ThrustShop_" then
		local key = string.sub(part.Name, 11)
		local item = CATALOG[key]
		if item then
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.ActionText = "Buy — " .. item.Price .. " thrusts"
			prompt.ObjectText = item.Label
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
			prompt.Parent = part
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				if not near(player, part, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then return end
				if (_G.JadeGetLifetime(player)) < item.Gate then return end
				if item.Kind == "Cosmetic"
					and ownedCount(player, key) >= 1 then
					return -- own-once goods are never charged for twice
				end
				if _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, item.Price, key) then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, key, 1)
				end
				-- A failed spend (balance short) does nothing at all:
				-- no partial charge, no debt, no item.
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ---------- garden plots ---------------------------------------------
local plotState = {} -- [part] = { Owner, SeedKey, ReadyAt, Flower }

local function clearFlower(part)
	local st = plotState[part]
	if st and st.Flower then st.Flower:Destroy() end
	plotState[part] = nil
end

local function growFlower(part, seedKey, owner)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "GardenFlower"
	local stem = Instance.new("Part")
	stem.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 3, 0.3)
	stem.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 80)
	stem.Anchored = true
	stem.CanCollide = false
	stem.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	stem.Parent = model
	local bloom = Instance.new("Part")
	bloom.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	bloom.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	bloom.Color = SEED_COLORS[seedKey] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203)
	bloom.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	bloom.Anchored = true
	bloom.CanCollide = false
	bloom.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	bloom.Parent = model
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end

for i = 1, 4 do
	local plot = workspace:FindFirstChild("GardenPlot_" .. i)
	if plot and plot:IsA("BasePart") then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Use Garden Plot"
		prompt.ObjectText = "Garden Plot " .. i
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.Parent = plot
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if not near(player, plot, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then return end
			local st = plotState[plot]
			if st then
				-- Occupied: only the planter harvests, only when ripe.
				if st.Owner == player and os.clock() >= st.ReadyAt then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "Bouquet", 1)
					clearFlower(plot)
				end
				return
			end
			-- Empty: plots 2-4 must be bought first (once, forever).
			if i > 1 and ownedCount(player, "GardenPlot" .. i) < 1 then
				local spec = PLOTS[i]
				if _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) >= spec.Gate
					and _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, spec.Price, "GardenPlot" .. i) then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "GardenPlot" .. i, 1)
				end
				return
			end
			-- Plant the best seed the player is carrying.
			for _, seedKey in ipairs(SEED_ORDER) do
				if ownedCount(player, seedKey) >= 1 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, seedKey, -1)
					plotState[plot] = {
						Owner = player,
						SeedKey = seedKey,
						ReadyAt = os.clock() + GROW_SECONDS,
						Flower = growFlower(plot, seedKey, player),
					}
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for part, st in pairs(plotState) do
		if st.Owner == player then clearFlower(part) end
	end
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 19_ZoneGates.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ZoneGates
-- What it does: the world ladder (Chapter 20). Each gated zone is
-- reached ONLY through its gate pad -- Parts named "ZoneGate_<Key>"
-- beside a decorative gateway (torii, portal ring, moon gate) --
-- because the zones themselves are separate islands with no walk-in
-- path. A gate opens for a player whose LIFETIME thrusts meet the
-- threshold, and teleports them to "Spawn_<Key>".
--
-- THE ONE RULE THAT MAKES THIS FAIR:
-- * Gates read Lifetime, through Script 13's JadeGetLifetime, and
--   nothing else. This Script contains no reference to Balance,
--   Spent, or Bonus -- spending every thrust you own cannot re-lock
--   a single gate, and a rich balance cannot open one early.
-- * The check is recomputed on the server at every crossing attempt
--   from the economy record itself. Gate visuals (Script 20) are
--   client decoration: a gate that LOOKS open to a tampered client
--   still teleports nobody the record says is short.
-- * Zone defence in depth: a slow monitor also checks gated-zone
--   regions. A player found inside a zone their Lifetime does not
--   unlock -- flown, flung, or glitched there -- is returned to the
--   Grove. Access is a server fact, not a doorway.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GATES = { -- order matters: the ladder, low to high
	{ Key = "SkyCanopy",    Name = "Sky Canopy",          Required = 1000,    GateKind = "Cloud Torii" },
	{ Key = "CrystalDeep",  Name = "Crystal Deep",        Required = 10000,   GateKind = "Crystal Portal" },
	{ Key = "HollowGrove",  Name = "The Hollow Grove",    Required = 25000,   GateKind = "Thorn Gate" },
	{ Key = "MoonlitForest", Name = "Moonlit Bamboo Forest", Required = 50000, GateKind = "Moon Torii" },
	{ Key = "KoiGrotto",    Name = "Sunken Koi Grotto",   Required = 100000,  GateKind = "Waterfall Portal" },
	{ Key = "Stormspire",   Name = "Stormspire Peaks",    Required = 500000,  GateKind = "Storm Arch" },
	{ Key = "Sanctum",      Name = "Eternal Blossom Sanctum", Required = 1000000, GateKind = "Golden Portal" },
}
local ZONE_RADIUS = 130

local deniedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeZoneDenied")
if not deniedEvent then
	deniedEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	deniedEvent.Name = "JadeZoneDenied"
	deniedEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local unlockedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeZoneUnlocked")
if not unlockedEvent then
	unlockedEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	unlockedEvent.Name = "JadeZoneUnlocked"
	unlockedEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function lifetimeOf(player)
	return _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
end

local function near(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, nil end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance, root
end

for _, gate in ipairs(GATES) do
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneGate_" .. gate.Key)
	local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_" .. gate.Key)
	if pad and spawn then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Enter — " .. gate.Required .. " lifetime thrusts"
		prompt.ObjectText = gate.Name .. " (" .. gate.GateKind .. ")"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
		prompt.Parent = pad
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			local ok, root = near(player, pad, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4)
			if not ok or not root then return end
			local have = lifetimeOf(player)
			if have >= gate.Required then
				root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			else
				deniedEvent:FireClient(player, gate.Name, gate.Required, have)
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Unlock celebrations + region defence.
local announced = {} -- [player] = { [gateKey] = true }

local function watchPlayer(player)
	announced[player] = {}
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ThrustTotal"):Connect(function()
		local have = lifetimeOf(player)
		for _, gate in ipairs(GATES) do
			if have >= gate.Required and not announced[player][gate.Key] then
				announced[player][gate.Key] = true
				unlockedEvent:FireClient(player, gate.Name, gate.Required)
			end
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(watchPlayer, player) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) announced[player] = nil end)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(2)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if root and os.clock() - (player:GetAttribute("JoinClock") or 0) > 10 then
				for _, gate in ipairs(GATES) do
					local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneCenter_" .. gate.Key)
					if center and (root.Position - center.Position).Magnitude <= ZONE_RADIUS
						and lifetimeOf(player) < gate.Required then
						local grove = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_Grove")
						if grove then root.CFrame = grove.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
						deniedEvent:FireClient(player, gate.Name, gate.Required, lifetimeOf(player))
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player:SetAttribute("JoinClock", os.clock())
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 21_ThrustMovement.client.lua
-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > LocalScript
-- rename it ThrustMovement.
-- What it does: THRUST-TO-MOVE (Chapter 22). Every thrust of the
-- Twin Spear -- tap, click, or the R2 trigger on an Xbox
-- controller, all of which fire the Tool's Activated event -- gives
-- the wielder a burst of momentum. The spear is weapon and wings.
--
-- ANIMATION PRIORITY (Chapter 4): movement is choreographed
-- weapon-first, wings-second, body-last. The spear thrusts and
-- the burst follows the TIP; wing beats (the player's wings, and
-- the Daemon's at Stage 3+) sell the lift; the character's body
-- is carried by both. Animate the weapon and the wings and the
-- movement reads; animate the body alone and it never will.
--
-- WHY THIS LIVES ON THE CLIENT: momentum that waits for a server
-- round-trip feels like mud. The burst is applied locally, the
-- instant the thrust starts, on every device identically. Nothing
-- valuable is decided here: hits, damage, combo stages, and thrust
-- COUNTING are all resolved by Scripts 2 and 13 on the server,
-- which rate-cap and re-validate everything. A tampered movement
-- client can make its owner fly about -- it cannot mint a single
-- thrust, open a single gate, or win a single arena exchange,
-- because none of those read this Script's numbers.
--
-- THE FEEL, IN NUMBERS (Chapter 22 has the design table):
-- * Ground burst 17 studs/s, +2.5 per movement-chain link (thrusts
--   within 1.15 s of the last), capped at +12. Every 3rd chain link
--   is a LUNGE DASH: burst x1.5 and a hop.
-- * Air bursts aim with the camera (right stick on Xbox), hold a
--   glide line instead of falling, and cost more stamina. Three
--   air bursts per airborne stretch, hard cap -- there is no
--   infinite flight, however fast you thrust.
-- * Stamina 100: ground burst 16, air burst 30, lunge dash 24.
--   Regenerates 30/s standing on ground, 6/s in the air. A thrust
--   with too little stamina still thrusts -- it just doesn't dash.
-- * DAEMON GLIDE (Chapter 32): while the player's Daemon pet is
--   condensed beside them (the server sets the DaemonCondensed
--   attribute; this client only reads it), the Daemon's wing
--   beats add ONE extra air burst per airborne stretch and the
--   glide line holds longer -- weapon and Daemon, comboing to
--   move. Walking is always available; this is the skilled path.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local WINDOW = 1.15
local GROUND_BURST = 17
local CHAIN_BONUS = 2.5
local CHAIN_BONUS_CAP = 12
local LUNGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
local MAX_AIR_BURSTS = 3
local function maxAirBursts()
	return player:GetAttribute("DaemonCondensed") and 4 or MAX_AIR_BURSTS
end
local STAMINA_MAX = 100
local COST = { Ground = 16, Air = 30, Lunge = 24 }

local stamina = STAMINA_MAX
local chain = 0
local lastThrustClock = 0
local airBursts = 0
local dashVelocity = nil
local dashAttachment = nil

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ThrustMovementGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local barBack = Instance.new("Frame")
barBack.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 14)
barBack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 1, -64)
barBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 34, 38)
barBack.Parent = gui
local bb = Instance.new("UICorner"); bb.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7); bb.Parent = barBack
local barFill = Instance.new("Frame")
barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
barFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203)
barFill.Parent = barBack
local bf = Instance.new("UICorner"); bf.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7); bf.Parent = barFill
local barLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
barLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 18)
barLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 1, -86)
barLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
barLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
barLabel.TextSize = 12
barLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 235)
barLabel.Text = "PETAL STAMINA"
barLabel.Parent = gui

local function currentRoot()
	local character = player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
		character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function ensureDashObjects(root)
	if dashVelocity and dashVelocity.Parent == root then return end
	dashAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	dashAttachment.Name = "ThrustDashAttachment"
	dashAttachment.Parent = root
	dashVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	dashVelocity.Name = "ThrustDash"
	dashVelocity.Attachment0 = dashAttachment
	dashVelocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	dashVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	dashVelocity.MaxForce = 100000
	dashVelocity.Enabled = false
	dashVelocity.Parent = root
end

local function onThrust()
	local root, humanoid = currentRoot()
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	chain = (now - lastThrustClock <= WINDOW) and chain + 1 or 1
	lastThrustClock = now
	local isLunge = chain % 3 == 0
	local grounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
	local cost = isLunge and COST.Lunge or (grounded and COST.Ground or COST.Air)
	if not grounded and airBursts >= maxAirBursts() then return end
	if stamina < cost then return end
	stamina -= cost
	if not grounded then airBursts += 1 end

	ensureDashObjects(root)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local dir
	if grounded then
		local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
		dir = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
	else
		dir = camera and camera.CFrame.LookVector or root.CFrame.LookVector
	end
	if dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then dir = root.CFrame.LookVector end
	dir = dir.Unit

	local bonus = math.min((chain - 1) * CHAIN_BONUS, CHAIN_BONUS_CAP)
	local speed = (GROUND_BURST + bonus) * (isLunge and LUNGE_MULTIPLIER or 1)
	local velocity = dir * speed
	if grounded then
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, isLunge and 14 or math.max(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0), 0)
	else
		-- Glide: an air dash holds its line, cancelling the fall for
		-- the burst, and a lunge dash pops upward -- wings, briefly.
		velocity += Vector3.new(0, isLunge and 11 or 2.5, 0)
	end
	dashVelocity.VectorVelocity = velocity
	dashVelocity.Enabled = true

	character.ChildAdded:Connect(hookTool)
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do hookTool(child) end
end

-- Jade Spirit | 10_Monetization.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Monetization
-- What it does: ALL paid content in the game, in one server Script --
-- Game Pass ownership checks on join, Game Pass purchase follow-up,
-- and Developer Product receipts (ProcessReceipt). Everything for
-- sale is cosmetic or convenience. Nothing here grants power.
--
-- ============================================================
-- THE ONE THING THAT IS NEVER FOR SALE
-- ============================================================
-- The Headless Jade Spirit form (Scripts 8 and 9) does not appear in
-- this file, in the shop Script 11, or anywhere in the shop at all.
-- It has no pass ID and no product ID, and no function in this file
-- can grant it. Do not add it here. It is unlocked only by the
-- UserId check in Script 8, for one named player, forever.
-- ============================================================
--
-- SECURITY MODEL (Chapter 14 has the full audit):
-- * A purchase prompt (Script 11) is a REQUEST, never a grant.
--   Passes take effect only after UserOwnsGamePassAsync -- Roblox's
--   own records -- says the player owns the pass. Products take
--   effect only inside ProcessReceipt, which Roblox calls on the
--   server after payment. A client cannot call either path itself.
-- * Every grant amount is a constant in the tables below. No client
--   input -- no RemoteEvent argument, no GUI field -- can name an
--   item, an amount, or a price. There is no code path to audit
--   beyond these two tables, and that is deliberate.
-- * Receipts are deduplicated against a persistent DataStore
--   ledger keyed by PurchaseId (see ProcessReceipt below), so a
--   redelivered receipt cannot grant twice -- in this session or
--   any later one.
-- * Grants refuse to run against an unloaded economy: if Script 1
--   flagged the player's data as not loaded, receipts answer
--   NotProcessedYet (Roblox redelivers later) instead of granting
--   into a balance that will never be saved.
--
-- SETUP (Chapter 6 walks through it click by click):
--   1. Create each Game Pass and Developer Product in the Creator
--      Dashboard (your game > Monetization). Creating them is free.
--   2. Copy each item's numeric ID into the two tables below.
--      An ID left at 0 means "not created yet" and that item is
--      disabled everywhere -- never prompted, never granted.
--   3. This Script must be the ONLY Script in the game that sets
--      MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt. Roblox allows exactly one
--      handler per game; a second one silently replaces the first.
--   4. ROUTED PRODUCTS: three catalogues live outside this file --
--      Colosseum tickets (Script 49's CONFIG), Vault skins (Script
--      51's SKINS), and the Sandbox Gate Pass (the PRODUCTS entry
--      below). Receipts for the first two are routed at grant time
--      to _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket / _G.JadeVaultGrantSkin, each
--      of which answers true only for its own IDs; an ID nobody
--      owns stays unknown and the receipt fails closed. Routing
--      happens inside the same six-step ledger discipline as every
--      other product -- routed grants are never granted twice.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

-- GAME PASSES: bought once, owned forever. Paste each ID from the
-- START HERE paste-point register; an ID of 0 disables that item.

	PetalTrailPack     = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsPetalTrailPack" },
	TwilightReaperPack      = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsTwilightReaperPack" },
	DaemonDesignPack        = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsDaemonDesignPack" },
	SakuraQueenSkin    = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsSakuraQueenSkin" },
	GoldenSpearSkin   = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsGoldenSpearSkin" },
	BloomAuraEffects   = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsBloomAuraEffects" },
	ExtraPetSlot       = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsExtraPetSlot" },
	GroveVIP           = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsGroveVIP" },
	SupporterSparkle   = { Id = 0, Attribute = "OwnsSupporterSparkle" },
	-- Thrust multipliers (Chapter 21): Script 13 verifies these

-- DEVELOPER PRODUCTS: bought again and again (consumables).
-- There are deliberately NO Sakura Shard packs here. Shards are the
-- game's earn currency, and the free faucets (Scripts 3 and 4) pay
-- up to 4,500 Shards an hour each -- any shard pack small enough to
-- price for a child is worth minutes of ordinary play, and any pack
-- big enough to matter would let money stomp the earn economy flat.
-- Chapter 6 shows this arithmetic. What is sold instead cannot be
-- farmed: treats and fireworks exist only here.
local PRODUCTS = {
	PetTreatBundle  = { Id = 0, Grant = function(p) addItem(p, "PetTreats", 5) end },
	ShrineFirework  = { Id = 0, Grant = function(p) addItem(p, "Fireworks", 1) end },
	-- The Sandbox Gate Pass (Chapter 52): a one-time pass sold as a
	-- Developer Product at 80 Robux. The grant is consent-gated by
	-- design: if Script 56 holds no recorded acceptance of the
	-- current Sandbox Terms for this player, the grant errors, the
	-- receipt answers NotProcessedYet, and Roblox redelivers it --
	-- the pass can never land ahead of the consent it depends on.
	SandboxGatePass = { Id = 0, Grant = function(p)
		if not (_G.JadeSandboxHasConsent and _G.JadeSandboxHasConsent(p)) then
			error("Sandbox consent not recorded for this player")
		end
		if not (_G.JadeGrantSandboxAccess and _G.JadeGrantSandboxAccess(p)) then
			error("Sandbox grant unavailable (Script 56 not loaded)")
		end
	end },
}

-- Consumable bag: PetTreats / Fireworks counts live under the player
-- (never on the public leaderboard) AND in their own DataStore, so a
-- paid item survives rejoining. Loaded clamped, saved on every grant.
local bagStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_Bag_v1")

local function cleanCount(value)
	value = tonumber(value)
	if value == nil or value ~= value then return 0 end
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, 1000000)
end

local function getBag(player)
	local bag = player:FindFirstChild("MonetizationBag")
	if not bag then
		bag = Instance.new("Folder")
		bag.Name = "MonetizationBag"
		bag.Parent = player
		for _, name in ipairs({ "PetTreats", "Fireworks" }) do
			local item = Instance.new("IntValue")
			item.Name = name
			item.Value = 0
			item.Parent = bag
		end
	end
	return bag
end

local function saveBag(player)
	local bag = player:FindFirstChild("MonetizationBag")
	if not bag then return end
	pcall(function()
		bagStore:SetAsync("bag_" .. player.UserId, {
			PetTreats = cleanCount(bag.PetTreats.Value),
			Fireworks = cleanCount(bag.Fireworks.Value),
		})
	end)
end

local function loadBag(player)
	local bag = getBag(player)
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return bagStore:GetAsync("bag_" .. player.UserId)
	end)
	if ok and type(data) == "table" then
		bag.PetTreats.Value = cleanCount(data.PetTreats)
		bag.Fireworks.Value = cleanCount(data.Fireworks)
	end
end

function addItem(player, name, amount)
	-- Declared as a global because the PRODUCTS table above closes
	-- over it. Amounts only ever come from that table's constants.
	local bag = getBag(player)
	local item = bag:FindFirstChild(name)
	if item then
		item.Value = cleanCount(item.Value + amount)
		saveBag(player)
	end
end

local function requestSave(player)
	-- Ask Script 1 to persist leaderstats now (it owns that store).
	local ev = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeRequestSave")
	if ev and ev:IsA("BindableEvent") then ev:Fire(player) end
end

local function findPassById(passId)
	for key, pass in pairs(GAME_PASSES) do
		if pass.Id ~= 0 and pass.Id == passId then return key, pass end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

local function findProductById(productId)
	for key, product in pairs(PRODUCTS) do
		if product.Id ~= 0 and product.Id == productId then return key, product end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- Cosmetic effect of owning each pass. Templates are OPTIONAL Models
-- in ServerStorage (a Trail, an Aura of particles). If a template is
-- not built yet, ownership is still recorded as an attribute -- the
-- skin / pet / lounge systems read those attributes, so passes work
-- before the art does, and adding the art later changes nothing here.
local function applyPassEffects(player)
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end

	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsExtraPetSlot") then
		player:SetAttribute("MaxPetsOut", 3) -- default elsewhere is 1
	else
		player:SetAttribute("MaxPetsOut", 1)
	end

	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsPetalTrailPack")
		and not character:FindFirstChild("PetalTrailPackTrail") then
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("PetalTrailTemplate")
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local waist = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		if template and template:IsA("Trail") and root and waist then
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", waist)
			local trail = template:Clone()
			trail.Name = "PetalTrailPackTrail"
			trail.Attachment0 = a0
			trail.Attachment1 = a1
			trail.Parent = character
		end
	end

	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsBloomAuraEffects")
		and not character:FindFirstChild("BloomAura") then
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("BloomAuraTemplate")
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if template and root then
			local aura = template:Clone()
			aura.Name = "BloomAura"
			aura.Parent = root
		end
	end
	-- SakuraQueenSkin, GoldenSpearSkin, GroveVIP, SupporterSparkle:
	-- presentation-only passes. Their systems check the attributes.
end

local refreshing = {} -- [player] = true while an ownership sweep runs

local function refreshPasses(player)
	if refreshing[player] then return end
	refreshing[player] = true
	for _, pass in pairs(GAME_PASSES) do
		local owns = false
		if pass.Id ~= 0 then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, pass.Id)
			end)
			owns = ok and result == true
			-- If the check itself failed (ok=false), keep whatever
			-- the attribute already said rather than stripping a
			-- paying player's pass over a transient API error.
			if not ok and player:GetAttribute(pass.Attribute) ~= nil then
				owns = player:GetAttribute(pass.Attribute) == true
			end
		end
		player:SetAttribute(pass.Attribute, owns)
	end
	refreshing[player] = nil
	applyPassEffects(player)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	loadBag(player)
	refreshPasses(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(0.5) -- let GameManager hand over the spear first
		refreshPasses(player)
	end)
end)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(function()
		loadBag(player)
		refreshPasses(player)
	end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	refreshing[player] = nil
	saveBag(player)
end)

-- A pass bought while already in the game takes effect immediately.
-- The event alone is not trusted: the pass ID must be one of ours,
-- and ownership is re-verified against Roblox's records before the
-- attribute is set. A forged or replayed event grants nothing.
MarketplaceService.GamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, wasPurchased)
	if not wasPurchased then return end
	local _, pass = findPassById(passId)
	if not pass then return end
	local ok, owns = pcall(function()
		return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, passId)
	end)
	if ok and owns then
		player:SetAttribute(pass.Attribute, true)
		applyPassEffects(player)
	end
end)

-- DEVELOPER PRODUCT RECEIPTS -- the money door, so it gets the most
-- locks. Roblox calls ProcessReceipt after payment, and may call it
-- AGAIN for the same purchase (the game closed mid-delivery, the
-- server died, an earlier call answered NotProcessedYet). Every
-- PurchaseId is therefore recorded in a persistent ledger:
--   1. In-session set hit        -> already granted: say Granted.
--   2. Ledger read fails         -> NotProcessedYet. Never grant
--      blind into a store you cannot record in.
--   3. Ledger already has the ID -> already granted in an earlier
--      session: say Granted, grant nothing.
--   4. Unknown / disabled product, wrong place, or the player's
--      economy has not loaded    -> NotProcessedYet.
--   5. Grant (constant amount from PRODUCTS, or a routed grant to
--      Script 49 / Script 51 for their own product IDs). Grant
--      fails -> NotProcessedYet, nothing recorded.
--   6. Record the PurchaseId, THEN answer PurchaseGranted. If the
--      record write fails, answer NotProcessedYet: Roblox will
--      redeliver, and step 1 or 3 will absorb the repeat. The one
--      residual window -- grant done, record lost, redelivery in a
--      LATER session reads an empty ledger -- is named in Chapter
--      14 rather than hidden; it is the known limit of check-then-
--      record on any platform, and redelivery is rare by design.
local receiptStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_Receipts_v1")
local processedThisSession = {} -- [PurchaseId] = true

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receiptInfo.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if receiptInfo.PlaceIdWherePurchased ~= game.PlaceId then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("DataLoaded") ~= true then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local _, product = findProductById(receiptInfo.ProductId)
	-- A receipt whose ProductId is not in this file's own PRODUCTS
	-- table is NOT rejected here: it may belong to a routed
	-- catalogue (Script 49's tickets, Script 51's skins). Routing is
	-- decided at grant time, AFTER the ledger read below, so a
	-- redelivered routed receipt is absorbed by the ledger exactly
	-- like any other -- never granted twice.

	local readOk, prior = pcall(function()
		return receiptStore:GetAsync("receipt_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId)
	end)
	if not readOk then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if prior then
		processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end

	local grantOk, err = pcall(function()
		if product then
			product.Grant(player, receiptInfo.ProductId)
		else
			-- Routed products (Chapters 46, 47, 52): each grant
			-- answers true only for its own product IDs, so an ID
			-- nobody owns errors here and the receipt fails closed
			-- (NotProcessedYet) instead of granting on trust.
			local routed = (_G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket
				and _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket(player, receiptInfo.ProductId) == true)
				or (_G.JadeVaultGrantSkin
				and _G.JadeVaultGrantSkin(player, receiptInfo.ProductId) == true)
			if not routed then
				error("unknown ProductId " .. tostring(receiptInfo.ProductId))
			end
		end
	end)
	if not grantOk then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] Product grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	local writeOk = pcall(function()
		receiptStore:SetAsync("receipt_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId, {
			PlayerId = receiptInfo.PlayerId,
			ProductId = receiptInfo.ProductId,
		})
	end)
	if not writeOk then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
	requestSave(player)
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

--

--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14): every ID in the ITEMS list below is

The naming rule that prevents 90% of beginner errors:  The code finds things by name. TwinSpear, SakuraShard, Checkpoint_4, Spawn_Obby — if a name in your Explorer differs by one letter or one capital, that feature silently does nothing.
