-- Jade Spirit | 01_GameManager.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > GameManager (Server Script)
-- Creates leaderstats, saves data, gives the Twin Spear on spawn.
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14 has the full audit):
-- * Every number in leaderstats is written by SERVER Scripts only.
--   No RemoteEvent in this game accepts a currency amount from a
--   client -- there is nothing for an exploiter to "fire with a
--   bigger number". If you ever add such a Remote, you own the hole.
-- * Load failure must never become a save. If the DataStore read
--   fails (outage, throttling), the session is flagged and
--   saveData() refuses to run -- otherwise a player who joins
--   during an outage would overwrite a real balance with the
--   0-Shard fallback. Balances are solvency.
-- * Loaded values are clamped to sane ranges before use, so a
--   corrupted or hand-edited save can never mint negative or
--   astronomical currency into the live economy.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_v1")
local MAX_STAGE = 12 -- Checkpoint_1 .. Checkpoint_12 (Script 5)

local function clean(value, fallback, max)
	value = tonumber(value)
	if value == nil or value ~= value then return fallback end -- nil / NaN
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, max)
end

local function loadData(player)
	-- Up to 3 attempts: a transient DataStore error should not cost
	-- a player their balance OR lock them out of saving for a session.
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			if type(data) == "table" then
				return {
					Shards = clean(data.Shards, 0, 1000000000),
					Blooms = clean(data.Blooms, 0, 100000000),
					Stage  = clean(data.Stage, 0, MAX_STAGE),
				}, true
			end
			return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, true -- new player
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, false
end

local function saveData(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled") then return end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local data = {
		Shards = clean(stats.Shards.Value, 0, 1000000000),
		Blooms = clean(stats.Blooms.Value, 0, 100000000),
		Stage  = clean(stats.Stage.Value, 0, MAX_STAGE),
	}
	-- UpdateAsync, not SetAsync: the write is atomic per key, so two
	-- servers can never interleave half a save over the other.
	pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, function()
			return data
		end)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local data, loaded = loadData(player)
	-- Other systems read these two attributes before they grant
	-- anything. DataLoaded=false means "hands off this player's
	-- economy this session" (Script 10 returns NotProcessedYet for
	-- receipts instead of granting into an unloaded balance).
	player:SetAttribute("DataLoaded", loaded)
	player:SetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled", not loaded)
	if not loaded then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] Data load failed for " .. player.Name
			.. " -- playing unsaved this session; balance is protected.")
	end

	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player

	local shards = Instance.new("IntValue")
	shards.Name = "Shards"
	shards.Value = data.Shards
	shards.Parent = stats

	local blooms = Instance.new("IntValue")
	blooms.Name = "Blooms"
	blooms.Value = data.Blooms
	blooms.Parent = stats

	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = data.Stage
	stage.Parent = stats

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		-- Give the Twin Spear -- once. Without this check every
		-- respawn stacked another copy in the Backpack (duplication
		-- of a Tool is untidy here and a real exploit in games where
		-- tools can be dropped or sold; the habit matters).
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
		if template
			and not player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
			and not character:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear") then
			template:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
		end
		-- Respawn at the player's highest obby checkpoint
		local spawnFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
		if spawnFolder and stage.Value > 0 then
			local pad = spawnFolder:FindFirstChild("Checkpoint_" .. stage.Value)
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			if pad and root then
				task.wait(0.2)
				root.CFrame = pad.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Script 10 (Monetization) fires this after a paid grant so the new
-- balance is persisted immediately, not at the next autosave: a
-- server crash in between must not eat a purchase a child paid for.
local saveEvent = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeRequestSave")
if not saveEvent then
	saveEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	saveEvent.Name = "JadeRequestSave"
	saveEvent.Parent = ServerStorage
end
saveEvent.Event:Connect(function(player)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		saveData(player)
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player) -- late-loading Script safety
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveData)

-- Autosave every 2 minutes
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(120)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			saveData(player)
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		saveData(player)
	end
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 02_TwinSpear.server.lua  (HARDENED + COMBO)
-- Location: Inside the Tool in ServerStorage > TwinSpear (Server Script)
-- Tool setup: Name the Tool "TwinSpear", set RequiresHandle = true.
-- The Twin Spear (Chapter 4) is a long thrusting spear. Parts, all
-- welded to the Part named "Handle": "Handle" (the grip section at
-- the butt of the shaft), "Shaft" (the LONG dark wood shaft -- the
-- body of the weapon; the two guardians' spears are the Twin Spear
-- Pack, forged as a pair from one great branch), "Tip" (one pointed
-- CRYSTAL spear tip -- jade crystal on hers, violet crystal on his;
-- Script 33 paints a player's tip from the creator palette),
-- "GoldBands" (small GOLD accent bands and studs spaced along the
-- shaft -- the twins' signature, straight from their portraits),
-- "Guard" (a small gold collar where shaft meets tip), and
-- "Pommel" (a plain gold-capped butt end). There is no blade, no
-- curve, and no edge anywhere on this weapon: it thrusts.
--
-- THE COMBO SYSTEM (Chapter 15 has the full design):
-- * A thrust that CONNECTS (hits a Thorn Husk or the Great Blossom
--   Tree) starts or extends the Bloom Chain. The next connecting
--   thrust must land within COMBO_WINDOW seconds or the chain ends.
-- * Connecting thrusts cycle three thrust stages:
--   1 Quick Thrust (a fast straight jab, narrow front box),
--   2 Piercing Lunge (a committed forward lunge -- longer, narrower
--   corridor), 3 Bloom Thrust (the lunge lands and bursts a full
--   petal ring around the wielder) -- then back to 1 at the next
--   tier of sparkle.
--   Damage never changes: 25, always. Combos buy spectacle and
--   reach, never power.
-- * TWIN RESONANCE: the two Twin Spears were forged as a pair and
--   remember it. When BOTH guardian accounts (TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID
--   and TWIN_SHADOW_USER_ID, pasted below) are alive, armed, and
--   within TWIN_RESONANCE_RANGE studs of each other, each twin's combo
--   window stretches to TWIN_RESONANCE_WINDOW seconds -- the pair
--   covers each other's recovery, so their chains live longer
--   side by side. That is the whole resonance bonus: time and spectacle.
--   Damage, cooldowns, and rewards do not change, for anyone,
--   ever. With either ID still 0 the resonance never fires.
-- * SOLVENCY: combos mint NOTHING. No Shards, no Blooms, at any
--   chain length. Milestones (chain 10 / 20 / 30+) grant a timed
--   cosmetic aura only. The Tree can be hit forever, so anything
--   currency-shaped here would be an infinite faucet (Chapter 6).
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * Tool.Activated is client-initiated, so everything is re-derived
--   on the server: the wielder (from the character the tool is
--   actually equipped in), aliveness, rate limit, ranges. The combo
--   counter lives in THIS server Script -- a client can display it
--   (Script 12 does, from the server's own updates) but can never
--   set it, extend its window, or claim a milestone.
-- * THE CHAIN BELONGS TO THE PLAYER, NEVER THE WEAPON: chain state
--   is kept in a table keyed by UserId, shared by every copy of
--   this Script. Swapping spear skins, re-equipping, respawning,
--   or thrusting with a different Tool instance entirely continues
--   the SAME chain -- and Script 13's counts, which the chain
--   feeds, are stored under the player's UserId for the same
--   reason. A weapon is a way to thrust; it is never the owner
--   of anything the thrust earns.
-- * This Script creates the "creator" tag Script 4 pays rewards
--   from, stamped per thrust with the verified wielder, expiring in
--   5 seconds. It also reports Tree hits to Script 13's
--   _G.JadeTreeHit, which re-validates distance and rate itself --
--   this Script's say-so is never the only check.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local tool = script.Parent
local DAMAGE = 25
local BASE_COOLDOWN = 0.55   -- seconds between thrusts, no chain live
local COMBO_COOLDOWN = 0.38  -- faster while a chain is live
local COMBO_WINDOW = 1.15    -- seconds to land the next connecting thrust
local MAX_RANGE = 10
-- Twin Resonance (see header). Paste the SAME two numbers used in
-- Scripts 8 (hers) and 35 (his). 0 = bond disabled, fail-closed.
local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0
local TWIN_SHADOW_USER_ID = 0
local TWIN_RESONANCE_WINDOW = 1.70  -- combo window while the twins fight together
local TWIN_RESONANCE_RANGE = 25     -- studs; "side by side" means this or closer

local function twinResonanceActive(player, root)
	if TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID == 0 or TWIN_SHADOW_USER_ID == 0 then return false end
	local partnerId = nil
	if player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID then partnerId = TWIN_SHADOW_USER_ID
	elseif player.UserId == TWIN_SHADOW_USER_ID then partnerId = TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID
	else return false end
	local partner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(partnerId)
	local pChar = partner and partner.Character
	local pRoot = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local pHumanoid = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not pRoot or not pHumanoid or pHumanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if not pChar:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear") then return false end
	return (pRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= TWIN_RESONANCE_RANGE
end

-- Display-only server->client feed for Script 12. There is NO
-- OnServerEvent handler for it anywhere: clients cannot talk back.
local comboEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeComboUpdate")
if not comboEvent then
	comboEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	comboEvent.Name = "JadeComboUpdate"
	comboEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

-- Per-PLAYER chain state, keyed by UserId (never by Tool, never
-- by character): { Combo, LastHit, BusyUntil }. Every Tool copy
-- reads and writes the wielder's one entry.
local chains = {}
local function chainOf(player)
	local st = chains[player.UserId]
	if not st then
		st = { Combo = 0, LastHit = 0, BusyUntil = 0 }
		chains[player.UserId] = st
	end
	return st
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	chains[player.UserId] = nil
end)

local TIER_COLORS = {
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 200),  -- chain 1-4: petal pink
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 185),  -- chain 5-9: hot pink
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 60),   -- chain 10-19: blossom gold
	Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90),   -- chain 20-29: radiant gold
	Color3.fromRGB(190, 240, 255),  -- chain 30+: crystal light
}

local function comboTier(count)
	return math.clamp(math.floor(count / 5) + 1, 1, #TIER_COLORS)
end

local function tagCreator(huskHumanoid, player)
	local tag = huskHumanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	if not tag then
		tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tag.Name = "creator"
		tag.Parent = huskHumanoid
	end
	tag.Value = player
	Debris:AddItem(tag, 5)
end

local function sparkleAt(position, tier, big)
	-- A one-shot sparkle burst on a temporary invisible marker Part.
	local marker = Instance.new("Part")
	marker.Anchored = true
	marker.CanCollide = false
	marker.CanQuery = false
	marker.CanTouch = false
	marker.Transparency = 1
	marker.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	marker.Position = position
	marker.Parent = workspace
	local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	p.Texture = "rbxassetid://241594419" -- sparkle
	p.Color = ColorSequence.new(TIER_COLORS[tier])
	p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.7)
	p.Rate = 0
	p.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 9)
	p.Parent = marker
	p:Emit(big and 40 or 16 + tier * 6)
	Debris:AddItem(marker, 1)
end

local function spearPetalRing(root, tier)
	-- The Bloom Thrust stage's signature: a flat ring of petals
	-- bursting once
	-- around the wielder. Pure decoration, server-created, no damage
	-- of its own -- damage is resolved in the thrust code below.
	for i = 1, 10 + tier * 3 do
		local angle = (i / (10 + tier * 3)) * math.pi * 2
		local petal = Instance.new("Part")
		petal.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		petal.Size = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.14, 0.55)
		petal.Color = TIER_COLORS[tier]
		petal.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		petal.CanCollide = false
		petal.CanTouch = false
		petal.CanQuery = false
		petal.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.cos(angle) * 6, 1, math.sin(angle) * 6)
		petal.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(-math.sin(angle) * 14, 3, math.cos(angle) * 14)
		petal.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(petal, 0.7)
	end
end

local MILESTONE_AURA_SECONDS = { [10] = 15, [20] = 20, [30] = 30 }

local function milestoneAura(character, root, chainCount)
	local seconds = MILESTONE_AURA_SECONDS[chainCount]
	if not seconds and chainCount > 30 and chainCount % 10 == 0 then
		seconds = 30 -- every further 10-chain refreshes the radiant aura
	end
	if not seconds then return end
	local old = root:FindFirstChild("ComboAura")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local aura = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	aura.Name = "ComboAura"
	aura.Texture = "rbxassetid://241594419"
	aura.Color = ColorSequence.new(TIER_COLORS[comboTier(chainCount)])
	aura.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1)
	aura.Rate = 45
	aura.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 3)
	aura.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	aura.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(aura, seconds)
end

local function inArena(root)
	-- The Blossom Arena (Chapter 17): PvP is possible ONLY inside
	-- this cylinder. Script 16 owns entry, protection, and KOs;
	-- this check is the combat gate and it is purely geometric --
	-- a position the server can see, never a client claim.
	local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaCenter")
	if not center or not center:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	local offset = root.Position - center.Position
	return math.sqrt(offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z) <= 55
		and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 25
end

local function knockback(targetRoot, fromPosition)
	local dir = targetRoot.Position - fromPosition
	dir = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if dir.Magnitude < 0.1 then dir = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.Parent = targetRoot
	local velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	velocity.Attachment0 = attachment
	velocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	velocity.VectorVelocity = dir.Unit * 30 + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)
	velocity.MaxForce = 100000
	velocity.Parent = targetRoot
	Debris:AddItem(velocity, 0.18)
	Debris:AddItem(attachment, 0.2)
end

local function onActivated()
	local character = tool.Parent
	if not character or not character:IsA("Model") then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not player or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root then
		return
	end
	local st = chainOf(player)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < st.BusyUntil then return end
	st.BusyUntil = now + 10 -- held until the chain step resolves below

	local bond = twinResonanceActive(player, root)
	local window = bond and TWIN_RESONANCE_WINDOW or COMBO_WINDOW
	local chainLive = st.Combo > 0 and (now - st.LastHit) <= window
	local stage = chainLive and (st.Combo % 3) + 1 or 1
	local tier = comboTier(chainLive and st.Combo + 1 or 1)
	local connected = false
	local source = nil
	local arenaTarget = nil

	local function hitsTarget(targetRoot)
		local offset = root.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(targetRoot.Position)
		local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
		if stage == 3 then
			return distance <= MAX_RANGE -- Bloom Thrust: petal-ring burst, all around
		elseif stage == 2 then
			return math.abs(offset.X) < 8.5 and offset.Z < 1.5 and offset.Z > -10
				and distance <= MAX_RANGE + 1
		end
		return math.abs(offset.X) < 6 and offset.Z < 0.5 and offset.Z > -9
			and distance <= MAX_RANGE
	end

	-- 1) Thorn Husks (co-op, everywhere)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Humanoid") and enemy:GetAttribute("IsThornHusk") then
			local eRoot = enemy.Parent and enemy.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if eRoot and enemy.Health > 0 and hitsTarget(eRoot) then
				tagCreator(enemy, player)
				-- Susanoo bonus (Chapter 30): Script 35 decides --
				-- skeletons only, never players, never in the Arena.
				local bonus = 0
				if _G.JadeSusanooBonusDamage then
					bonus = _G.JadeSusanooBonusDamage(player) or 0
				end
				-- Daemon Resonance (Chapter 32): at full sync in
				-- Weapon form the Daemon surges through the spear.
				if _G.JadeDaemonSurge then
					bonus += _G.JadeDaemonSurge(player) or 0
				end
				enemy:TakeDamage(DAMAGE + bonus)
				sparkleAt(eRoot.Position, tier, stage == 3)
				connected = true
				source = source or "Husk"
			end
		end
	end

	-- 2) The Great Blossom Tree (Chapter 16). Script 13 owns the
	-- counter and the tree's reactions; it re-validates this hit.
	local hitbox = _G.JadeTreeHitbox
	if hitbox and hitbox.Parent and hitsTarget(hitbox) then
		sparkleAt(hitbox.Position + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), tier, stage == 3)
		connected = true
		if source ~= "Arena" then source = "Tree" end
	end

	-- 3) Other players -- ONLY inside the Blossom Arena, and only
	-- if BOTH fighters are in the zone (Chapter 17). Nowhere else
	-- in the game can a thrust touch another player, ever: there is
	-- no friendly fire in the Grove, the Obby, or at the Tree.
	if inArena(root) then
		for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if other ~= player and other.Character then
				local oHumanoid = other.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local oRoot = other.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if oHumanoid and oRoot and oHumanoid.Health > 0
					and inArena(oRoot) and hitsTarget(oRoot) then
					local protectedUntil = other:GetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil") or 0
					if os.clock() >= protectedUntil then
						tagCreator(oHumanoid, player)
						oHumanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
						knockback(oRoot, root.Position)
						sparkleAt(oRoot.Position, tier, stage == 3)
						connected = true
						source = "Arena"
						arenaTarget = other
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Combo bookkeeping: only a CONNECTING thrust moves the chain.
	if connected then
		st.Combo = chainLive and st.Combo + 1 or 1
		st.LastHit = os.clock()
		-- The thrust counter is tied to the PLAYER, never the weapon
		-- (Chapter 16): Script 13 files this under the player's
		-- UserId, whichever spear skin this Tool happens to wear.
		if _G.JadeCountThrust then _G.JadeCountThrust(player, source, arenaTarget) end
		if _G.JadeDaemonThrust then _G.JadeDaemonThrust(player, stage) end
			if _G.JadeBranchOnHit then _G.JadeBranchOnHit(player) end -- Chapter 34: the companion's blossoms glow with the same rhythm
		if stage == 3 then spearPetalRing(root, tier) end
		milestoneAura(character, root, st.Combo)
		comboEvent:FireClient(player, st.Combo, stage, tier)
		local token = st.LastHit
		local userId = player.UserId
		task.delay(window + 0.05, function()
			local cur = chains[userId]
			if cur and cur.LastHit == token and cur.Combo > 0 then
				cur.Combo = 0
				comboEvent:FireClient(player, 0, 0, 1)
			end
		end)
	end

	st.BusyUntil = os.clock() + (st.Combo > 0 and COMBO_COOLDOWN or BASE_COOLDOWN)
end

tool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)
tool.Equipped:Connect(function()
	-- Cosmetic metadata only (Chapter 16): the counter script notes
	-- which skin a player thrusts with for its records. It is never
	-- read by counting, damage, or cooldown code -- swapping skins
	-- mid-chain does not even reset the combo, let alone the count.
	local character = tool.Parent
	local player = character and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if player then
		player:SetAttribute("SpearVariant", tool:GetAttribute("Variant") or "Bloom")
	end
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 03_Pickup.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: Inside any collectable Part (Server Script, ONE per Part)
-- Name the Part "SakuraShard" (+10 Shards) or "CrystalBloom" (+1 Bloom).
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * Touched is physics: a modified client controls its own
--   character's movement and can touch pickups fast, from odd
--   angles, and in bursts. So this handler assumes hostile input:
--   it verifies the toucher is a real player's living character,
--   checks the character is actually at the pickup (server-side
--   distance), and latches a per-part, per-player cooldown BEFORE
--   granting -- in that order, every time.
-- * Exactly ONE copy of this Script per Part. Two copies = two
--   grants per touch. The PickupScriptActive attribute below turns
--   a second pasted copy inert instead of a duplication exploit.
-- * The reward table is a server constant keyed by the Part's own
--   name. A player cannot rename a server Part, so the amount can
--   never arrive from the client.
--
-- SOLVENCY NOTE: the respawn timer IS the faucet rate. One shard
-- point pays at most 10 Shards per 8 seconds = 4,500 Shards/hour.
-- Chapter 6 audits every price in the game against this ceiling.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local part = script.Parent
if part:GetAttribute("PickupScriptActive") then return end
part:SetAttribute("PickupScriptActive", true)

local REWARDS = {
	SakuraShard = { Stat = "Shards", Amount = 10 },
	CrystalBloom = { Stat = "Blooms", Amount = 1 },
}

local reward = REWARDS[part.Name]
if not reward then return end

local RESPAWN_SECONDS = 8
local MAX_TOUCH_DISTANCE = 12 -- HRP to pickup, in studs
local cooldown = {} -- [player] = true while this Part is spent for them

-- Make it pretty: spin and bob
task.spawn(function()
	local start = part.CFrame
	local t = 0
	while part.Parent do
		t += 0.05
		part.CFrame = start * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(t) * 0.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t, 0)
		task.wait()
	end
end)

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit and hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or cooldown[player] then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	if (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > MAX_TOUCH_DISTANCE then
		return -- touch claimed from implausibly far away; ignore it
	end

	cooldown[player] = true -- latch BEFORE granting, never after

	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats and stats:FindFirstChild(reward.Stat) then
		stats[reward.Stat].Value += reward.Amount
	end

	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CanTouch = false
	task.wait(RESPAWN_SECONDS)
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.CanTouch = true
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 05_Checkpoint.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > CheckpointSystem (ONE Server Script)
-- Setup: Folder in Workspace named "Checkpoints". Inside it, Parts named
-- Checkpoint_1, Checkpoint_2, Checkpoint_3 ... in order along the obby.
-- Make each pad jade green, Material = Neon, CanCollide = true.
--
-- SECURITY NOTE (Chapter 14): progress is SEQUENTIAL now. The first
-- edition saved any higher pad a character touched -- so one lucky
-- glitch, one fling exploit, or one friend's launched character
-- landing on Checkpoint_12 permanently banked the whole obby into
-- the DataStore. This version only ever advances a player by one
-- stage at a time: stage N+1 is accepted, anything further ahead is
-- ignored until the stages between are honestly touched in order.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")

for _, pad in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	if pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		local stageNumber = tonumber(string.match(pad.Name, "%d+"))
		if stageNumber then
			pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if not player then return end
				local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
				local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
				if not stats then return end
				local current = stats.Stage.Value
				if stageNumber == current + 1 then
					stats.Stage.Value = stageNumber
					local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
					light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 190)
					light.Range = 14
					light.Parent = pad
					task.delay(1, function() light:Destroy() end)
				end
				-- stageNumber <= current: already banked, no-op.
				-- stageNumber > current + 1: a skip. Ignored, and
				-- deliberately not saved -- see the note above.
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Jade Spirit | 06_ShopAndTeleports.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > ShopAndTeleports (Server Script)
-- Teleports: Parts in Workspace named Teleport_Grove, Teleport_Obby,
-- Teleport_Arena. Touching one moves the player to the matching
-- SpawnLocation named Spawn_Grove, Spawn_Obby, Spawn_Arena.
-- Earn-shop: a Part named "ShopPad" in the Grove sells ONE earn-only
-- cosmetic, the Grove Trail, for Shards earned in play.
--
-- SECURITY / SOLVENCY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * ProximityPrompt.Triggered hands the server a player object, but
--   a modified client can fire prompts from across the map. Every
--   prompt handler in this game therefore re-checks, on the server,
--   that the player's character is genuinely within reach of the
--   pad before money moves. Distance is checked here, in the quest
--   Script 7, and at the spirit form shrine in Script 8.
-- * Ownership lives on the PLAYER, not the character (the first
--   edition stored it on the character, so it vanished on respawn
--   and the same trail could be charged for again and again -- a
--   shard drain for honest players). It is checked before charging,
--   and the charge + grant happen back-to-back with no yield
--   between them, so the prompt cannot be double-fired mid-sale.
-- * The Robux Petal Trail PACK is a different item, sold only by
--   Script 10. Nothing sold for Shards here is also sold for Robux:
--   one item, one currency, one seller -- see the audit in Ch. 6.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local function characterNear(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end

local DESTINATIONS = {
	Teleport_Grove = "Spawn_Grove",
	Teleport_Obby = "Spawn_Obby",
	Teleport_Arena = "Spawn_Arena",
}

local teleportCooldown = {} -- [player] = true for 1s after a hop

for partName, spawnName in pairs(DESTINATIONS) do
	local pad = workspace:WaitForChild(partName, 10)
	local spawn = workspace:WaitForChild(spawnName, 10)
	if pad and spawn then
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if not player or teleportCooldown[player] then return end
			local root = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			teleportCooldown[player] = true
			root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			task.delay(1, function() teleportCooldown[player] = nil end)
		end)
	end
end

-- Earn-only cosmetic shop: Grove Trail for 500 Shards (play-earned)
local TRAIL_PRICE = 500
local shopPad = workspace:WaitForChild("ShopPad", 10)
if shopPad then
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Buy Grove Trail (" .. TRAIL_PRICE .. " Shards)"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Jade Spirit Shop"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.Parent = shopPad

	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if not characterNear(player, shopPad, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then
			return -- prompt fired from out of reach: not a sale
		end
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local character = player.Character
		if not stats or not character then return end
		if player:GetAttribute("OwnsGroveTrail") then return end -- own it: never charge twice
		if stats.Shards.Value < TRAIL_PRICE then return end

		-- Charge and grant together, with no yield between: a second
		-- Triggered arriving in the same frame sees the attribute set.
		stats.Shards.Value -= TRAIL_PRICE
		player:SetAttribute("OwnsGroveTrail", true)

		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local waist = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		if root and waist then
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", waist)
			local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
			trail.Name = "GroveTrail"
			trail.Attachment0 = a0
			trail.Attachment1 = a1
			trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 170))
			trail.Lifetime = 0.6
			trail.Parent = character
		end
	end)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	teleportCooldown[player] = nil
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 07_QuestGiver.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: Inside the Jade Spirit NPC Model in the Grove (Server Script)
-- NPC setup: Model named "JadeSpiritNPC" with HumanoidRootPart.
-- Quest: Free 3 Thorn Husks, earn 150 Shards. This Script creates
-- its own ProximityPrompt on the NPC.
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * The prompt handler re-checks distance on the server before any
--   quest state or currency moves (prompts can be fired remotely
--   by modified clients -- see Script 6's note).
-- * The reward is a server constant, paid once: completion latches
--   the player's state to DONE in the same handler run, before the
--   Shards are added, so a double-fired prompt in the same frame
--   sees a completed quest and pays nothing the second time.
-- * _G.JadeQuestAdd is a server-only bridge (only server Scripts
--   share _G; a client has no path to it). It still validates its
--   inputs: the target must have an ACTIVE quest and the amount is
--   clamped to 1 per call, so no caller -- ours or a future one --
--   can fast-forward a quest with a giant number.
-- * Progress is per-session by design (persisting it is Chapter
--   13's update). The reward gate means the 150 Shards can be
--   earned at most once per session, and only after 3 real frees.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local npc = script.Parent
local root = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Talk"
prompt.ObjectText = "Jade Spirit"
prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
prompt.Parent = root

local QUEST_GOAL = 3
local QUEST_REWARD = 150
local progress = {} -- [player] = number of frees, or "DONE"

prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local cRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not cRoot then return end
	if (cRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
		> prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4 then
		return -- fired from out of reach: not a conversation
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local state = progress[player]

	if state == nil then
		progress[player] = 0
		print(player.Name .. " accepted: Free 3 Thorn Husks in the Grove!")
	elseif state == "DONE" then
		print(player.Name .. " has already completed the Grove quest.")
	elseif state >= QUEST_GOAL then
		progress[player] = "DONE" -- latch BEFORE paying: no double pay
		stats.Shards.Value += QUEST_REWARD
		print(player.Name .. " completed the Grove quest! +" .. QUEST_REWARD .. " Shards")
	else
		print(player.Name .. " quest progress: " .. state .. " / " .. QUEST_GOAL)
	end
end)

-- Called by Script 4 (ThornHusk) when a husk is freed:
--   if _G.JadeQuestAdd then _G.JadeQuestAdd(player, 1) end
_G.JadeQuestAdd = function(player, amount)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
	local state = progress[player]
	if typeof(state) ~= "number" then return end -- no active quest
	progress[player] = state + math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 1)
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	progress[player] = nil
end)

Script 7 tracks quest progress in memory per session (the reward still pays at most once per session, after 3 real frees); persisting quest state belongs in a later update (Chapter 13). Everything money-shaped that began as a simplification in earlier editions — in-memory receipt handling, character-stored shop ownership, unsequenced checkpoints — has been hardened in this edition and is NOT a simplification any more; Chapter 14 is the record of those fixes and the reasoning behind each one.
EXCLUSIVE — not for sale, not unlockable, not a reward:  This form is never sold (Chapter 6), never given as a quest reward, never a Game Pass, and never added to the shop. -- SET THE ID (one minute, do it before publishing):
--   1. Log in as your daughter on roblox.com and open her profile.
--   2. The address bar reads roblox.com/users/<NUMBER>/profile --
--      that number is her UserId. It never changes, even if her
--      display name or username does. (Usernames can be copied by
--      other players. UserIds cannot. That is why the lock uses it.)
--   3. Put that number in place of the 0 on the next line, AND in
--      Script 9 in the same place. Script 9's copy only hides the
--      button for everyone else -- this server copy is the real lock.
-- ============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE 0 with your daughter's UserId

local function isExclusiveOwner(player)
	return EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID
end

-- Her spirit form: pale jade, glowing -- a body of living jade
-- light, solid and smooth, with no head: the form is the First
-- Guardian's, and it is hers and hers only.
local SPIRIT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(168, 235, 203)
local SPIRIT_MATERIAL = Enum.Material.Neon

-- Form part name in SpiritRig -> R15 body Part it welds to.
-- THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO HEAD PART IN THIS LIST.
-- Headless means the rig adds nothing at the head slot: the real Head
-- is hidden with the rest of the body and nothing replaces it.
local FORM_MAP = {
	TorsoGlow       = "UpperTorso",
	DefinitiveWing  = "UpperTorso", -- Chapter 36: ONE double-sized angel wing (pink feathers, brown tips) welded at the back of the UpperTorso -- the wing IS the outfit; the morph wears no clothing assets
	Pelvis          = "LowerTorso",
	LeftUpperArm    = "LeftUpperArm",
	LeftLowerArm    = "LeftLowerArm",
	LeftHand        = "LeftHand",
	RightUpperArm   = "RightUpperArm",
	RightLowerArm   = "RightLowerArm",
	RightHand       = "RightHand",
	LeftUpperLeg    = "LeftUpperLeg",
	LeftLowerLeg    = "LeftLowerLeg",
	LeftFoot        = "LeftFoot",
	RightUpperLeg   = "RightUpperLeg",
	RightLowerLeg   = "RightLowerLeg",
	RightFoot       = "RightFoot",
}

-- Floating keepsakes: rig Part name -> body Part it hovers with.
-- These keep their OWN colour (the bow stays pink) and are the only
-- things at head height -- a bow floating over an empty neck is her
-- signature, and it is what other players will recognise her by.
local FLOATING_MAP = {
	SpiritBow = "Head",
}

-- Remote the client toggle (Script 9) fires. Created here if missing.
local toggleEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeSpiritToggle")
if not toggleEvent then
	toggleEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	toggleEvent.Name = "JadeSpiritToggle"
	toggleEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local saved = {} -- [character] = { [instance] = original Transparency }

local function remember(instance)
	local char = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	if not saved[char] then saved[char] = {} end
	if saved[char][instance] == nil then
		saved[char][instance] = instance.Transparency
	end
end

local function hideBody(character)
	-- Hide every visible body part -- Head included -- plus the face
	-- and accessories. The Parts and Motor6D joints stay in place;
	-- only the rendering goes. Animations, tools, and hats' anchor
	-- points are untouched, which is why nothing breaks.
	for _, inst in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") and inst.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
			remember(inst)
			inst.Transparency = 1
		elseif inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
			remember(inst)
			inst.Transparency = 1
		elseif inst:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			inst:Destroy()
		end
	end
	for _, acc in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if acc:IsA("Accessory") then
			local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
			if handle then
				remember(handle)
				handle.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	end
end

local function showBody(character)
	local store = saved[character]
	if store then
		for inst, transparency in pairs(store) do
			if inst and inst.Parent then
				inst.Transparency = transparency
			end
		end
		saved[character] = nil
	end
end

local function clearSpiritForm(character)
	local old = character:FindFirstChild("SpiritRig")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	character:SetAttribute("IsSpiritForm", false)
	character:SetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit", false)
end

local function weldTo(form, body, keepOwnColor)
	form.Anchored = false
	form.CanCollide = false
	form.CanTouch = false
	form.CanQuery = false
	form.Massless = true
	if not keepOwnColor then
		form.Color = SPIRIT_COLOR
		form.Material = SPIRIT_MATERIAL
	end
	form.CFrame = body.CFrame
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = body
	weld.Part1 = form
	weld.Parent = form
end

local function applySpiritForm(character)
	clearSpiritForm(character)
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("SpiritRig")
	if not template then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] SpiritRig not found in ServerStorage. Build it from Chapter 9, Step 2.")
		return
	end

	hideBody(character)

	local rig = template:Clone()
	rig.Name = "SpiritRig"
	rig.Parent = character

	-- Headless guarantee, enforced in code as well as in the build:
	-- if a Head part was ever left in the template rig, it is removed
	-- here and never reaches her character.
	local strayHead = rig:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
	if strayHead then strayHead:Destroy() end

	local welded = {} -- [form instance] = body Part it follows
	local templateCF = {} -- [form instance] = its template CFrame

	for formName, bodyName in pairs(FORM_MAP) do
		local form = rig:FindFirstChild(formName, true)
		local body = character:FindFirstChild(bodyName)
		if form and body and form:IsA("BasePart") then
			templateCF[form] = form.CFrame
			welded[form] = body
			weldTo(form, body, false)
		elseif form then
			form:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Floating keepsakes (the pink Spirit Bow): welded to the Head's
	-- body Part so the bow hovers and bobs with her movement, but the
	-- Head itself stays invisible -- bow visible, head not. That is
	-- the headless look.
	for partName, bodyName in pairs(FLOATING_MAP) do
		local part = rig:FindFirstChild(partName, true)
		local body = character:FindFirstChild(bodyName)
		if part and body and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			templateCF[part] = part.CFrame
			welded[part] = body
			-- Lift the bow above the empty neck joint.
			part.Anchored = false
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.CanTouch = false
			part.CanQuery = false
			part.Massless = true
			part.CFrame = body.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.85, 0)
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = body
			weld.Part1 = part
			weld.Parent = part
		elseif part then
			part:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Detail Parts parented UNDER a form part in the template (a
	-- jade heart at the chest, glow studs along the arms): each
	-- keeps its own colour and offset and rides its form part.
	for _, detail in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
		if detail:IsA("BasePart") and not welded[detail] then
			local form = detail.Parent
			while form and not welded[form] do
				form = form.Parent
			end
			if form then
				local offset = templateCF[form]:ToObjectSpace(detail.CFrame)
				detail.Anchored = false
				detail.CanCollide = false
				detail.CanTouch = false
				detail.CanQuery = false
				detail.Massless = true
				detail.CFrame = welded[form].CFrame * offset
				local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
				weld.Part0 = welded[form]
				weld.Part1 = detail
				weld.Parent = detail
			else
				detail:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	character:SetAttribute("IsSpiritForm", true)
	character:SetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit", true)
end

local function removeSpiritForm(character)
	clearSpiritForm(character)
	showBody(character)
end

local lastToggle = {} -- [player] = os.clock() of last accepted toggle

local function toggle(player)
	-- THE LOCK. Every way in -- the on-screen button, the B key, the
	-- Xbox Y button, the shrine pad, and any script or exploit that
	-- fires this RemoteEvent directly -- arrives at this one function,
	-- and this function checks the UserId before it does anything.
	-- For everyone else it simply returns: no error, no message, no
	-- partial morph. There is nothing for them to unlock or buy.
	if not isExclusiveOwner(player) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastToggle[player] and now - lastToggle[player] < 1 then return end
	lastToggle[player] = now
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	if character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then
		removeSpiritForm(character)
	else
		applySpiritForm(character)
	end
end

-- The (player) below is supplied by Roblox for the firing
-- connection. Any arguments an exploiter adds are ignored by design.
toggleEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	toggle(player)
end)

-- Optional shrine station: a Part named SpiritStation in Workspace
-- (Chapter 9, Step 5). The prompt is visible in the world, but its
-- handler is the same locked toggle() above -- stepping up to the
-- shrine does nothing at all for anyone except the named owner.
local station = workspace:FindFirstChild("SpiritStation")
if station and station:IsA("BasePart") then
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Become the Jade Spirit"
	prompt.ObjectText = "A Family Keepsake"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
	prompt.Parent = station
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		-- Prompts can be fired from across the map by modified
		-- clients, so reach is re-checked on the server (the UserId
		-- lock in toggle() then applies as usual).
		local character = player and player.Character
		local cRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not cRoot then return end
		if (cRoot.Position - station.Position).Magnitude
			> prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4 then return end
		toggle(player)
	end)
end

local function spawnArrivalEffect(character)
	-- Her entrance (Chapter 9): a breath of petals and a jade
	-- shimmer as the Guardian arrives. Pure theatre, server-made,
	-- the same for every witness -- other players are MEANT to
	-- see this. The legend walks in; she does not sneak in.
	local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	for _ = 1, 22 do
		local petal = Instance.new("Part")
		petal.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
		petal.Size = Vector3.new(0.55, 0.14, 0.55)
		petal.Color = Color3.fromRGB(168, 235, 203)
		petal.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		petal.CanCollide = false
		petal.CanTouch = false
		petal.CanQuery = false
		petal.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(math.random(-3, 3), math.random(0, 4), math.random(-3, 3))
		petal.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-4, 4), math.random(2, 6), math.random(-4, 4))
		petal.Parent = workspace
		Debris:AddItem(petal, 1.6)
	end
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 255, 200)
	light.Range = 12
	light.Brightness = 2
	light.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(light, 0.8)
end
local function setupPlayer(player)
	-- Tell her client (and only hers) that the form is hers, so
	-- Script 9 can draw its button. This attribute grants nothing by
	-- itself -- toggle() above re-checks the UserId on every use,
	-- and a client that sets this attribute for itself locally has
	-- changed nothing on the server.
	player:SetAttribute("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit", isExclusiveOwner(player))
	-- AUTO-MORPH (Chapter 9): for the exclusive owner, the spirit form
	-- is not something she visits -- it is how she ARRIVES. The
	-- CharacterAdded connection below applies it on every spawn for
	-- her UserId only, once the character has loaded, with the
	-- arrival effect. She may toggle it off and play as herself for
	-- the rest of that life; the next respawn defaults to the
	-- Guardian again. No other player's spawn path touches this.
	if isExclusiveOwner(player) then
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			task.spawn(function()
				local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
				if not root then return end
				task.wait(0.4)
				if player.Character == character
					and not character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then
					applySpiritForm(character)
					spawnArrivalEffect(character)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		saved[character] = nil
		character:SetAttribute("IsSpiritForm", false)
		character:SetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit", false)
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player) -- late-loading Script safety
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastToggle[player] = nil
	if player.Character then saved[player.Character] = nil end
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 09_HeadlessSpiritToggle.client.lua  (EXCLUSIVE VERSION)
-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > insert LocalScript,
-- rename it HeadlessSpiritToggle. (A LocalScript -- server Scripts cannot
-- read a controller, a keyboard, or a touch screen.)
-- What it does: for the ONE exclusive owner only, one on-screen button
-- (phone / tablet / mouse), the B key on PC, and the Y button on an
-- Xbox controller -- all firing the same RemoteEvent that Script 8
-- checks on the server.
--
-- FOR EVERYONE ELSE THIS SCRIPT DRAWS NOTHING AND BINDS NO KEYS.
-- There is no greyed-out button, no "locked" teaser, no shop link --
-- the form is a private gift, not an advert, so other players simply
-- never see that it exists in their controls.
--
-- SET THE SAME ID AS SCRIPT 8: replace the 0 below with your
-- daughter's UserId (roblox.com/users/<NUMBER>/profile). This copy
-- only controls what her screen shows. The real lock is Script 8's
-- server check -- if the two numbers ever disagree, the server wins:
-- a visible button with the wrong server ID does nothing when tapped.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE 0 with your daughter's UserId

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

if EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID == 0 or player.UserId ~= EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID then
	return -- not hers: no button, no keybinds, nothing to discover
end

local toggleEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("JadeSpiritToggle")

-- Big, thumb-friendly button, bottom-right, clear of the jump button.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "HeadlessSpiritToggleGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Name = "Spirit formButton"
button.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 52)
button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -186, 1, -128)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(168, 235, 203)
button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 34)
button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
button.TextSize = 15
button.Text = "Jade Spirit form: OFF"
button.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
corner.Parent = button

-- Second gate, defence in depth: Script 8 sets the server attribute
-- HasHeadlessJadeSpirit on the Player at join. If it ever reports
-- false (IDs pasted into the two Scripts disagree, or Script 8 is
-- missing), the button hides itself rather than sit there dead --
-- and firing the event anyway would still fail Script 8's own
-- server check, which is the only check that grants anything.
local function syncServerGate()
	if player:GetAttribute("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit") == false then
		gui.Enabled = false
	else
		gui.Enabled = true
	end
end
syncServerGate()
player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit"):Connect(syncServerGate)

local function flipLabel(character)
	-- Trust the server's attribute, not a local guess, so the shrine
	-- prompt in Script 8 and this button never disagree.
	local isOn = character and character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") == true
	button.Text = isOn and "Jade Spirit form: ON" or "Jade Spirit form: OFF"
end

local function requestToggle()
	toggleEvent:FireServer()
end

button.Activated:Connect(requestToggle)

-- PC keyboard: B. Xbox controller: Y (ButtonY). UserInputService
-- reports gamepad buttons through the same event as keys, so one
-- block covers both -- there is no separate "Xbox version".
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end -- do not fire while typing in chat
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY then
		requestToggle()
	end
end)

local function watchCharacter(character)
	flipLabel(character)
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsJadeSpirit"):Connect(function()
		flipLabel(character)
	end)
end

if player.Character then watchCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)

--   logged to the server Output, and rate-locked after three.

-- ---------- validation: the whole security model in one function ----
local profiles = {}      -- [UserId] = sanitised config or false
local loadOk = {}        -- [UserId] = true only after a clean read
local applying = {}      -- [UserId] = true while THIS Script builds
local invalidLog = {}    -- [UserId] = { count, windowStart, lockedUntil, lastLog }

local function recordInvalid(player, reason)
	local now = os.clock()
	local entry = invalidLog[player.UserId]
	if not entry or now - entry.windowStart > 60 then
		entry = { count = 0, windowStart = now, lockedUntil = 0, lastLog = 0 }
		invalidLog[player.UserId] = entry
	end
	entry.count = entry.count + 1
	if entry.count >= 3 then entry.lockedUntil = now + 60 end
	if now - entry.lastLog >= 5 then
		entry.lastLog = now
		warn(string.format("[JadeCreator] Rejected config from %s (UserId %d): %s (strike %d)",
			player.Name, player.UserId, reason, entry.count))
	end
end

local function validateConfig(player, raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "payload is not a table" end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 1 profile (8 fields, no mask
	-- fields) is upgraded with the starter mask, then validated
	-- exactly like a native v2 payload. A CLIENT payload claiming
	-- Version 1 with mask fields, or any other field mix, fails.
	if raw.Version == 1 then
		local v1Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v1Count = v1Count + 1
			if not V1_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v1 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v1Count ~= 8 then return nil, "v1 field count is not exactly 8" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(maskDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		-- v1 named the weapon slot "Scythe"; the current schema
		-- calls it "Spear" (the Twin Spear redesign, Chapter 4).
		-- Same palette ID, new field name -- the value carries
		-- over untouched.
		merged.Spear = merged.Scythe
		merged.Scythe = nil
		for key, value in pairs(designDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 3
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 2 profile (13 fields, masks but
	-- no weapon/wing design) gains the design defaults the same
	-- way -- the unified flow must never orphan an older profile.
	if raw.Version == 2 then
		local v2Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v2Count = v2Count + 1
			if not V2_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v2 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v2Count ~= 13 then return nil, "v2 field count is not exactly 13" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(designDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 3
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 3 profile (19 fields, no Daemon
	-- choices) gains the Daemon defaults the same way.
	if raw.Version == 3 then
		local v3Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v3Count = v3Count + 1
			if not V3_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v3 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v3Count ~= 19 then return nil, "v3 field count is not exactly 19" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(daemonDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 4
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 4 profile (25 fields, no
	-- DaemonForm) gains the solid-form default the same way.
	if raw.Version == 4 then
		local v4Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v4Count = v4Count + 1
			if not V4_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v4 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v4Count ~= 25 then return nil, "v4 field count is not exactly 25" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.DaemonForm = "FormSolid"
		merged.Version = 5
		raw = merged
	end
	local keyCount = 0
	for key in pairs(raw) do
		keyCount = keyCount + 1
		if not CONFIG_KEYS[key] then
			return nil, "unapproved field present: " .. tostring(key)
		end
	end
	if keyCount ~= 26 then return nil, "field count is not exactly 26" end
	if raw.Version ~= 5 then return nil, "Version is not 5" end
	if type(raw.Chassis) ~= "string" or not CHASSIS[raw.Chassis] then
		return nil, "Chassis is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.Material) ~= "string" or not MATERIALS[raw.Material] then
		return nil, "Material is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.Detail) ~= "number" or not DETAIL_STOPS[raw.Detail] then
		return nil, "Detail is not an approved stop"
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs({ "Spear", "Aura", "Effects" }) do
		if type(raw[slot]) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw[slot]] then
			return nil, slot .. " colour is not in the palette"
		end
	end
	if type(raw.Lighting) ~= "string" or not LIGHTING[raw.Lighting] then
		return nil, "Lighting is not an approved preview"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskShape) ~= "string" or not MASK_SHAPES[raw.MaskShape] then
		return nil, "MaskShape is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskMaterial) ~= "string" or not MASK_MATERIALS[raw.MaskMaterial] then
		return nil, "MaskMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskColor) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw.MaskColor] then
		return nil, "MaskColor is not in the palette"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskGlow) ~= "string" or not MASK_GLOWS[raw.MaskGlow] then
		return nil, "MaskGlow is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskMotif) ~= "string" or not MASK_MOTIFS[raw.MaskMotif] then
		return nil, "MaskMotif is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WeaponStyle) ~= "string" or not WEAPON_STYLES[raw.WeaponStyle] then
		return nil, "WeaponStyle is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WeaponMaterial) ~= "string" or not WEAPON_MATERIALS[raw.WeaponMaterial] then
		return nil, "WeaponMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingCount) ~= "number" or not WING_COUNTS[raw.WingCount] then
		return nil, "WingCount is not 0, 1, or 2"
	end
	if type(raw.WingShape) ~= "string" or not WING_SHAPES[raw.WingShape] then
		return nil, "WingShape is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingMaterial) ~= "string" or not WING_MATERIALS[raw.WingMaterial] then
		return nil, "WingMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingColor) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw.WingColor] then
		return nil, "WingColor is not in the palette"
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs({ "DaemonColor", "DaemonGlow", "DaemonClaw" }) do
		if type(raw[slot]) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw[slot]] then
			return nil, slot .. " is not in the palette"
		end
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonMaterial) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_MATERIALS[raw.DaemonMaterial] then
		return nil, "DaemonMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonScale) ~= "number" or not DAEMON_SCALES[raw.DaemonScale] then
		return nil, "DaemonScale is not an approved scale"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonAccessory) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_ACCESSORIES[raw.DaemonAccessory] then
		return nil, "DaemonAccessory is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonForm) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_FORMS[raw.DaemonForm] then
		return nil, "DaemonForm is not on the whitelist"
	end
	-- The skeleton form is a STANDARD skeleton-bear variant: it
	-- passes this gate for any account that owns the Daemon
	-- Design Package (OwnsDaemonDesignPack). It is NOT Oakley's
	-- pet -- her Daemon is the Gold Dragon (Script 39, GoldDragon),
	-- which no Workbench field can name or grant.
	if raw.DaemonForm == "FormSkeleton" and player:GetAttribute("OwnsDaemonDesignPack") ~= true then
		return nil, "DaemonForm FormSkeleton requires the Daemon Design Package"
	end
	-- Rebuilt from catalogue constants, never the client's table:
	-- even a passing payload contributes nothing but its choices.
	return { Version = 5, Chassis = raw.Chassis, Material = raw.Material,
		Detail = raw.Detail, Spear = raw.Spear, Aura = raw.Aura,
		Effects = raw.Effects, Lighting = raw.Lighting,
		MaskShape = raw.MaskShape, MaskMaterial = raw.MaskMaterial,
		MaskColor = raw.MaskColor, MaskGlow = raw.MaskGlow, MaskMotif = raw.MaskMotif,
		WeaponStyle = raw.WeaponStyle, WeaponMaterial = raw.WeaponMaterial,
		WingCount = raw.WingCount, WingShape = raw.WingShape,
		WingMaterial = raw.WingMaterial, WingColor = raw.WingColor,
		DaemonColor = raw.DaemonColor, DaemonMaterial = raw.DaemonMaterial,
		DaemonScale = raw.DaemonScale, DaemonGlow = raw.DaemonGlow,
		DaemonClaw = raw.DaemonClaw, DaemonAccessory = raw.DaemonAccessory,
		DaemonForm = raw.DaemonForm }
end

local function isLockedOut(player)
	local entry = invalidLog[player.UserId]
	return entry and os.clock() < entry.lockedUntil or false
end

-- ---------- persistence: sanitised profiles only ---------------------
local function saveProfile(player)
	if not loadOk[player.UserId] then return end
	local config = profiles[player.UserId]
	if config == nil then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, config or false)
	end)
end

local function loadProfile(player)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			loadOk[player.UserId] = true
			if data == nil or data == false then
				profiles[player.UserId] = data or false
				return
			end
			local clean, reason = validateConfig(player, data)
			if clean then
				profiles[player.UserId] = clean
			else
				-- Stored data failing today's whitelist is treated
				-- as no profile and never re-saved over itself.
				profiles[player.UserId] = false
				loadOk[player.UserId] = false
				recordInvalid(player, "stored profile rejected: " .. reason)
			end
			return
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	profiles[player.UserId] = false
end

-- ---------- building the look (server-side parts only) ---------------
local function clearCreatorLook(character)
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 12) == "JadeCreator_" then child:Destroy() end
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		local emitter = root:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_Effect")
		if emitter then emitter:Destroy() end
	end
end

local function setScales(humanoid, scales)
	local fields = { Height = "HeightScale", Width = "WidthScale", Depth = "DepthScale",
		Head = "HeadScale", BodyType = "BodyTypeScale", Proportion = "ProportionScale" }
	for key, childName in pairs(fields) do
		local value = humanoid:FindFirstChild(childName)
		if value and value:IsA("NumberValue") then value.Value = scales[key] end
	end
end

local function makePart(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end

local function weldTo(part, target, offset)
	part.CFrame = target.CFrame * offset
	part.Parent = target.Parent
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = part
	weld.Part1 = target
	weld.Parent = part
end

local function makeWedge(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end

-- ---------- the Mask Atelier build (server-side parts only) ----------
-- One source of truth for mask colours: the builder paints from
-- this function and the sweep repairs from this function, so a
-- tampered mask part is repainted to exactly these values.
local function maskRoleColor(role, config)
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	if role == "accent" then
		if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then return paletteColor(config.MaskColor) end
		return paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(mat.Color[1], mat.Color[2], mat.Color[3])
end

local function maskRoleMaterial(role, config)
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	if role == "accent" and config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then
		return Enum.Material.Neon
	end
	return Enum.Material[mat.Material]
end

-- The exact set of mask parts a config should produce:
-- [part name] = expected Color3. The sweep compares against this.
local function expectedMaskParts(config)
	local expected = {}
	if config.MaskShape == "None" then return expected end
	local shape = MASK_SHAPES[config.MaskShape]
	for _, entry in ipairs(shape.Parts) do
		expected["JadeCreator_Mask" .. entry[1]] = maskRoleColor(entry[4], config)
	end
	local motif = MASK_MOTIFS[config.MaskMotif]
	for i = 1, motif.Count do
		local color = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
			or maskRoleColor("main", config)
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i] = color
	end
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEyes" then
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskEyeL"] = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskEyeR"] = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
	end
	return expected
end

local function buildMask(character, config)
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head or config.MaskShape == "None" then return end
	local shape = MASK_SHAPES[config.MaskShape]
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	for _, entry in ipairs(shape.Parts) do
		local suffix, size, offset, role, kind = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3], entry[4], entry[5]
		local color = maskRoleColor(role, config)
		local material = maskRoleMaterial(role, config)
		local part
		if kind == "Wedge" then
			part = makeWedge("JadeCreator_Mask" .. suffix,
				Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3]), color, material)
		else
			part = makePart("JadeCreator_Mask" .. suffix,
				Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3]), color, material)
		end
		if role == "main" then part.Transparency = mat.Transparency end
		weldTo(part, head, CFrame.new(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3]))
	end
	-- Motif attachments, welded to the head over the mask plate.
	local motifOffsets = {
		MotifSpiral = { { 0, 0.42, -0.70 } },
		MotifBlossom = { { 0, 0.48, -0.68 }, { -0.17, 0.36, -0.68 }, { 0.17, 0.36, -0.68 },
			{ -0.10, 0.60, -0.68 }, { 0.10, 0.60, -0.68 } },
		MotifFang = { { -0.28, -0.68, -0.60 }, { 0.28, -0.68, -0.60 } },
	}
	local offsets = motifOffsets[config.MaskMotif]
	if offsets then
		local motifColor = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and paletteColor(config.MaskColor) or maskRoleColor("main", config)
		local motifMaterial = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material[MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial].Material]
		for i, off in ipairs(offsets) do
			local part
			if config.MaskMotif == "MotifFang" then
				part = makeWedge("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.16, 0.34, 0.16), motifColor, motifMaterial)
			elseif config.MaskMotif == "MotifSpiral" then
				part = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.52, 0.52, 0.08), motifColor, motifMaterial)

					Vector3.new(0.20, 0.20, 0.10), motifColor, motifMaterial)
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			end
			weldTo(part, head, CFrame.new(off[1], off[2], off[3]))
		end
	end
	-- Glowing eyes: two neon lenses on the mask's eye line.
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEyes" then
		for _, side in ipairs({ { "L", -0.30 }, { "R", 0.30 } }) do
			local eye = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskEye" .. side[1],

			weldTo(eye, head, CFrame.new(side[2], 0.14, -0.68))
		end
	end
	-- Glowing etchings: one soft light inside the main plate.
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then
		local plate = character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_MaskPlate")
			or character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_MaskLowerPlate")
		if plate then

			light.Name = "JadeCreator_MaskGlowLight"
			light.Color = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
			light.Brightness = 1
			light.Range = 6
			light.Parent = plate
		end
	end
end

local function paintSpear(player, config)
	local containers = {}
	local character = player.Character
	if character then table.insert(containers, character) end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then table.insert(containers, backpack) end
	for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
		local tool = container:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
		if tool then
			for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "Tip" then
					-- Only the crystal spear Tip takes the palette.
					-- The wood Shaft, gold GoldBands, and dark Handle
					-- are the twins' fixed design and never repainted.
					part.Color = config and paletteColor(config.Spear) or TIP_DEFAULT
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local EXPECTED_BY_DETAIL = {
	[0] = { JadeCreator_Sash = true },
	[25] = { JadeCreator_Sash = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderLeft = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderRight = true },
	[50] = { JadeCreator_Sash = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderLeft = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderRight = true, JadeCreator_TorsoPlate = true },
	[75] = { JadeCreator_Sash = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderLeft = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderRight = true, JadeCreator_TorsoPlate = true, JadeCreator_AuraRing = true },
	[100] = { JadeCreator_Sash = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderLeft = true, JadeCreator_ShoulderRight = true, JadeCreator_TorsoPlate = true, JadeCreator_AuraRing = true },

local function expectedColor(name, config)
	if name == "JadeCreator_Sash" then return paletteColor(config.Effects) end
	if name == "JadeCreator_AuraRing" then return paletteColor(config.Aura) end
	local mat = MATERIALS[config.Material]
	return Color3.fromRGB(mat.Color[1], mat.Color[2], mat.Color[3])
end

local function sweep(player, source)
	if applying[player.UserId] then return end
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local config = profiles[player.UserId]
	if character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then
		if character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_Sash") then clearCreatorLook(character) end
		return
	end
	if not config then
		if character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_Sash") then
			recordInvalid(player, "creator parts present with no profile (" .. source .. ")")
			removeConfig(player)
		end
		return
	end
	local expected = EXPECTED_BY_DETAIL[config.Detail]
	local expectedMask = expectedMaskParts(config)
	local dirty = false
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 12) == "JadeCreator_" then
			if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 17) == "JadeCreator_Mask" then
				-- Mask parts answer to the mask catalogue, not Detail.
				local want = expectedMask[child.Name]
				if not want then
					recordInvalid(player, "unapproved mask part " .. child.Name .. " (" .. source .. ")")
					child:Destroy()
					dirty = true
				elseif child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Color ~= want then
					child.Color = want -- repair, don't trust
					dirty = true
				end
			elseif not expected[child.Name] then
				recordInvalid(player, "unapproved creator part " .. child.Name .. " (" .. source .. ")")
				child:Destroy()
				dirty = true
			elseif child:IsA("BasePart") and child.Color ~= expectedColor(child.Name, config) then
				child.Color = expectedColor(child.Name, config) -- repair, don't trust
				dirty = true
			end
		end
	end
	-- Scale tampering is repaired from the catalogue, not debated.
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		local want = CHASSIS[config.Chassis]
		local fields = { Height = "HeightScale", Width = "WidthScale", Depth = "DepthScale",
			Head = "HeadScale", BodyType = "BodyTypeScale", Proportion = "ProportionScale" }
		for key, childName in pairs(fields) do
			local value = humanoid:FindFirstChild(childName)
			if value and value:IsA("NumberValue") and math.abs(value.Value - want[key]) > 0.001 then
				value.Value = want[key]
				dirty = true
			end
		end
	end
	if dirty or source == "Respawn" then paintSpear(player, config) end
end

local lastApply = {}
applyEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, payload)
	if type(action) ~= "string" then
		recordInvalid(player, "action is not a string")
		return
	end
	if action == "Remove" then
		profiles[player.UserId] = false
		removeConfig(player)
		saveProfile(player)
		return
	end
	if action ~= "Apply" then
		recordInvalid(player, "unknown action " .. action)
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastApply[player.UserId] and now - lastApply[player.UserId] < 1 then return end
	lastApply[player.UserId] = now
	if isLockedOut(player) then
		recordInvalid(player, "apply attempted during validation lockout")
		return
	end
	local clean, reason = validateConfig(player, payload)
	if not clean then
		recordInvalid(player, reason)
		return
	end
	profiles[player.UserId] = clean
	if applyConfig(player, clean) then saveProfile(player) end
end)

local function previewPart(parent, name, size, pos, color, material, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = pos
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.Anchored = true
	if shape then part.Shape = shape end
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

function refreshPreview()
	if previewModel then previewModel:Destroy() end
	previewModel = Instance.new("Model")
	previewModel.Parent = world
	local h, w = table.unpack(PROPORTIONS[state.Chassis] or { 1, 1 })
	local matEntry = materialById[state.Material]
	local matColor = matEntry and rgb(matEntry.Color) or Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165)
	local blueprint = state.Detail == 0
	local bodyColor = blueprint and Color3.fromRGB(120, 190, 255) or matColor
	local bodyMat = blueprint and Enum.Material.ForceField or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	local pivot = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	local function place(size, localPos)
		return (pivot * CFrame.new(localPos)).Position
	end
	-- A complete spirit: head included, always. The workbench has
	-- no headless anything -- that form is not a catalogue item.
	previewPart(previewModel, "LegL", Vector3.new(0.55 * w, 1.6 * h, 0.6), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(-0.35 * w, 0.8 * h, 0)), bodyColor, bodyMat)
	previewPart(previewModel, "LegR", Vector3.new(0.55 * w, 1.6 * h, 0.6), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(0.35 * w, 0.8 * h, 0)), bodyColor, bodyMat)
	previewPart(previewModel, "Torso", Vector3.new(1.5 * w, 1.9 * h, 0.8), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(0, 2.55 * h, 0)), bodyColor, bodyMat)
	previewPart(previewModel, "ArmL", Vector3.new(0.45 * w, 1.7 * h, 0.5), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(-1.05 * w, 2.6 * h, 0)), bodyColor, bodyMat)
	previewPart(previewModel, "ArmR", Vector3.new(0.45 * w, 1.7 * h, 0.5), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(1.05 * w, 2.6 * h, 0)), bodyColor, bodyMat)
	previewPart(previewModel, "Head", Vector3.new(0.95, 0.95, 0.95), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(0, 4.05 * h, 0)), bodyColor, bodyMat)
	-- The mask, previewed on the mannequin's face: a plate in the
	-- chosen mask material, an accent trim in the mask colour, the
	-- motif as a forehead mark, and neon eye lenses on GlowEyes.
	-- Generic catalogue masks only -- her heirloom mask and his
	-- shadow mask are not in this catalogue and cannot be previewed.
	if state.MaskShape ~= "None" then
		local mm = maskMaterialById[state.MaskMaterial]
		local maskColor = mm and rgb(mm.Color) or Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165)
		local accent = rgb(paletteById[state.MaskColor])
		local my = state.MaskShape == "Half" and 3.80 * h or 4.05 * h

		previewPart(previewModel, "MaskTrim", Vector3.new(1.0, 0.14, 0.15), place(Vector3.new(0), Vector3.new(0, my + mh / 2, -0.52)), accent, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

				rgb(paletteById[state.Effects]), Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)

	-- The Twin Spear in hand: a LONG wood shaft, a gold guard

-- Jade Spirit | 35_SusanooSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it SusanooSystem
-- What it does: THE GUARDIAN (Chapter 30). Every Keeper's Daemon
-- pet is their Susanoo, condensed (Chapter 32, Script 39); this
-- Script is the same being EXPANDED -- a giant spectral guardian
-- in the Naruto tradition, rebuilt here in the Grove's own
-- language: jade light, blossom colour, a spectral warrior that
-- manifests AROUND its player and grows as they do. One being,
-- two states: Daemon pet when folded, Susanoo when open.
-- (The staged spectral-warrior idea is the inspiration; every part,
-- name, colour, and line of code here is original to this game.)
--
-- STAGING (server-derived from Lifetime thrusts + Guardian Essence;
-- the client can display a stage but can never claim one):
--   Stage 1 AWAKENED FRAME   250 lifetime
--   Stage 2 ARMED GUARDIAN     2,500 lifetime
--   Stage 3 SPECTRAL WARRIOR   15,000 lifetime + 100 essence
--   Stage 4 PERFECT FORM       60,000 lifetime + 400 essence
--   Stage 5 ETERNAL BLOOM      250,000 lifetime + 1,200 essence
-- Essence is earned in the fight itself: +2 per Hollow skeleton laid to rest, +15
-- per Hollow boss, +25 on a boss drop roll, +5 per defense held.
-- It is granted only through _G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence, a
-- server-side global no client can reach, clamped per call.
--
-- FAIRNESS, IN CODE: the guardian's gifts work ONLY against the
-- corruption. Its shield absorbs damage only outside the Blossom
-- Arena, and Script 2 asks this Script for bonus damage only on
-- husk targets -- the bonus function itself re-checks the wielder
-- is not standing in the Arena. In PvP the guardian is a silhouette
-- and nothing more. Nobody buys a stage: no pass, product, or shop
-- entry touches this system, at any price.
--
-- APPEARANCE: the guardian wears the player's own Spirit Workbench
-- choices -- Script 33 publishes CreatorMaterial / CreatorAura /
-- CreatorEffects as player attributes, and this Script reads them.
-- No creator profile yet? The guardian defaults to jade.

local function defaultData()
	return { Stage = 0, Essence = 0, EssenceTotal = 0, Manifested = true, Kills = 0 }
end

local function savePlayer(player)
	if not loadOk[player.UserId] then return end
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	if not record then return end
	pcall(function() store:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, record) end)
	dirty[player.UserId] = nil
end

local function loadPlayer(player)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, saved = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			loadOk[player.UserId] = true
			local record = defaultData()
			if type(saved) == "table" then
				record.Stage = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(saved.Stage) or 0), 0, 5)
				record.Essence = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(saved.Essence) or 0))
				record.EssenceTotal = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(saved.EssenceTotal) or 0))
				record.Manifested = saved.Manifested ~= false
				record.Kills = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(saved.Kills) or 0))
			end
			data[player.UserId] = record
			shields[player.UserId] = SHIELD_MAX[record.Stage]
			return
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	data[player.UserId] = defaultData()
end
