-- ---------- the rig: server-built spectral parts ----------------------
local function addPart(parts, name, size, offset, color, transparency, material, shape)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.Neon
	part.Transparency = transparency
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	if shape then part.Shape = shape end
	table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Offset = offset })
	return part
end

local function buildRig(player)
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	destroyRig(player)
	if not record or record.Stage == 0 or not record.Manifested then return end
	local stage = record.Stage
	local colors = resolveColors(player)
	local design = resolveDesign(player)
	local s = stage >= 5 and 1.45 or stage >= 4 and 1.25 or 1
	local P, E, A, T = colors.Primary, colors.Energy, colors.Accent, colors.BodyTransparency
	local parts = {}
	local function V(x, y, z) return Vector3.new(x * s, y * s, z * s) end
	local function C(x, y, z, rx, ry, rz)
		return CFrame.new(V(x, y, z)) * CFrame.Angles(rx or 0, ry or 0, rz or 0)
	end
	-- Stage 1+: the frame of arcs around its Keeper.
	addPart(parts, "Spine", V(0.7, 5.4, 0.7), C(0, 2.2, 1.3), P, T)
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local y = 3.6 - (i - 1) * 0.55
		addPart(parts, "ArcL" .. i, V(2.6 - i * 0.22, 0.34, 0.34), C(-0.95, y, 0.95, 0, 0, -0.35), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArcR" .. i, V(2.6 - i * 0.22, 0.34, 0.34), C(0.95, y, 0.95, 0, 0, 0.35), P, T)
	end
	local core = addPart(parts, "Core", V(1.15, 1.15, 1.15), C(0, 2.7, 1.0), E, 0.12, Enum.Material.Neon, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	if alignmentOf(player) == "Violet" or stage >= 4 then
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Color = E
		light.Range = 16
		light.Brightness = 1.4
		light.Parent = core
	end
	if stage >= 2 then
		addPart(parts, "ArmLU", V(0.6, 2.8, 0.6), C(-2.1, 3.3, 0.7, 0, 0, 0.45), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArmRU", V(0.6, 2.8, 0.6), C(2.1, 3.3, 0.7, 0, 0, -0.45), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArmLF", V(0.55, 2.4, 0.55), C(-2.9, 1.9, 0.4, 0, 0, 0.85), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "ArmRF", V(0.55, 2.4, 0.55), C(2.9, 1.9, 0.4, 0, 0, -0.85), P, T)
		-- The guardian's spectral Twin Spear: one long wood
		-- shaft and a great pointed crystal tip -- the player's
		-- own weapon, scaled to the guardian (Chapter 30).
		local styleF = WEAPON_STYLE_FACTORS[design.Style] or WEAPON_STYLE_FACTORS.SpearClassic
		local reveal = ({ [2] = 0.5, [3] = 0.8, [4] = 1.0, [5] = 1.25 })[stage] or 1
		addPart(parts, "SpearShaft", V(0.26, 5.4 * styleF.Shaft, 0.26), C(3.7, 2.4, -0.5, 0.35, 0, 0), design.Mat, T)
		addPart(parts, "SpearGuard", V(1.15, 0.22, 1.15), C(3.55, 4.6, -1.15), design.Color, 0.1)
		addPart(parts, "SpearTip", V(0.5 * styleF.Wide, 2.6 * reveal * styleF.Tip, 0.5 * styleF.Wide), C(3.45, 5.6, -1.9, -0.5, 0, 0), design.Color, 0.1)
	end
	if stage >= 3 then
		addPart(parts, "Pelvis", V(2.3, 0.8, 0.95), C(0, 0.1, 1.15), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "LegL", V(0.72, 2.8, 0.72), C(-0.8, -1.5, 1.15), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "LegR", V(0.72, 2.8, 0.72), C(0.8, -1.5, 1.15), P, T)
		addPart(parts, "PauldronL", V(1.1, 0.6, 1.1), C(-1.6, 4.15, 0.9), A, T)
		addPart(parts, "PauldronR", V(1.1, 0.6, 1.1), C(1.6, 4.15, 0.9), A, T)
		addPart(parts, "Head", V(1.5, 1.6, 1.5), C(0, 5.6, 1.05), P, T)

local absorbing = {}
local lastHealth = {}

local function hookShield(player, character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	lastHealth[player.UserId] = humanoid.Health
	humanoid.HealthChanged:Connect(function(newHealth)
		local previous = lastHealth[player.UserId] or newHealth
		lastHealth[player.UserId] = newHealth
		if absorbing[player.UserId] then return end
		local record = data[player.UserId]
		if not record or record.Stage == 0 or not record.Manifested then return end
		if newHealth >= previous or newHealth <= 0 then return end
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if inArena(root) then return end -- the guardian will not fight Keepers
		local shield = shields[player.UserId] or 0
		if shield <= 0 then return end
		local absorbed = math.min(shield, previous - newHealth)
		shields[player.UserId] = shield - absorbed
		absorbing[player.UserId] = true
		humanoid.Health = newHealth + absorbed
		lastHealth[player.UserId] = humanoid.Health
		absorbing[player.UserId] = nil
	end)
end

	record.Essence = record.Essence + amount

	dirty[player.UserId] = true
end

local function eligibleStage(lifetime, essenceTotal)
	local stage = 0
	for i, spec in ipairs(STAGES) do
		if lifetime >= spec.Lifetime and essenceTotal >= spec.Essence then
			stage = i - 1
		end
	end
	return stage
end

-- ---------- the condensed form (Chapter 32, Script 39) -------------
-- For the TWINS only, the Susanoo has two states of one being:
-- EXPANDED (this Script's spectral rig) and CONDENSED (the crystal
-- bear spirit form Script 39 builds). Script 39 is the only caller.
-- Condensed suppresses the rig and the shield alike -- the bear's
-- body takes the hits a spectral form would have absorbed, and it
-- has its own (physical) presence instead. Non-twins are refused:
-- their Susanoo has one state, spectral, as Chapter 30 describes.
local function isTwin(player)
	return (TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID)
		or (TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID)
end

function _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, form)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	if not isTwin(player) then return false end
	local record = data[player.UserId]
	if not record or record.Stage < 2 then return false end
	if form == "Condensed" then
		record.Manifested = false
		destroyRig(player)
		player:SetAttribute("SusanooForm", "Condensed")
	elseif form == "Expanded" then
		record.Manifested = true
		buildRig(player)
		player:SetAttribute("SusanooForm", "Expanded")
	else
		return false
	end
	dirty[player.UserId] = true
	return true
end

	if lastToggle[player.UserId] and now - lastToggle[player.UserId] < 1 then return end

	local record = data[player.UserId]

	if player:GetAttribute("SusanooForm") == "Condensed" then return end

-- KIMONO-FIRST (Chapter 31): the kimono is the BASE look of
-- this game -- every player spawns wearing one. Two base styles
-- are always owned and never sold: GrovePurple (deep purple
-- robe, white trim -- his default palette) and GroveWhite
-- (white robe, purple trim -- hers). Battle armor is an
-- equipable LAYER worn over the kimono (Script 33's creator
-- pieces and the Armor toggle), never the base. Two premium
-- Game Pass variants -- Blossom (cherry blossom pink, jade
-- trim) and Violet (deep violet, silver trim) -- are sold as
-- pure cosmetics. Worn only in non-combat areas; the Arena
-- warden equips the armor layer automatically.
--
-- THE RULES THIS SCRIPT ENFORCES ON THE SERVER:
-- * Ownership is a Roblox fact, never a client claim: passes are
--   checked with UserOwnsGamePassAsync on join and re-checked at
--   every toggle. A pass ID left at 0 disables that style.
-- * A kimono is casual wear. It cannot be worn inside the
--   Blossom Arena (the same geometric check Script 2 uses), it
--   stows the Twin Spear in the Backpack while worn, and a
--   2-second warden reverts any wearer who walks into the Arena
--   still dressed for the village.
-- * Her spirit form form owns her character completely: while
--   IsJadeSpirit is set, this Script builds nothing on her.
-- * The kimono is built from server constants (the STYLES table)
--   as parts named JadeKimono_*. The client sends a style ID and
--   nothing else -- no colours, no parts, no asset IDs.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Paste the two Game Pass IDs from the Creator Dashboard
-- (Chapter 31, setup steps). 0 = that style stays disabled.
local PASSES = {
	Blossom = 0, -- << Blossom Kimono pass ID
	Violet = 0,  -- << Violet Kimono pass ID
}
-- Base kimonos: no pass exists for these and none ever will --
-- ownership is constant true, granted by this table alone.
local BASE_STYLES = { GrovePurple = true, GroveWhite = true }

local STYLES = {
	GrovePurple = {
		Label = "Grove Kimono — Purple",
		Robe = Color3.fromRGB(78, 52, 160),    -- deep purple
		Trim = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),  -- white accents
		Obi = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245),   -- white sash
	},
	GroveWhite = {
		Label = "Grove Kimono — White",
		Robe = Color3.fromRGB(240, 238, 242),  -- white
		Trim = Color3.fromRGB(120, 80, 200),   -- purple accents
		Obi = Color3.fromRGB(78, 52, 160),     -- deep purple sash
	},
	Blossom = {
		Label = "Blossom Kimono",
		Robe = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 205),  -- cherry blossom pink
		Trim = Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165),   -- jade accents
		Obi = Color3.fromRGB(46, 125, 100),    -- deep jade sash
	},
	Violet = {
		Label = "Violet Kimono",
		Robe = Color3.fromRGB(78, 52, 160),    -- deep violet
		Trim = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215),  -- silver accents
		Obi = Color3.fromRGB(150, 155, 170),   -- brushed silver sash
	},
}

local owns = {} -- [UserId] = { Blossom = bool, Violet = bool }

local function refreshOwnership(player)
	local record = owns[player.UserId] or {}
	for style in pairs(BASE_STYLES) do record[style] = true end
	for style, passId in pairs(PASSES) do
		if passId ~= 0 then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, passId)
			end)
			if ok then record[style] = result == true end
		else
			record[style] = false
		end
	end
	owns[player.UserId] = record
	return record
end

local function inArena(root)
	local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaCenter")
	if not center or not center:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
	local offset = root.Position - center.Position
	return math.sqrt(offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z) <= 55
		and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 25
end

local function makePart(name, size, color)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end

local function weldTo(part, target, offset)
	part.CFrame = target.CFrame * offset
	part.Parent = target.Parent
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = part
	weld.Part1 = target
	weld.Parent = part
end

local function clearKimono(character)
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 11) == "JadeKimono_" then child:Destroy() end
	end
end

local function wearKimono(player, style)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local torso = character and (character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not torso then return false end
	if character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then return false end
	if inArena(root) then return false end
	local s = STYLES[style]
	clearKimono(character)
	-- Robe body over the torso, skirt over the hips.
	weldTo(makePart("JadeKimono_Robe", Vector3.new(1.7, 1.9, 1.0), s.Robe), torso, CFrame.new(0, 0.1, 0))

			Vector3.new(0.22, 1.15, 0.08), s.Trim)

			* CFrame.Angles(0, 0, side * math.rad(28)))
	end
	-- Obi sash at the waist, with the bow/knot at the front.
	weldTo(makePart("JadeKimono_Obi", Vector3.new(1.78, 0.42, 1.08), s.Obi), torso, CFrame.new(0, -0.62, 0))
	weldTo(makePart("JadeKimono_ObiKnot", Vector3.new(0.55, 0.4, 0.16), s.Trim), torso, CFrame.new(0, -0.62, -0.6))
	-- Wide sleeves on both arms -- the kimono silhouette.
	for _, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
		local arm = character:FindFirstChild(side .. "UpperArm") or character:FindFirstChild(side .. " Arm")

				arm, CFrame.new(0, -1.2, 0))
		end
	end
	-- Casual means unarmed: the spear rests in the Backpack.
	humanoid:UnequipTools()
	player:SetAttribute("WearingKimono", style)
	return true

-- What it does: THE DAEMON PET -- the condensed Susanoo
-- (Chapter 32). A player's Susanoo has two states of one being:
--
-- * CONDENSED -- the DAEMON PET: the spectral form compacted
--   into a rideable, flyable crystal BEAR. No wood, no armor,
--   no mask, no cloak, no horns -- the Daemon is not a separate
--   creature, it is the Susanoo itself, folded, and the power
--   of the great weapon lives in its gold claws.
-- * TWO FORMS, ONE DAEMON (the Workbench's DaemonForm choice,
--   Script 33): FormSolid -- a solid LIVING crystal beast, the
--   default: full crystal body, head, legs, gold trim. Or
--   FormSkeleton -- the crystal SKELETON bear of the four-colour
--   lineup: crystal skull with GOLD TEETH, rib arcs, spine, and
--   gold claws. Form is aesthetic only -- same stats, seats,
--   flight, stamina, and Mount Chain in either shape.
-- * THE LINEUP (Chapter 32): four Daemon colours. His signature
--   Daemon is PURPLE (violet crystal, glowing purple eyes and
--   claws); hers is PINK/JADE (pale jade bone, pink eyes, pink
--   crystal claws) -- the twins' signatures, decided by UserId
--   below. GREEN and BLUE are player variants: earned/unlocked
--   in play and granted server-side through _G.JadeUnlockDaemon
--   (persisted under the player's UserId), never bought.
-- * EXPANDED -- the same being unfolded back into the giant
--   spectral Susanoo of Script 35, standing around its keeper.
--
-- THE TOGGLE (one RemoteEvent, no arguments, server decides):
-- * Condense/Expand requests arrive on JadeBearTransform. The
--   server re-checks EVERYTHING per call: the player HAS a Daemon
--   (twin signature or an unlocked variant), Susanoo Stage >= 2
--   (Script 35's published
--   SusanooStage attribute), a living character, and the 6 s
--   transform cooldown.
-- * EXPANSION REQUIRES THE DISMOUNT: if the twin is still in the
--   RiderSeat, the request is refused. The bear unfolds around a
--   standing guardian, never around a seated one -- and a
--   passenger must be off as well.
-- * While CONDENSED, Script 35's spectral rig is suppressed via
--   _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, "Condensed"); on expansion this
--   Script calls it with "Expanded" and Script 35 rebuilds the
--   giant. There is only ever ONE form in the world: bear XOR
--   spectral, enforced here, in one place.
--
-- RIDING, SPEED, AND THE MOUNT CHAIN:
-- * RiderSeat is a VehicleSeat: throttle/steer drive the bear.
--   PassengerSeat behind it carries any one other player (co-op).
-- * Bear speed and turning come from the STAGE table below --
--   the bear IS the Susanoo, so it grows exactly when the
--   Susanoo grows (Chapter 30 stages, no separate XP track):
--   faster top speed, tighter turning, harder claws per stage.
--   Sprint (Script 40 sends it; the server validates the sender
--   is the seated rider) multiplies speed 1.45x on a stamina pool.
-- * MOUNT CHAIN: Script 2 calls _G.JadeDaemonThrust on every
--   connecting thrust. If the owner is mounted (or within 12
--   studs of the Daemon), the Daemon answers with a claw swipe
--   0.25 s later at the nearest husk within 9 studs. A swipe
--   landing inside MOUNT_WINDOW of the thrust extends the Mount
--   Chain; every 5 chain links grant +5 SPENDABLE thrusts through
--   Script 13's JadeGrantBonus (Spend Balance only, once per
--   chain at each multiple of 5 -- Lifetime is never touched).
--   Daemon damage hits husks and corruption only, never players,
--   and stamps the same "creator" tag pattern Script 2 uses, so
--   a Daemon-freed husk pays its owner exactly like a thrust-
--   freed one -- and never twice (Script 4's paid latch).
-- * FLIGHT (Stage 3+, when the Susanoo has wings): hold Fly
--   (Script 40) while riding and the Daemon unfolds its crystal
--   flight wings -- built in the player's designed wing colour
--   (weapon + wings are the design atoms; the Daemon's wings ARE
--   the player's wings, folded) -- and climbs. Flight drains the
--   same stamina pool as sprint; release Fly and it glides down.
-- * COMBO-TO-MOVE (the Daemon Stride): the Mount Chain IS a
--   movement system. Every 2nd chain link fires a STRIDE DASH

-- Chapter 33 hook: Script 41 (Showcase) reads the live Daemon
-- model through here; it never builds or destroys a Daemon.
-- NOTE (GoldDragon): Oakley's model is built to the dragon spec
-- in Chapter 32 -- serpentine gold segment body, dragon head
-- (horns, whiskers, mane), four gold-clawed legs, tufted tail --
-- using this same builder's part/place/seat/flight scaffolding,
-- with daemonForm forced to "FormDragon" for her kind below.
local function daemonKind(player)
	-- HERS FIRST: the Gold Japanese Dragon (GoldDragon) belongs
	-- to the daughter alone, by UserId, exactly like Script 8's
	-- lock on the Green Jade Skeleton. No unlock, purchase, or
	-- Workbench choice can produce this branch for anyone else.
	if TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID then return "GoldDragon" end
	-- Her brother's Daemon is the blue crystal.
	if TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID then return "Blue" end
	-- Then a player's earned (Green/Blue) or purchased (Pink)
	-- variant, if one is on record; every keeper's starter Daemon
	-- is the green crystal, so no keeper is ever Daemon-less.
	return unlockedVariant[player.UserId] or "Green"
end
-- Backwards-compatible alias: older comments and hooks say "twin".
local twinKind = daemonKind

-- The ONLY door to a player Daemon variant: server scripts call
-- this when a variant is earned or unlocked in play (quest,
-- arena, Grove milestone). Validates, persists per UserId, and
-- wakes the new Daemon beside a Stage 2+ player.
function _G.JadeUnlockDaemon(player, variant)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	if variant ~= "Green" and variant ~= "Blue" and variant ~= "Pink" then return false end
	unlockedVariant[player.UserId] = variant
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonVariant", variant)
	pcall(function()
		variantStore:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, variant)
	end)
	return true
end

local state = {} -- [UserId] = { Form, Bear, RiderSeat, PassengerSeat, Chain, LastThrust, LastBonusChain, Sprint, Fly, Flying, Stamina, LastTransform, Busy, LastStrideLink }

local function stageOf(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("SusanooStage") or 0
end

local function statsFor(player)
	return STAGE_STATS[math.clamp(stageOf(player), MIN_STAGE, 5)] or STAGE_STATS[2]
end

local function pushUpdate(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return end
	updateEvent:FireClient(player, {
		Form = st.Form, Chain = st.Chain or 0,
		Resonance = math.floor(math.max(0, (st.Resonance or 0)
			- (st.ResonanceT and (os.clock() - st.ResonanceT) * 6 or 0))),
		Stamina = math.floor(st.Stamina or STAMINA_MAX),
		Mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil,
		Flying = st.Flying == true,
		Stage = stageOf(player),
	})
end

-- ---------- the Daemon: a solid LIVING BEAR of pure crystal --------
-- FINAL DESIGN (Chapter 32): the condensed Susanoo is a complete,
-- living bear built from solid crystal in the Daemon's colour,
-- with GOLD accents throughout -- gold claws, a gold collar and
-- saddle trim, gold nose and tail tip. No wood, no bone, nothing
-- hollow: a crystal beast, warm with the guardian's light, solid
-- enough to ride and strong enough to fly. The element mapping
-- is one-to-one with the spectral form: the Susanoo's frame of
-- arcs is the bear's solid body; its head is the bear's head;
-- and the power of its great weapon lives in the gold claws.
local ELEMENT_ORDER = { "Body", "Chest", "Neck", "Head", "Skull", "EarL", "EarR",
	"UpperLegFL", "UpperLegFR", "UpperLegBL", "UpperLegBR",
	"LowerLegFL", "LowerLegFR", "LowerLegBL", "LowerLegBR",
	"FrontClawsL", "FrontClawsR", "Tail", "CollarGold" }

local GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(217, 164, 65)

local function buildBear(player, kind)
	local pal = PALETTES[kind]
	local stats = statsFor(player)
	-- Workbench styling (Script 33 attributes): every player's
	-- Daemon is designed -- colour, crystal finish, scale, glow,
	-- claws, accessory. Signature crystal colour stays with the
	-- twins; all other choices apply to every Daemon.
	local isSignature = kind == "GoldDragon" or kind == "Blue"
	local crystalColor = pal.Crystal
	if not isSignature then
		crystalColor = CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonColor")] or pal.Crystal
	end
	local daemonForm = player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonForm") or "FormSolid"
	if kind == "GoldDragon" then daemonForm = "FormDragon" end -- hers is a dragon, never a bear form
	-- The SKELETON form is a standard skeleton-bear variant: it
	-- builds for any keeper who owns the Daemon Design Package
	-- (OwnsDaemonDesignPack). It is not Oakley's form -- hers is
	-- FormDragon, forced above. Any other claim builds solid.
	if daemonForm == "FormSkeleton" and player:GetAttribute("OwnsDaemonDesignPack") ~= true then
		daemonForm = "FormSolid"
	end
	local glowColor = CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonGlow")] or pal.Glow
	local clawColor = GOLD -- Daemon claws are gold, by design, for every Daemon
	local crystalMaterial = DAEMON_MATERIALS[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonMaterial")] or Enum.Material.Glass
	local wingColor = CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingColor")] or crystalColor
	local accessory = player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonAccessory") or "AccNone"
	local s = stats.Scale * (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonScale")) or 1)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	if kind == "GoldDragon" then model:SetAttribute("CanonicalDaemon", true) end
	model.Name = kind == "GoldDragon" and "GoldDragonDaemon" or (kind .. "DaemonBear")

	local function part(name, size, color, material)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = material or crystalMaterial
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.Massless = true
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	-- the root is a solid crystal block at the hips
	local root = part("HumanoidRootPart", Vector3.new(2.2, 1.6, 2.4) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	root.CanCollide = true
	root.Massless = false
	if daemonForm == "FormDragon" then
		-- GOLD JAPANESE DRAGON form (Oakley alone): serpentine
		-- gold segment body, elegant dragon head, horns, whiskers,
		-- mane, four gold-clawed legs, tufted tail. No bear parts,
		-- no skeleton parts, no flight wings -- she swims the air.
		for i = 1, 6 do part("DragonSeg" .. i, Vector3.new(2.0, 1.8, 1.6) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal) end
		part("DragonHead", Vector3.new(2.2, 1.9, 2.3) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("DragonSnout", Vector3.new(1.3, 0.9, 1.2) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("HornL", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.6, 0.4) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("HornR", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.6, 0.4) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("WhiskerL", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.18, 0.18) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("WhiskerR", Vector3.new(1.5, 0.18, 0.18) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("Mane", Vector3.new(1.7, 2.0, 0.7) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("EyeL", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.2) * s, glowColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
		part("EyeR", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.2) * s, glowColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
		for _, leg in ipairs({ "FL", "FR", "BL", "BR" }) do
			part("UpperLeg" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.6, 1.6, 0.6) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
			part("LowerLeg" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.5, 1.4, 0.5) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
			part("Paw" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.95, 0.42, 1.2) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		end
		part("FrontClawsL", Vector3.new(1.0, 1.3, 0.45) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("FrontClawsR", Vector3.new(1.0, 1.3, 0.45) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("TailFin", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.1, 0.5) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	elseif daemonForm == "FormSkeleton" then
		-- CRYSTAL SKELETON form: skull, gold teeth, rib arcs,
		-- spine, pelvis, long leg bones, gold claws -- the
		-- four-colour lineup bear, at rideable scale.
		part("Skull", Vector3.new(2.5, 2.2, 2.4) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		part("Jaw", Vector3.new(1.8, 0.5, 2.0) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		part("TeethGold", Vector3.new(1.35, 0.35, 0.3) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("EarL", Vector3.new(0.8, 0.9, 0.35) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		part("EarR", Vector3.new(0.8, 0.9, 0.35) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		part("EyeL", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.2) * s, glowColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
		part("EyeR", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.2) * s, glowColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
		for i = 1, 3 do part("Spine" .. i, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.65, 0.8) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial) end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			part("Rib" .. i, Vector3.new(0.32, 2.3 - (i - 1) * 0.2, 0.32) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
			part("Rib" .. i .. "R", Vector3.new(0.32, 2.3 - (i - 1) * 0.2, 0.32) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
			part("Rib" .. i .. "Top", Vector3.new(2.3 - (i - 1) * 0.2, 0.32, 0.32) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		end
		part("Pelvis", Vector3.new(2.3, 1.1, 1.7) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		for _, leg in ipairs({ "FL", "FR", "BL", "BR" }) do
			part("UpperLeg" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.46, 2.0, 0.46) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
			part("LowerLeg" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.38, 1.85, 0.38) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
			part("Paw" .. leg, Vector3.new(1.0, 0.45, 1.3) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		end
		part("FrontClawsL", Vector3.new(1.1, 1.5, 0.5) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("FrontClawsR", Vector3.new(1.1, 1.5, 0.5) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
		part("Tail", Vector3.new(0.4, 1.1, 0.4) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	else
	part("Body", Vector3.new(3.2, 2.7, 4.4) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("Chest", Vector3.new(3.3, 2.8, 1.6) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("Neck", Vector3.new(1.9, 1.7, 1.4) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("Head", Vector3.new(2.3, 2.0, 2.2) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("Muzzle", Vector3.new(1.4, 0.95, 1.1) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("NoseGold", Vector3.new(0.62, 0.4, 0.3) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	part("EarL", Vector3.new(0.75, 0.85, 0.35) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("EarR", Vector3.new(0.75, 0.85, 0.35) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("EyeL", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.2) * s, glowColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
	part("EyeR", Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 0.2) * s, glowColor, Enum.Material.Neon)
	part("CollarGold", Vector3.new(2.15, 0.5, 2.15) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	for _, leg in ipairs({ "FL", "FR", "BL", "BR" }) do
		part("UpperLeg" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.95, 1.9, 0.95) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		part("LowerLeg" .. leg, Vector3.new(0.8, 1.7, 0.8) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
		part("Paw" .. leg, Vector3.new(1.05, 0.5, 1.35) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	end
	-- GOLD claws on the front paws -- the Daemon's weapon
	part("FrontClawsL", Vector3.new(1.1, 1.5, 0.5) * s, clawColor, Enum.Material.Metal)
	part("FrontClawsR", Vector3.new(1.1, 1.5, 0.5) * s, clawColor, Enum.Material.Metal)
	part("Tail", Vector3.new(0.55, 1.5, 0.55) * s, crystalColor, crystalMaterial)
	part("TailTipGold", Vector3.new(0.6, 0.5, 0.6) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	part("SaddleTrimGold", Vector3.new(2.4, 0.35, 2.2) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	-- Flight wings: the player's designed wings, folded into the
	-- Daemon. Crystal, gold-edged; hidden until flight unfolds them.
	local wingL = part("FlightWingL", Vector3.new(2.6, 0.35, 1.1) * s, wingColor, Enum.Material.Glass)
	wingL.Transparency = 1
	local wingR = part("FlightWingR", Vector3.new(2.6, 0.35, 1.1) * s, wingColor, Enum.Material.Glass)
	wingR.Transparency = 1
	-- The one designed accessory, if any.
	if accessory == "AccGoldTeeth" then
		part("GoldTeeth", Vector3.new(1.3, 0.35, 0.3) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	elseif accessory == "AccMoss" then
		part("MossPatch", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.3, 1.6) * s, Color3.fromRGB(96, 160, 90), Enum.Material.Grass)
	elseif accessory == "AccBlossomCollar" then
		part("BlossomCollar", Vector3.new(2.5, 0.4, 2.5) * s, Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203), Enum.Material.Neon)
	elseif accessory == "AccStarBell" then
		part("StarBell", Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.55) * s, GOLD, Enum.Material.Metal)
	end
	end -- (form branch: skeleton parts above, solid parts here)
	-- Flight wings belong to BOTH forms: if the solid branch did
	-- not build them (skeleton form), build them now.
	if daemonForm ~= "FormDragon" and not model:FindFirstChild("FlightWingL") then
		local swl = part("FlightWingL", Vector3.new(2.6, 0.35, 1.1) * s, wingColor, Enum.Material.Glass)
		swl.Transparency = 1
		local swr = part("FlightWingR", Vector3.new(2.6, 0.35, 1.1) * s, wingColor, Enum.Material.Glass)
		swr.Transparency = 1
	end
	if daemonForm == "FormSkeleton" and accessory == "AccMoss" then
		part("MossPatch", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.3, 1.6) * s, Color3.fromRGB(96, 160, 90), Enum.Material.Grass)
	end
	local riderSeat = Instance.new("VehicleSeat")
	riderSeat.Name = "RiderSeat"
	riderSeat.Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.4, 1.8) * s
	riderSeat.Color = pal.Seat
	riderSeat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	riderSeat.MaxSpeed = 0 -- the Daemon's legs are the engine, not the seat
	riderSeat.Torque = 0
	riderSeat.Parent = model
	local passengerSeat = Instance.new("Seat")
	passengerSeat.Name = "PassengerSeat"
	passengerSeat.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 0.4, 1.6) * s
	passengerSeat.Color = pal.Seat
	passengerSeat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	passengerSeat.Parent = model

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.DisplayName = kind .. " Daemon — Susanoo, Condensed"
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = stats.Speed
	humanoid.MaxHealth = 100000 -- set dressing: the Daemon is a form, not a target
	humanoid.Health = 100000
	humanoid.Parent = model

	local function place(p, x, y, z, rx, ry, rz)
		p.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(x * s, y * s, z * s)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rx or 0), math.rad(ry or 0), math.rad(rz or 0))
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = root
		weld.Part1 = p
		weld.Parent = p
	end
	local char = player.Character
	local spawnAt = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	if spawnAt then
		root.CFrame = spawnAt.CFrame * CFrame.new((kind == "GoldDragon") and 5 or -5, 2.5, 0)
	end
	model.Parent = workspace
	if daemonForm == "FormDragon" then
		for i = 1, 6 do place(model["DragonSeg" .. i], 0, 0.3 + (i % 2) * 0.35, -2.2 + i * 0.85, (i % 2) * 10 - 5, 0, 0) end
		place(model.DragonHead, 0, 2.1, -3.6)
		place(model.DragonSnout, 0, 1.75, -4.8)
		place(model.HornL, -0.7, 3.3, -3.4, -18, 0, -12) place(model.HornR, 0.7, 3.3, -3.4, -18, 0, 12)
		place(model.WhiskerL, -1.5, 1.7, -5.0, 0, 24, 0) place(model.WhiskerR, 1.5, 1.7, -5.0, 0, -24, 0)
		place(model.Mane, 0, 2.4, -2.85, -14, 0, 0)
		place(model.EyeL, -0.55, 2.3, -4.68) place(model.EyeR, 0.55, 2.3, -4.68)
		place(model.UpperLegFL, -0.95, -0.7, -2.2, 6, 0, 0) place(model.UpperLegFR, 0.95, -0.7, -2.2, 6, 0, 0)
		place(model.UpperLegBL, -0.95, -0.7, 1.4, -6, 0, 0) place(model.UpperLegBR, 0.95, -0.7, 1.4, -6, 0, 0)
		place(model.LowerLegFL, -0.95, -2.0, -2.35) place(model.LowerLegFR, 0.95, -2.0, -2.35)
		place(model.LowerLegBL, -0.95, -2.0, 1.55) place(model.LowerLegBR, 0.95, -2.0, 1.55)
		place(model.PawFL, -0.95, -2.85, -2.5) place(model.PawFR, 0.95, -2.85, -2.5)
		place(model.PawBL, -0.95, -2.85, 1.4) place(model.PawBR, 0.95, -2.85, 1.4)
		place(model.FrontClawsL, -0.95, -2.6, -3.4, 32, 0, 0)
		place(model.FrontClawsR, 0.95, -2.6, -3.4, 32, 0, 0)

		place(model.TeethGold, 0, 1.12, -5.3)
		place(model.EarL, -0.95, 3.05, -3.7) place(model.EarR, 0.95, 3.05, -3.7)
		place(model.EyeL, -0.55, 2.05, -5.02) place(model.EyeR, 0.55, 2.05, -5.02)
		for i = 1, 3 do place(model["Spine" .. i], 0, 0.6, -0.6 - i * 0.6) end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local z = -1.15 - i * 0.6
			place(model["Rib" .. i], -1.12, -0.3, z, 0, 0, 10)
			place(model["Rib" .. i .. "R"], 1.12, -0.3, z, 0, 0, -10)
			place(model["Rib" .. i .. "Top"], 0, 0.82, z)
		end
		place(model.Pelvis, 0, 0, 0.9)
		place(model.UpperLegFL, -1.05, -0.85, -2.6, 8, 0, 0) place(model.UpperLegFR, 1.05, -0.85, -2.6, 8, 0, 0)

	place(model.PawBL, -1.15, -3.3, 1.45) place(model.PawBR, 1.15, -3.3, 1.45)
	place(model.FrontClawsL, -1.15, -3.15, -3.05, 32, 0, 0)
	place(model.FrontClawsR, 1.15, -3.15, -3.05, 32, 0, 0)
	place(model.Tail, 0, 0.85, 2.85, -32, 0, 0)
	place(model.TailTipGold, 0, 1.5, 3.3, -32, 0, 0)
	place(model.SaddleTrimGold, 0, 1.78, -0.35)
	end -- (form branch: placements)
	if model:FindFirstChild("FlightWingL") then place(model.FlightWingL, -2.1, 1.5, -0.6, 0, 0, 24) end
	if model:FindFirstChild("FlightWingR") then place(model.FlightWingR, 2.1, 1.5, -0.6, 0, 0, -24) end
	if model:FindFirstChild("GoldTeeth") then place(model.GoldTeeth, 0, 1.25, -5.15) end
	if model:FindFirstChild("MossPatch") then place(model.MossPatch, 0.8, 1.85, 0.4, 0, 0, 8) end
	if model:FindFirstChild("BlossomCollar") then place(model.BlossomCollar, 0, 1.0, -2.85, -18, 0, 0) end
	if model:FindFirstChild("StarBell") then place(model.StarBell, 0, 0.55, -2.95) end
	riderSeat.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.0 * s, -0.35 * s)
	local rw = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); rw.Part0 = root; rw.Part1 = riderSeat; rw.Parent = riderSeat
	passengerSeat.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.8 * s, 1.15 * s)
	local pw = Instance.new("WeldConstraint"); pw.Part0 = root; pw.Part1 = passengerSeat; pw.Parent = passengerSeat
	-- Flight: a LinearVelocity the drive loop arms only while the
	-- rider holds Fly at Stage 3+ (MaxForce 0 = grounded).
	local flightAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")

	flight.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	flight.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World

	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "MountPrompt"
	prompt.ActionText = "Ride"

	return model, riderSeat, passengerSeat, prompt
end

-- ---------- combo-to-move: the Daemon Stride ---------------------------
-- Alternating weapon thrusts and Daemon swipes does not only
-- fight -- it MOVES. Link 2 (and every even link): STRIDE DASH, a
-- forward burst. Link 3 (and every multiple of 3): WING LAUNCH,
-- an upward burst. Mounted, the bursts move the coupled unit
-- (Daemon + rider as one); on foot they move the player, with
-- the Daemon answering beside them. One burst per link number.
local function strideBurst(player, st, kind)
	local mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil
	local root
	if mounted then
		root = st.Bear and st.Bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	else
		local char = player.Character
		root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	if not root then return end
	local facing = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local velocity = flat.Unit * (kind == "Launch" and 10 or 34)
		+ Vector3.new(0, kind == "Launch" and 30 or 4, 0)
	if mounted and kind == "Dash" then velocity *= 1.3 end -- coupled momentum
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Parent = root
	local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	lv.Attachment0 = att
	lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	lv.VectorVelocity = velocity
	lv.MaxForce = 200000
	lv.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(lv, 0.22)
	Debris:AddItem(att, 0.25)
end

-- ---------- Daemon combat: the claw answers the thrust ----------------
local function tagCreator(huskHumanoid, player)
	local tag = huskHumanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	if not tag then
		tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tag.Name = "creator"
		tag.Parent = huskHumanoid
	end
	tag.Value = player
	Debris:AddItem(tag, 5)
end

local function bearSwipe(player, st)
	local bear = st.Bear
	if not bear or st.Form ~= "Bear" then return end
	local root = bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local stats = statsFor(player)
	local best, bestDist = nil, 9
	for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Humanoid") and enemy:GetAttribute("IsThornHusk") and enemy.Health > 0 then
			local eRoot = enemy.Parent and enemy.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if eRoot then
				local d = (eRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = enemy, d end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return end
	-- the chain: a landing swipe inside the window extends it
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastThrust or 0) <= MOUNT_WINDOW then
		st.Chain = (st.Chain or 0) + 1
		if st.Chain ~= st.LastStrideLink then
			st.LastStrideLink = st.Chain
			if st.Chain % 3 == 0 then strideBurst(player, st, "Launch")
			elseif st.Chain % 2 == 0 then strideBurst(player, st, "Dash") end
		end
		if st.Chain % 5 == 0 and st.Chain ~= st.LastBonusChain then
			st.LastBonusChain = st.Chain
			if _G.JadeGrantBonus then _G.JadeGrantBonus(player, 5, "MountChain") end
		end
	else
		st.Chain = 1
	end
	tagCreator(best, player)
	best:TakeDamage(stats.Claw)
	pushUpdate(player)
end

-- Called by Script 2 on EVERY connecting thrust (any player; this
-- function itself decides whether a Daemon answers).
function _G.JadeDaemonThrust(player, stage)
	local st = player and state[player.UserId]
	if st then
		-- RESONANCE (the partnership sync): every connecting thrust
		-- raises keeper-Daemon sync by 8, capped at 100, decaying
		-- 6 per second. It builds in ANY form -- keeper and Daemon
		-- acting together is the bond -- and is spent only in
		-- Weapon form, by _G.JadeDaemonSurge below.
		local nowR = os.clock()
		local r = st.Resonance or 0
		if st.ResonanceT then r = math.max(0, r - (nowR - st.ResonanceT) * 6) end
		st.Resonance = math.min(100, r + 8)
		st.ResonanceT = nowR
	end
	if not st or st.Form ~= "Bear" or not st.Bear then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local bearRoot = st.Bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not bearRoot then return end
	local mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil
		and st.RiderSeat.Occupant.Parent == char
	if not mounted and (root.Position - bearRoot.Position).Magnitude > COMBO_NEAR then return end
	st.LastThrust = os.clock()
	if mounted then
		-- COUPLING: rider and Daemon are one unit. The Daemon's
		-- momentum amplifies every thrust (a forward surge that
		-- grows with the thrust stage), and a held turn while
		-- thrusting carves the unit around -- thrust-steering:
		-- the weapon's direction, amplified by the body.
		local facing = bearRoot.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
			att.Parent = bearRoot
			local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
			lv.Attachment0 = att
			lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
			lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
			lv.VectorVelocity = flat.Unit * (18 + 6 * (stage or 1))
			lv.MaxForce = 200000
			lv.Parent = bearRoot
			Debris:AddItem(lv, 0.18)
			Debris:AddItem(att, 0.2)
		end
		local steer = st.RiderSeat.Steer or 0
		if steer ~= 0 then
			bearRoot.CFrame = bearRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -steer * 0.35, 0)
		end
	end
	task.delay(0.25, function() bearSwipe(player, st) end)
end

-- ---------- form changes ----------------------------------------------
function _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	return st and st.Bear or nil
end

local function condense(player, animate)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	local kind = twinKind(player)
	if not st or not kind then return end
	if _G.JadeSetSusanooForm then _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, "Condensed") end
	local bear, riderSeat, passengerSeat, prompt = buildBear(player, kind)
	st.Bear, st.RiderSeat, st.PassengerSeat = bear, riderSeat, passengerSeat
	st.Form = "Bear"
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonCondensed", true)
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Bear")
	st.Chain, st.Stamina, st.Sprint = 0, STAMINA_MAX, false
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
		if who ~= player then return end
		if riderSeat.Occupant then
			local hum = who.Character and who.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and riderSeat.Occupant == hum then hum.Sit = false end
		else
			local hum = who.Character and who.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then riderSeat:Sit(hum) end
		end
	end)
	if animate then
		-- FOLD-IN: the giant's light pours down and the bear rises
		-- out of it -- parts fade IN element by element, body
		-- first, mask last, over TRANSFORM_SECONDS.
		task.spawn(function()
			local names = ELEMENT_ORDER
			for _, p in ipairs(bear:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then p.Transparency = 1 end
			end
			for i, name in ipairs(names) do
				local p = bear:FindFirstChild(name)
				if p then p.Transparency = 0 end
				task.wait(TRANSFORM_SECONDS / (#names + 4))
			end
			for _, p in ipairs(bear:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "FlightWingL" and p.Name ~= "FlightWingR" then
					p.Transparency = 0 -- flight wings stay folded until flight
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	pushUpdate(player)
end

local function expand(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or not st.Bear then return end
	local bear = st.Bear
	st.Bear, st.RiderSeat, st.PassengerSeat = nil, nil, nil
	st.Form = "Susanoo"
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Susanoo")
	st.Fly, st.Flying = false, false
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonCondensed", false)
	st.Chain = 0
	-- UNFOLD: the bear rears up and its elements lift OUT of the
	-- body in the order Script 35 will rebuild them -- frame,
	-- weapon ridge, wing, horns, mask -- fading as they rise over
	-- TRANSFORM_SECONDS; then the spectral rig takes over.
	task.spawn(function()
		local order = ELEMENT_ORDER
		for _, name in ipairs(order) do
			local p = bear:FindFirstChild(name)
			if p then
				p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0)
				p.Transparency = 0.45
			end
			task.wait(TRANSFORM_SECONDS / (#order + 4))
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(bear:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Transparency = 1 end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
		bear:Destroy()
		if _G.JadeSetSusanooForm then _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, "Expanded") end
		pushUpdate(player)
	end)
	pushUpdate(player)
end

-- ---------- the WEAPON form: the Daemon IS the spear --------------
-- The keeper's weapon and pet are one being. From BEAR form, with
-- the Twin Spear equipped and both seats empty, a transform folds
-- the Daemon INTO the spear: the bear pours into the crystal tip,
-- which takes the Daemon's colour and light (paintWeapon). Damage,
-- cooldowns, and counting do not change -- Script 2 never reads the
-- form -- so Weapon form is stance and spectacle: no mount, no
-- flight, no Mount Chain while the Daemon is the weapon. From
-- WEAPON form, a transform raises the Susanoo (the Daemon pours
-- back out); from SUSANOO, a transform condenses to the bear.
local savedTipColor = {}
local function paintWeapon(player, on)
	local char = player.Character
	local spear = (char and char:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear"))
		or player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") and player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
	if not spear then return end
	local tip = spear:FindFirstChild("Tip")
	if not tip then return end
	if on then
		savedTipColor[player.UserId] = tip.Color
		local glow = CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonGlow")]
			or CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonColor")]
			or Color3.fromRGB(185, 140, 255)
		tip.Color = glow
		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Name = "DaemonLight"
		light.Color = glow
		light.Range = 10
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = tip
	else
		local light = tip:FindFirstChild("DaemonLight")
		if light then light:Destroy() end
		if savedTipColor[player.UserId] then
			tip.Color = savedTipColor[player.UserId]
			savedTipColor[player.UserId] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function foldToWeapon(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or not st.Bear then return end
	local bear = st.Bear
	st.Bear, st.RiderSeat, st.PassengerSeat = nil, nil, nil
	st.Form = "Weapon"
	st.Fly, st.Flying = false, false
	st.Chain = 0
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Weapon")
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonWeaponForm", true)
	-- FOLD-IN, reversed: the bear's elements draw together and pour
	-- into the spear's tip over TRANSFORM_SECONDS, claws last.
	task.spawn(function()
		local order = ELEMENT_ORDER
		for i = #order, 1, -1 do
			local part = bear:FindFirstChild(order[i])
			if part then part.Transparency = 0.45 end
			task.wait(TRANSFORM_SECONDS / (#order + 4))
		end
		bear:Destroy()
	end)
	paintWeapon(player, true)
	pushUpdate(player)
end

local function unfoldFromWeapon(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return end
	paintWeapon(player, false)
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonWeaponForm", nil)
	st.Form = "Susanoo"
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Susanoo")
	if _G.JadeSetSusanooForm then _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, "Expanded") end
	pushUpdate(player)
end

-- Called by Script 2 before it damages a husk. At full sync in
-- WEAPON form, the Daemon surges through the spear: +25 damage
-- against that husk (husks and corruption only -- Script 2's player
-- paths never call this), and the sync falls to 40. Anywhere else,
-- or below full sync, it returns 0 and the thrust is a plain 25.
function _G.JadeDaemonSurge(player)
	local st = player and state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return 0 end
	local nowS = os.clock()
	local r = st.Resonance or 0
	if st.ResonanceT then r = math.max(0, r - (nowS - st.ResonanceT) * 6) end
	st.Resonance, st.ResonanceT = r, nowS
	if st.Form == "Weapon" and r >= 100 then
		st.Resonance = 40
		pushUpdate(player)
		return 25
	end
	return 0
end

function _G.JadeDaemonForm(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	return st and st.Form or "None"
end

transformEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or st.Busy then return end
	if not twinKind(player) then return end
	if stageOf(player) < MIN_STAGE then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastTransform or 0) < TRANSFORM_COOLDOWN then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	if st.Form == "Bear" then
		-- every form change requires the dismount -- both seats empty
		if st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant then return end
		if st.PassengerSeat and st.PassengerSeat.Occupant then return end
		st.LastTransform = now
		st.Busy = true
		-- spear in hand: the Daemon folds INTO the weapon. Spear
		-- stowed: the Daemon unfolds into the Susanoo.
		local charNow = player.Character
		if charNow and charNow:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear") then
			foldToWeapon(player)
		else
			expand(player)
		end
		task.delay(TRANSFORM_SECONDS + 0.4, function() st.Busy = false end)
	elseif st.Form == "Weapon" then
		st.LastTransform = now
		st.Busy = true
		unfoldFromWeapon(player)
		task.delay(TRANSFORM_SECONDS + 0.4, function() st.Busy = false end)
	elseif st.Form == "Susanoo" then
		st.LastTransform = now
		st.Busy = true
		condense(player, true)
		task.delay(TRANSFORM_SECONDS + 0.4, function() st.Busy = false end)
	end
end)

controlEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, payload)
	-- the ONLY client input: a sprint boolean, and only from the
	-- player actually sitting in the RiderSeat.
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or type(payload) ~= "table" then return end
	if st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant then
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and st.RiderSeat.Occupant == hum then
			st.Sprint = payload.Sprint == true
			st.Fly = payload.Fly == true
		end
	end
end)

-- ---------- driving & following ---------------------------------------
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			local st = state[player.UserId]
			if st and st.Form == "Bear" and st.Bear then
				local bear = st.Bear
				local bHum = bear:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local bRoot = bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if bHum and bRoot then
					local stats = statsFor(player)
					local riderHum = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant
					if riderHum then
						-- driven: throttle forward/back, steer turns
						-- the root; speed & turn rate are the stage
						-- table's, sprint on stamina.
						local throttle = st.RiderSeat.Throttle
						local steer = st.RiderSeat.Steer
						-- FLIGHT: Stage 3+ (the Susanoo has wings),
						-- Fly held, stamina in the pool. The wings
						-- unfold, the flight constraint arms, and
						-- the coupled unit climbs; release and it
						-- glides back down on gravity.
						local wantFly = st.Fly and stageOf(player) >= 3 and (st.Stamina or 0) > 0
						if wantFly ~= (st.Flying == true) then
							st.Flying = wantFly
							pushUpdate(player)
						end
						local flight = bRoot:FindFirstChild("DaemonFlight")
						local wingL, wingR = bear:FindFirstChild("FlightWingL"), bear:FindFirstChild("FlightWingR")
						if st.Flying then
							st.Stamina = math.max(0, (st.Stamina or 0) - 26 * 0.1)
							if wingL then wingL.Transparency = 0.15 end
							if wingR then wingR.Transparency = 0.15 end
							if flight then
								local f = bRoot.CFrame.LookVector
								flight.VectorVelocity = f * (throttle * stats.Speed * 1.1) + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)
								flight.MaxForce = 250000
							end
							if steer ~= 0 then
								bRoot.CFrame = bRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -steer * stats.Turn * 0.1, 0)
							end
							bHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
							continue
						end
						if wingL then wingL.Transparency = 1 end
						if wingR then wingR.Transparency = 1 end
						if flight then flight.MaxForce = 0 end
						local speed = stats.Speed
						if st.Sprint and throttle > 0 and (st.Stamina or 0) > 0 then
							speed *= SPRINT_MULT
							st.Stamina = math.max(0, st.Stamina - STAMINA_DRAIN * 0.1)
						else
							st.Stamina = math.min(STAMINA_MAX, (st.Stamina or 0) + STAMINA_REGEN * 0.1)
						end
						bHum.WalkSpeed = speed
						if throttle ~= 0 then
							local facing = bRoot.CFrame.LookVector
							bHum:Move(facing * throttle, false)
						else
							bHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
						end
						if steer ~= 0 then
							bRoot.CFrame = bRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -steer * stats.Turn * 0.1, 0)
						end
					else
						-- unmounted: follow the twin, keep FOLLOW_DISTANCE
						st.Stamina = math.min(STAMINA_MAX, (st.Stamina or 0) + STAMINA_REGEN * 0.1)
						local char = player.Character
						local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if root then
							local offset = (bRoot.Position - root.Position)
							if offset.Magnitude > FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
								bHum.WalkSpeed = stats.Speed
								bHum:MoveTo(root.Position - offset.Unit * (FOLLOW_DISTANCE - 2))
							else
								bHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

	state[player.UserId] = { Form = "None", Chain = 0, Stamina = STAMINA_MAX, LastTransform = 0 }
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, saved = pcall(function()
			return variantStore:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)

			unlockedVariant[player.UserId] = saved
		end
	end)
	-- The Daemon Design Package (Script 10's pass) unlocks the

	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OwnsDaemonDesignPack"):Connect(function()
		if player:GetAttribute("OwnsDaemonDesignPack") == true then
			_G.JadeUnlockDaemon(player, "Pink")
		end
	end)
	if player:GetAttribute("OwnsDaemonDesignPack") == true then
		_G.JadeUnlockDaemon(player, "Pink")
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.delay(2, function()
			local st = state[player.UserId]
			if not st or st.Form ~= "None" then return end
			if twinKind(player) and stageOf(player) >= MIN_STAGE then
				-- a keeper at Stage 2+ wakes with their Daemon at
				-- their side: the condensed form is the resting state.
				condense(player, false)
			elseif twinKind(player) then
				st.Form = "Susanoo" -- below Stage 2 there is nothing to fold yet
			end
		end)
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if st and st.Bear then st.Bear:Destroy() end
	state[player.UserId] = nil
	unlockedVariant[player.UserId] = nil
end)

-- Jade Spirit | 40_BearControl.client.lua (Daemon panel)
-- Location: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts > LocalScript,
-- rename it BearControl. (File and RemoteEvent names keep their
-- original "Bear" spellings -- they are internal identifiers;
-- everything a player SEES calls it the Daemon pet.)
-- What it does: the client half of the Daemon pet -- the
-- condensed Susanoo (Chapter 32, Script 39). It draws the Daemon

The center of every showcase:  THE PET'S DESIGN AND ABILITIES. Design first: the showcase opens with a slow Design Turn so the crowd can actually see the creature — its colours, its materials, its signature details. Abilities second: flight, attack demo, weapon transformation, in that order, because that is the order a spectator's questions come in — can it fly, can it fight, is it really the weapon too. Poses, titles, pedestals, and entrances in this chapter all exist to serve those two minutes of performance.
Tier | Whose pet | Acts / length | Effects budget
Legendary | Oakley’s Gold Japanese Dragon — the only pet in this tier, by UserId | 6 acts / 24 seconds (the Dragon’s Display, below) | Full: gold light, petal bursts, plaza bell, spotlight on the Legend Pedestal
Epic | Pink (Design Package) or Blue (earned) Daemon bears | 4 acts / 16 seconds | Spotlight, colour light ring, one petal burst
Rare | A Workbench-designed Daemon with a designed wing set | 3 acts / 12 seconds | Colour light ring, small petal drift
Common | The starter Green Daemon bear | 2 acts / 8 seconds | A warm light and the Daemon’s own glow
Act | Seconds | What the dragon does — design and abilities
1. Grand Coil | 5 | THE COILING SHOWCASE: she pours onto the pedestal and coils — three full rings of golden serpentine body settling ring by ring, tail fin last, head rising from the coil's center to Legend Pedestal height. Gold light runs down her scale segments as each ring lands. This act is pure design: the full length of her, visible in one shape.
2. The Design Turn | 4 | She turns — slowly, once — head high, whiskers flaring, mane catching the spotlight, horns, amber eyes, gold claws on all four feet, and the tufted tail presented in order as she rotates. The keeper does not speak or pose over this: the turn is the design spec, performed.
3. Flight Display | 5 | FLIGHT: she leaves the coil in an undulating climb — a Japanese dragon swimming the air, no wings — spirals once around the Legend Pedestal above the crowd, dives in a gold S-curve, and hovers, still and level, at her keeper's shoulder height. Stage-3 flight, performed as ballet.
4. Breath Demo | 4 | BREATH ATTACK DEMO: she faces the crystal Breath Demo Target — the only legal target — and breathes gold blossom-fire: a stream of gold light and petals that strikes the target, which blooms crystal flowers and sheds petals. Demonstration only: the demo breath touches nothing else, damages nothing and no one, and pays nothing.
5. Weapon Transformation | 4 | THE SOUL EATER ACT, fully realized: the scarf unwraps, she pours into gold light, and the light stretches long and hardens — stock, receiver, barrel, scope — until the GOLDEN DRAGON RIFLE lies in Oakley's hands, filigree still etching itself, iridescent shimmer running through the engraved lines. Three demonstration shots at the demo target: light bolts, petal bursts, the semi-auto chime at its capped pace. She pours back grinning — dragons who are rifles always do.
6. Finale — the Answer | 2 | She pours back out onto the pedestal, rebuilds head-first, coils once, looks at Oakley first (the Answer), shakes once (the Shake), and the plaza bell rings over a gold-and-petal burst. Titles show. The show is over; the legend is just standing there again.
Oakley's entrance — the moment before the show:  Oakley never has to start a showcase to get her moment; the game gives it to her when she ARRIVES. When her account joins the server — and again, once, when she first enters the Hero's Plaza in a session — Script 41 fires her Legend Entrance to every client: the plaza bell, a double burst of gold light and cherry petals at her position, her title shown overhead (below), and her dragon uncoiling beside her in the Grand Coil's first ring before settling to her side. It lasts seconds, it cannot be triggered by anyone else, it cannot be bought or imitated, and it has a session lockout so it never becomes noise: once per join, once per plaza entry, never in the Arena, never during a defense event.

-- Jade Spirit | 41_Showcase.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Showcase
-- What it does: SHOW-OFF / PET SHOWCASE (Chapter 33). The pet is
-- the performance: this Script runs pedestal claims in the Hero's
-- Plaza, the pet ability showcase sequence (scaled by the pet's
-- rarity tier), overhead titles, and petal-burst entrances --
-- including Oakley's dedicated LEGEND entrance and the full
-- Dragon's Display for her GOLD JAPANESE DRAGON Daemon.
--
-- RARITY TIERS (server-decided, never client-claimed):
--   Legendary -- Oakley alone: the Gold Japanese Dragon (Script
--     39 kind GoldDragon) + the Headless Jade Skeleton. Full
--     5-act, 24-second Dragon's Display; Legend entrance.
--   Epic -- Pink (Design Package) or Blue (earned) Daemon bears.
--     4 acts, 16 seconds.
--   Rare -- Workbench-designed Daemons with a designed wing set.
--     3 acts, 12 seconds.
--   Common -- the starter Green Daemon bear. 2 acts, 8 seconds.
-- A showcase NEVER changes a number: no damage to players, no
-- counts, no rewards. The breath demo fires only at the plaza's
-- crystal demo target. Cooldown 60 s per player, server-side.
--
-- INTEGRATION: Script 39 publishes _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player)
-- (the keeper's live Daemon model) and _G.JadeDaemonForm(player)
-- ("Bear" / "Weapon" / "Susanoo"). Script 39's transform cycle
-- is requested through the same JadeBearTransform RemoteEvent it
-- already owns -- this Script never builds or destroys a Daemon.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN = 60
local PEDESTAL_HOLD = 120 -- seconds a claim lasts without renewal

local function remote(name)
	local r = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then
		r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent"); r.Name = name; r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	return r
end
local updateEvent = remote("JadeShowcaseUpdate")   -- server -> all: stage/effects
local requestEvent = remote("JadeShowcaseRequest") -- client -> server: start/pose/title
local entranceEvent = remote("JadeEntrance")        -- server -> all: entrance burst

local TITLES = {
	Keeper = { Text = "Bloom Keeper", Tier = "Common" },
	HuskFriend = { Text = "Friend of Husks", Tier = "Common" },
	TreeDefender = { Text = "Defender of the Tree", Tier = "Rare" },
	BlossomLegend = { Text = "Blossom Legend", Tier = "Epic" },
	DragonFriend = { Text = "Friend of Dragons", Tier = "Epic" },
	JadeLegend = { Text = "The Jade Legend -- Keeper of the Gold Dragon", Tier = "Legendary" },
}

local state = {} -- [UserId] = { Pedestal, LastShowcase, Title, Showcasing }

local function isLegend(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit") == true
end

local function tierOf(player)
	if isLegend(player) then return "Legendary" end
	local v = player:GetAttribute("DaemonVariant")
	if v == "Pink" or v == "Blue" then return "Epic" end
	if player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingColor") then return "Rare" end
	return "Common"
end

-- The Dragon's Display (Legendary) and its scaled-down forms.
-- Act = { Name, Seconds, Effect } -- the client renders Effect
-- (coil / design turn / flight / breath / weapon / finale lights
-- and petals); the server owns timing, order, and permission.
local SEQUENCES = {
	Legendary = {
		{ Name = "Grand Coil", Seconds = 5, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "The Design Turn", Seconds = 4, Effect = "DesignTurn" },
		{ Name = "Flight Display", Seconds = 5, Effect = "Flight" },
		{ Name = "Breath Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "GoldBreath" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
		{ Name = "Finale -- the Answer", Seconds = 2, Effect = "Finale" },
	},
	Epic = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Flight Display", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Flight" },
		{ Name = "Claw Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "ClawDemo" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
	Rare = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Ability Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "ClawDemo" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
	Common = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
}

local function daemonOf(player)
	if _G.JadeGetDaemonModel then return _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player) end
	return nil
end

local function runShowcase(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or st.Showcasing then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastShowcase or -SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN) < SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN then return end
	local daemon = daemonOf(player)
	if not daemon then return end -- no condensed Daemon, no showcase
	st.Showcasing = true
	st.LastShowcase = now
	local tier = tierOf(player)
	player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseTier", tier)
	for i, act in ipairs(SEQUENCES[tier]) do
		if not player.Parent then break end
		player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseAct", act.Name)
		updateEvent:FireAllClients({
			UserId = player.UserId, Tier = tier, Act = act.Name,
			Effect = act.Effect, Index = i, Seconds = act.Seconds,
			Pedestal = st.Pedestal,
		})
		task.wait(act.Seconds)
	end
	player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseAct", "")
	st.Showcasing = false
	updateEvent:FireAllClients({ UserId = player.UserId, Tier = tier, Act = "", Effect = "End" })
end

-- ---------- pedestals (Hero's Plaza, World 1) -------------------
local function bindPedestals()
	local plaza = workspace:FindFirstChild("HerosPlaza")
	if not plaza then return end
	for _, pedestal in ipairs(plaza:GetChildren()) do
		if pedestal:IsA("BasePart") and pedestal.Name:match("^Pedestal") then
			local prompt = pedestal:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
			if not prompt then
				prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
				prompt.ActionText = "Show Off"; prompt.ObjectText = "Showcase Pedestal"
				prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10; prompt.Parent = pedestal
			end
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				local st = state[player.UserId]
				if not st then return end
				-- one pedestal per player; claiming a new one frees the old
				st.Pedestal = pedestal.Name
				player:SetAttribute("ShowcasePedestal", pedestal.Name)
				task.delay(PEDESTAL_HOLD, function()
					if st.Pedestal == pedestal.Name then
						st.Pedestal = nil
						player:SetAttribute("ShowcasePedestal", "")
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ---------- titles ----------------------------------------------
local function applyTitle(player, titleId)
	local def = TITLES[titleId]
	if not def then return end
	if def.Tier == "Legendary" and not isLegend(player) then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local old = root:FindFirstChild("ShowcaseTitle")
	if old then old:Destroy() end
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "ShowcaseTitle"; gui.Size = UDim2.new(6, 0, 1, 0)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.6, 0); gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0); label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = def.Text; label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	label.TextColor3 = def.Tier == "Legendary" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80)
		or def.Tier == "Epic" and Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 210)
		or Color3.fromRGB(190, 255, 220)
	label.Parent = gui; gui.Parent = root
	state[player.UserId].Title = titleId
end

-- ---------- entrances -------------------------------------------
local function fireEntrance(player, area)
	local tier = tierOf(player)
	entranceEvent:FireAllClients({
		UserId = player.UserId, Tier = tier, Area = area or "World",
		-- Legendary = Oakley's dedicated moment: bell, petal burst,
		-- gold light, dragon uncoil -- rendered by every client.
		Legend = isLegend(player),
	})
end

requestEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return end
	if action == "StartShowcase" then
		task.spawn(runShowcase, player)
	elseif action == "SetTitle" and type(arg) == "string" then
		applyTitle(player, arg)
	elseif action == "EnterArea" and type(arg) == "string" then
		fireEntrance(player, arg)
	end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	state[player.UserId] = {}
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		task.wait(1)
		fireEntrance(player, "World") -- join entrance, tier-scaled
	end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	state[player.UserId] = nil
end)
bindPedestals()

-- What it does: the CLIENT half of Chapter 33 -- the Showcase
-- panel (Start Showcase, the pose wheel, title picker), the
-- local rendering of showcase acts and entrances (spotlights,
-- petal bursts, gold breath light, coil light rings), and the
-- Settings toggle that lets any player turn OTHER players'
-- effects down or off. It decides nothing: Script 41 owns
-- tiers, pedestals, cooldowns, titles, and sequence timing.

	effectsMode = effectsMode == "Full" and "Reduced" or effectsMode == "Reduced" and "Off" or "Full"
	effectsButton.Text = "Effects: " .. effectsMode
end)

function playPose(poseId)
	local char = player.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hum then return end
	for _, pose in ipairs(POSES) do
		if pose.Id == poseId and pose.AnimationId ~= 0 then
			local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://" .. pose.AnimationId
			local track = hum:LoadAnimation(anim)
			track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
			track:Play()
			return
		end
	end
end

local function burst(root, color, count)
	if effectsMode == "Off" then return end
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment"); att.Parent = root
	local em = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	em.Color = ColorSequence.new(color)
	em.Rate = 0; em.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.4)
	em.Speed = NumberRange.new(6, 11)
	em.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
	em.Parent = att
	em:Emit(effectsMode == "Reduced" and math.floor(count / 2) or count)
	game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(att, 2)
end

local function rootOf(userId)
	local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
	local char = p and p.Character
	return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

updateEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	local root = rootOf(data.UserId)
	if not root then return end
	if data.Effect == "GoldBreath" then
		burst(root, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 80), 60) -- gold blossom breath light
	elseif data.Effect == "Finale" then

The palette law — pink and brown:  Every base character's clothing and every companion pet in this game is PINK AND BROWN — only pink and brown. Browns are the wood: heartwood, bark, leather shades. Pinks are the quartz: blossom pink quartz in every companion and every weapon. The four starters read as four different characters entirely through silhouette, cut, pattern, and their companions — never through a third colour. Oakley is the exception, and she is the exception everywhere: jade skeleton, gold dragon, golden sniper rifle and pink-and-brown ghillie (Chapter 36). If a base design draft shows any other colour, the draft is wrong.

Fairness and security, once more:  The client sends one string — a type name — and Script 43 accepts only the four names in its own table. The choice is saved server-side under the UserId; the companion's species is derived from it server-side (Script 45), never sent by the client. All four types are free, all deal 25, and the twins' accounts bypass the screen by server-side UserId alone — Oakley's bypass grants her nothing from this system at all, because her partner lives in Script 39, behind the same lock as everything else of hers.
Rule | The limitation, exactly
Slot 1 — the First Choice | Every keeper owns exactly ONE weapon at the start: the starter chosen at the Threshold (this chapter), bonded to its companion, permanent. Slot 1 can never be sold, traded, deleted, reset, or re-picked — the branch that grew for you grew once
Maximum owned — three, never four | A keeper may own AT MOST 3 of the 4 starters, ever. One starter is always the one you did not take — for every player, forever. There is no fourth slot: no unlock, no pass, no product, no event grants one, and the shop (Chapter 6) sells no slot of any kind
Slot 2 — earned mid-game | Unlocks at 5,000 Lifetime thrusts AND completion of the Second Vow quest at the Main Shrine (free 25 husks beyond the gates in one expedition, return through the light). On unlock, the keeper chooses ONE of the two starters they do not own, at the Threshold stands, with the same two-tap deliberate confirm — and that choice is just as permanent. A new branch lowers; a second companion grows; nobody pretends the second bond is the first
Slot 3 — the endgame vow | Unlocks at 25,000 Lifetime thrusts AND 10 assaults held (the defense record of Script 31). One final choice from the last two unowned starters. After it, the roster is closed to that keeper permanently — the fourth weapon becomes their known road not taken, named on their profile beside the three they carry
Swapping — at home, on purpose | Owned weapons swap ONLY at home: at the Spirit Workbench Hall or the Root Plaza swap stone, standing still, a 3-second change while the active companion pours back through its branch and the chosen one pours in (Chapter 34's transformation rules). There is no mid-expedition swap, no hotkey loadout wheel beyond the gates, and no swap during combat, a raid, or a showcase act — the loadout you carried through the light is the loadout the expedition is played with
Why the lock matters | Because preparation is gameplay (Chapter 3's expedition loop): choosing spear-reach, katana-speed, scythe-arc, or hammer-weight for the ring you are entering — solo or as a party balancing its three-slots against each other — is the strategic decision the apocalypse asks before it asks for aim. A party of four keepers fields at most twelve weapon-bonds between them and still leaves four starters on the table; composition is a conversation, not a checklist
Companions follow the slots | Each owned weapon has ITS companion (this chapter's pairings) — sprite, fox, serpent, bear cub. Only the ACTIVE weapon's companion is out in the world. The others rest at home in branch form along the Daemon Garden fence, visible, named, and waiting — a keeper's garden fence quietly shows the whole server exactly what they chose, and one bare hook shows what they didn't
Oakley & the twins | Outside this system, as everywhere: the twins' Twin Spears are birthright, not slots, and Oakley's Golden Dragon Rifle (Chapter 36) is her dragon — she has no slots, no roster, and no road not taken. Scarcity is for keepers; legends are singular
What is never sold | Slots. Not slot 2, not slot 3, not the fourth that does not exist. Robux touches designs, treats, and cosmetics (Chapter 6) — never the size of a keeper's commitment. The day a slot can be bought, the First Choice stops meaning anything, and this game is built on it meaning everything
-- Jade Spirit | 43_WeaponChoice.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it WeaponChoice
-- What it does: THE FIRST CHOICE (Chapter 34). Before the tutorial,
-- before the Daemon Garden, before World 1 itself, a first-time
-- player stands on the Threshold and chooses a weapon TYPE. Only
-- then does the branch manifest (Script 45) and the game begin.
--
-- * THE FOUR STARTERS (the whole launch roster): Spear, Katana,
--   Scythe, Hammer. Each type is a base character AND a companion:
--   Spear -> the wooden Sprite, Katana -> the wooden Fox, Scythe ->
--   the wooden Serpent, Hammer -> the wooden Bear Cub. The pairing
--   is 1:1 and lives in this table; Script 45 reads the same names.
-- * ALL FOUR ARE FREE, forever. No type is sold, granted by a pass,
--   or dropped by a quest. Damage is 25 for every type (Script 2's
--   pattern); the types differ in reach, arc, and rhythm only --
--   style stats, published in WEAPON_TYPES below and in Chapter 34.
-- * THE TWINS ARE NOT IN THE CHOICE. The twin guardian accounts
--   (the same UserIds as Scripts 8/35/39) are settled server-side:
--   both are Spear by birthright, and Oakley's account never sees
--   the Threshold at all -- her companion is the Gold Dragon
--   (Script 39), not a branch creature, and no choice can change
--   that. With an ID still 0, nobody is special-cased (fail-closed).
-- * HOLD: a player with no saved choice is teleported to the
--   Threshold platform (Workspace > Threshold > ThresholdSpawn) on
--   every spawn and cannot leave it until they choose: the exit
--   gate is this Script, and it opens only after a saved choice.
-- * STORAGE: DataStore "JadeWeaponChoice_v1", key = UserId, value =
--   the type name. The choice is also published as the WeaponType
--   attribute, which Scripts 33/39/45 read. Re-choosing is free at
--   the Spirit Workbench (Chapter 28): fire the same RemoteEvent
--   while standing at the Workbench -- this Script re-checks the
--   player's zone either way, and a re-choice never touches counts,
--   stages, or unlocks (those belong to the player, Chapter 4).
--
-- SECURITY: the client sends ONE string. It must be a string, it
-- must be a key of WEAPON_TYPES, and that is the entire trust
-- surface. There is no fifth type a client can name into being.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with her UserId (same as Scripts 8/35/39)
local TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with his UserId

local WEAPON_TYPES = {
	Spear  = { Companion = "Sprite",  Reach = 11, Arc = 40,  Cooldown = 0.55 },
	Katana = { Companion = "Fox",     Reach = 8,  Arc = 90,  Cooldown = 0.45 },
	Scythe = { Companion = "Serpent", Reach = 10, Arc = 120, Cooldown = 0.65 },
	Hammer = { Companion = "BearCub", Reach = 7,  Arc = 70,  Cooldown = 0.80 },
}

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeWeaponChoice_v1")
local chosen = {} -- [UserId] = typeName

local choiceEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
choiceEvent.Name = "JadeWeaponChoice"
choiceEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local openEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
openEvent.Name = "JadeWeaponChoiceOpen"
openEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function isTwin(player)
	return (TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID)
		or (TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID)
end

local function applyChoice(player, typeName, save)
	chosen[player.UserId] = typeName
	player:SetAttribute("WeaponType", typeName)
	player:SetAttribute("CompanionSpecies", WEAPON_TYPES[typeName].Companion)
	if save then
		pcall(function() store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), typeName) end)
	end
	-- The branch hears about it from the attribute; Script 45 builds
	-- the seed branch and grows the companion from it.
	if _G.JadeBranchOnChoice then _G.JadeBranchOnChoice(player, typeName) end
end

local function holdAtThreshold(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local threshold = workspace:FindFirstChild("Threshold")
	local spawn = threshold and threshold:FindFirstChild("ThresholdSpawn")
	if char and spawn then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end
	openEvent:FireClient(player)
end

local function releaseToWorld(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local gate = workspace:FindFirstChild("ThresholdExitSpawn")
	if char and gate then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then root.CFrame = gate.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end
end

local function onJoin(player)
	if isTwin(player) then
		applyChoice(player, "Spear", false) -- birthright; never saved as a "choice"
		return
	end
	local saved
	pcall(function() saved = store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId)) end)
	if type(saved) == "string" and WEAPON_TYPES[saved] then
		applyChoice(player, saved, false)
	else
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not chosen[player.UserId] then holdAtThreshold(player) end
		end)
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(function()
				task.wait(0.5)
				if not chosen[player.UserId] then holdAtThreshold(player) end
			end)
		end
	end
end

choiceEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, typeName)
	if type(typeName) ~= "string" then return end
	if not WEAPON_TYPES[typeName] then return end
	local firstChoice = chosen[player.UserId] == nil
	applyChoice(player, typeName, true)
	if firstChoice then releaseToWorld(player) end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(onJoin, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) chosen[player.UserId] = nil end)

-- SECURITY: clients send nothing to this Script. Forms change on

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
