-- Jade Spirit | 56_SandboxSystem.server.lua
-- What it does: THE SANDBOX (Chapter 52). Assigns each player a
-- build plot beyond the Sandbox Gate, validates every placed
-- part server-side (whitelist, like the creator, Chapter 29),
-- saves and loads plots in a DataStore, and runs submissions
-- into the creativity system (Chapter 37).
--
-- SAFETY LAW: players place PARTS, never scripts. A submitted
-- build is data — shape, size, colour, material, transform —
-- and this script rebuilds it from that data. Nothing a player
-- makes can contain code, a free-text field is filtered through
-- Roblox's TextService before it is stored, and featuring a
-- build in World 1 loads the same data through the same
-- validator. There is no path from a sandbox plot to a Script.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local PLOT_SIZE = 64 -- studs, square (Chapter 52)
local PART_BUDGET = 500 -- per plot, a performance promise
local SAVE_SLOTS = 3
local SHAPES = { Block = true, Wedge = true, Cylinder = true, Ball = true, CornerWedge = true }
local MATERIALS = {
	[Enum.Material.Wood] = true, [Enum.Material.WoodPlanks] = true,
	[Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic] = true, [Enum.Material.Glass] = true,
	[Enum.Material.Neon] = true, [Enum.Material.Marble] = true,
	[Enum.Material.Grass] = true, [Enum.Material.Slate] = true,
}

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpiritSandbox_v1")
-- ENTRY (Chapter 52): building requires (a) the Sandbox Gate
-- Pass — a Developer Product at 80 Robux, routed by Script 10
-- to the grant below — and (b) a recorded acceptance of the
-- Sandbox IP Terms, CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION, accepted in the
-- gate panel before any purchase prompt is shown. Viewing
-- featured builds is free and needs neither.
local CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION = "sandbox-terms-v1-DRAFT"
local hasAccess, hasConsent = {}, {}
function _G.JadeGrantSandboxAccess(player)
	hasAccess[player] = true
	-- The pass is one-time and permanent (Chapter 52: bought once,
	-- the gate opens on every visit), so the grant is recorded in
	-- the same DataStore as the consent record and reloaded on
	-- join below -- a session table alone would revoke a paid pass
	-- at logout.
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("access_" .. player.UserId, true)
	end)
	return true
end
function _G.JadeSandboxHasConsent(player)
	return hasConsent[player] == CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION
end
function _G.JadeSandboxHasAccess(player)
	return hasAccess[player] == true and hasConsent[player] == CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION
end
local plots, builds, plotIndex = {}, {}, {}
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeSandbox")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "JadeSandbox"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end

local function plotOrigin(player)
	if not plotIndex[player] then
		local n = 0
		for _ in pairs(plotIndex) do n += 1 end
		plotIndex[player] = n
	end
	return Vector3.new((plotIndex[player] % 8) * 80, 200, math.floor(plotIndex[player] / 8) * 80)
end

local function serialize(player)
	local out = {}
	for _, part in ipairs(builds[player] or {}) do
		table.insert(out, {
			Shape = part.Name, Size = { part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z },
			Pos = { part.Position.X, part.Position.Y, part.Position.Z },
			Rot = { part.Orientation.X, part.Orientation.Y, part.Orientation.Z },
			Color = { part.Color.R, part.Color.G, part.Color.B },
			Material = part.Material.Name,
		})
	end
	return out
end

local function rebuild(player, data)
	for _, part in ipairs(builds[player] or {}) do part:Destroy() end
	builds[player] = {}
	local origin = plotOrigin(player)
	for _, d in ipairs(data or {}) do
		if #builds[player] >= PART_BUDGET then break end
		if not SHAPES[d.Shape] then continue end
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = d.Shape
		part.Shape = (d.Shape == "Block") and Enum.PartType.Block
			or (d.Shape == "Ball") and Enum.PartType.Ball
			or (d.Shape == "Cylinder") and Enum.PartType.Cylinder or Enum.PartType.Block
		if d.Shape == "Wedge" or d.Shape == "CornerWedge" then
			part:Destroy()
			part = Instance.new(d.Shape == "Wedge" and "WedgePart" or "CornerWedgePart")
		end
		part.Size = Vector3.new(table.unpack(d.Size))
		part.Position = origin + Vector3.new(table.unpack(d.Pos))
		part.Orientation = Vector3.new(table.unpack(d.Rot))
		part.Color = Color3.new(table.unpack(d.Color))
		part.Material = Enum.Material[d.Material] or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		part.Anchored = true
		part.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("SandboxBuilds") or workspace
		table.insert(builds[player], part)
	end
end

local lastAction = {}
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg)
	local now = os.clock()
	if lastAction[player] and now - lastAction[player] < 0.25 then return end
	lastAction[player] = now
	builds[player] = builds[player] or {}

	if action == "AcceptTerms" then
		-- The server records the version accepted and when; the
		-- client cannot backdate, skip, or accept "on behalf of".
		if arg == CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION then
			hasConsent[player] = CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION
			pcall(function()
				store:SetAsync("consent_" .. player.UserId,
					{ Version = CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION, At = os.time() })
			end)
			remote:FireClient(player, "TermsAccepted", CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION)
		end
		return
	elseif action == "EnterSandbox" then
		if not _G.JadeSandboxHasAccess(player) then
			remote:FireClient(player, "NeedGatePass", {
				TermsVersion = CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION, HasConsent = hasConsent[player] == CURRENT_TERMS_VERSION,
			})
			return
		end
		local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("SandboxSpawn")
		local root = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if spawn and root then
			plots[player] = plotOrigin(player)
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(plots[player] + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
		end

	elseif action == "Place" and type(arg) == "table" then
		if not _G.JadeSandboxHasAccess(player) then return end
		if #builds[player] >= PART_BUDGET then
			remote:FireClient(player, "Denied", "Plot budget reached (500 parts).")
			return
		end
		if not SHAPES[arg.Shape] or not MATERIALS[arg.Material] then return end
		local origin = plots[player] or plotOrigin(player)
		local pos = Vector3.new(arg.Pos[1], arg.Pos[2], arg.Pos[3])
		-- The plot is a fence the server enforces, not a suggestion:
		if math.abs(pos.X - origin.X) > PLOT_SIZE / 2
			or math.abs(pos.Z - origin.Z) > PLOT_SIZE / 2
			or pos.Y < origin.Y or pos.Y > origin.Y + 80 then return end
		local data = serialize(player)
		table.insert(data, arg)
		rebuild(player, data)

	elseif action == "Save" and type(arg) == "number" then
		local slot = math.clamp(math.floor(arg), 1, SAVE_SLOTS)
		pcall(function()
			store:SetAsync(("u_%d_slot_%d"):format(player.UserId, slot), serialize(player))
		end)
		remote:FireClient(player, "Saved", slot)

	elseif action == "Load" and type(arg) == "number" then
		local slot = math.clamp(math.floor(arg), 1, SAVE_SLOTS)
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync(("u_%d_slot_%d"):format(player.UserId, slot))
		end)
		if ok and data then rebuild(player, data) end

	elseif action == "Submit" and type(arg) == "table" then
		-- Title travels through Roblox's filter before it is kept.
		local title = "Untitled Build"
		local okF, res = pcall(function()
			return TextService:FilterStringAsync(tostring(arg.Title or title), player.UserId)
		end)
		if okF and res then
			local okG, filtered = pcall(function()
				return res:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
			end)
			if okG and filtered then title = filtered end
		end
		local record = {
			Author = player.Name, UserId = player.UserId, Title = title,
			Kind = (arg.Kind == "Arena" or arg.Kind == "Obby") and arg.Kind or "Structure",
			Parts = #builds[player], Data = serialize(player),
			Status = "InReview", -- InReview | Featured | Published | Returned
		}
		pcall(function()
			local queue = store:GetAsync("submission_queue") or {}
			table.insert(queue, record)
			store:SetAsync("submission_queue", queue)
		end)
		remote:FireClient(player, "Submitted", title)
	end
end)

The amendment, stated plainly:  Chapter 45 ruled that no external canon would be imported into this game. That rule is amended by the owner's direction, in one narrow way: Taylor's other frameworks enter ONLY as executable code — server-side ModuleScripts behind the interface in this chapter, judged by their measured verdicts in the ledger — never as lore, never as rarity claims, never as numbers a chapter merely asserts. What enters as code must survive as code: shadow first, armed second, rolled back the moment the data says so.
Live event | Source (existing system) | Envelope | Who consumes it
Swing | Script 13 publishes Lifetime to the ThrustTotal attribute on every counted thrust; Script 58 listens to the attribute signal | {Kind=Swing, A=Lifetime after the swing} | G48 gate (the 48-swing window), Thermal gate (load), Codec gate (payload)
Free / Kill | Script 4's husk and Hollow frees, emitted through _G.JadeEmitLive — one line added at the free site | {Kind=Free, A=node the husk stood on} | H14 door gate (the player's pair)
Traverse | Script 58's own pads and Script 19's gates | {Kind=Traverse, A=the gate's required count} | Every module's Recent window; the ledger
Death | Humanoid.Died on each character | {Kind=Death} | Aggregates; difficulty analysis (Chapter 50)
Damage | Script 2 / the damage meter (_G.JadeGetMeter), sampled by Script 58's taps | {Kind=Damage, A=amount} | Aggregates; calibration scoring
Module member | Contract
Id / Version | A string and a number. The ledger stamps both on every verdict, so results are always attributable to an exact build of the module
Validate(ctx) → verdict | THE gate function. ctx is a fresh read-only snapshot: UserId, GateKey, Now, Lifetime (read live through Script 13), Recent (the ring buffer copy), Params (the module's calibrated parameters). The module receives no Player object, no _G, no DataStore — it can compute, and only compute
Verdict table | {Action, Reason, Residual?, Payload?} with Action one of ADMIT, REFUSE, REPAIR, GENERATE. Reason is player-facing text. Residual is the measured number the decision turned on — the gate card (Script 59) shows it, and the ledger keeps it
Generate(ctx) → payload (optional) | For gates that make things: a door puzzle, a frame, a heat band, a gate layout seed. Generated content enters the world only through Script 58, which validates its shape first
Calibrate(aggregates) → params (optional) | The learning hook — see the learning loop below. Bounded by the module's own declared limits
Score(verdict, outcome) → number (optional) | The module grades its own past verdicts against what happened next; this is the score calibration must not degrade
Gate | Framework and source rule | The live mechanic
The Present Gate (G48Present) | G48: the 48 masks are the 7-bit odd odometer 3..97; thermal heat = popcount(mask) + distance/100, distance pattern {124, 282, 352, 253, 100, 17} repeating; G48 is the 4/3 fixed point — the present is occurring, thermal measures the tangent to it | The gate reads the player's last 48 live swings: swing k carries mask k, the window's mean thermal is the residual against the present, and the gate admits inside the calibrated band (default 6.4). Play is the measurement — a keeper quite literally plays the harp to open the gate
The Door Gate (H14Doors) | The CORE: 1,128 pairs partition completely as 944 door + 124 alias + 60 never, carrying 7,140 doors; alias ⟺ Hamming distance 1 (no door is combinatorially possible); the 544 identity: the 17 complementary pairs (a + b = 128) carry exactly 32 doors each, all Floor | The player's pair is their two most recent husk frees (the nodes those husks stood on). Alias pair → REFUSED with the reason named. Complementary pair → ADMITTED on its 32 Floor doors. Any other pair → REFUSED, honestly: the gate does not guess pairs the proved rules do not cover, until the full door table ships as a data module
The Frame Gate (CodecFrame) | RFF-1 / C(7,48), filed as U.S. Prov. 64/170,360: H is 7×48, every column carries common bit 0 and weight ≥ 2; singles are repaired, dual spikes are REFUSED, never miscorrected; refusal propagates — a refused frame reaches no second layer | At each crossing the gate builds a frame from the player's live record (payload = their window swing counts, parity = H × payload) and the world injects the fault the minute selects: none → ADMIT; single spike → REPAIR, admitted repaired; dual spike → REFUSE. The filed codec's behaviour IS the gate's behaviour, on live data, three crossings in three minutes showing all three verdicts
The Soak Gate (ThermalSoak) | The lumped thermal model C_th·dT/dt = P − (T − T_amb)/R_th with the 1.2 MHz module's figures: P to 12 W core + 8 W copper, R_th 4.5 K/W, T_max 120 °C | The player's live swing rate is the electrical load. The gate integrates the model per player and admits while the core sits in the working band (default ≤ 105 °C); a play style whose steady state passes 120 °C is refused until rest cools the core. The model is the lock — there is no timer anywhere in it
Failure | Automatic recovery | What the player experiences
Module errors or returns a malformed verdict | pcall catches it; one automatic retry after 0.25 s; the fault is logged to the ledger with the module's Id and Version | Nothing — the crossing resolves by fallback
Module exceeds its 8 ms budget | Counted as a fault, same path as an error. Six faults trip the circuit breaker: the module is bypassed for 60 s, then probed back on live traffic | Nothing — fallback decides; the gate card notes the module only when it actually judged
Script 58 itself stops (heartbeat stale > 10 s) | The watchdog sets CodeGatesDown; every pad behaves as its classic gate; heartbeat recovery clears the flag and code-gates resume | Classic gates throughout — a slightly plainer game, never a stopped one
A bus event is malformed or a producer dies mid-fire | Validation rejects it; one re-queue; a second failure quarantines it to the ledger for later analysis — the stream flows on | Nothing
Player stuck (walking, moving < 1 stud in 20 s) | Watchdog re-seats them at the nearest Spawn_ pad; the third rescue in a session routes to Spawn_Grove | A blink and solid ground
Broken character state (no Humanoid, dead > 15 s without respawn) | Watchdog calls LoadCharacter — the standard safe reset | A normal respawn
Ledger DataStore write fails | Buffer keeps the newest 400 entries in memory and retries at the next 30 s flush; verdicts never block on the store | Nothing — logging is a passenger, never the driver
Stage | How it works
1. Accumulate | Every live event and every verdict feeds per-module aggregates on five-minute windows: attempts, admits, refuses, mean residual, fault count, and the appeal signal — a refused player who then succeeds through the classic fallback within 60 seconds, the strongest available evidence that a refusal was wrong
2. Propose | A module that exposes Calibrate(aggregates) may propose new parameters — for example the G48 gate nudging its thermal band by at most 0.1 per window, inside its declared hard bounds (5.6–7.2). Modules without Calibrate never change; silence is a valid calibration
3. Prove in shadow | A candidate never goes live directly. It scores in shadow against the incumbent on the next window of live traffic, using the module's own Score function where provided. Adoption requires: candidate score at least the incumbent's, AND an appeal rate no worse. A tie keeps the incumbent — stability wins ties by design
4. Adopt or discard, always reversible | Adoption is stamped in the ledger (module, version, window statistics, old and new params). The previous params are kept, and _G.JadeGateRollback(moduleId) restores them in one call. Any fault spike in the window after adoption auto-rolls-back without waiting for a human
-- Jade Spirit | 58_CodeGate.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it CodeGate
-- What it does: THE CODE-GATE ENGINE (Chapter 53). A gate in this
-- game can be more than a number check: it can EXECUTE one of
-- Taylor's own code modules -- G48, the H14/CORE door system, the
-- RFF codec, the thermal model -- on LIVE game data. Every counted
-- swing, every husk freed, every gate traversal, every death flows
-- through the live bus below; a module reads that stream, returns a
-- verdict, and the gate acts on it: ADMIT, REFUSE, REPAIR, or
-- GENERATE (a puzzle, a frame, a heat band the world then obeys).
--
-- PRODUCTION RULES (this runs on live players, not in a sandbox):
-- * SERVER ONLY. Modules live in ServerScriptService > CodeGateModules
--   (ModuleScripts). Clients never see module code or raw verdicts
--   beyond the gate card Script 59 draws.
-- * FAIL CLOSED, NEVER CRASH. Every module call is wrapped in pcall
--   with a time budget. An error, a timeout, or a malformed verdict
--   becomes a REFUSAL with a reason -- or the gate's declared safe
--   fallback (below) -- never an exception that reaches the game.
-- * MODULES CANNOT WRITE THE GAME. A module receives a read-only
--   snapshot and returns data. It gets no Player object, no _G, no
--   DataStore handle, and no path to currency, Lifetime, damage, or
--   prices (Chapter 50's never-list, enforced here by construction:
--   the capability simply is not in the room).
-- * EVERY VERDICT IS LOGGED. The ledger (see LEDGER) is the
--   laboratory notebook: module id + version, gate, player, input
--   summary, verdict, residual, mode, and timestamp.
-- * SHADOW BEFORE ARMED. A module runs in SHADOW mode first: it
--   evaluates live traffic and logs verdicts but the gate still
--   obeys its classic rule (Script 19's Lifetime ladder). Only the
--   owner flips a gate to ARMED, per gate, by attribute. A module
--   that misbehaves in shadow never touches a player.
--
-- SELF-HEALING (Chapter 53): Script 60 (JadeWatchdog) supervises
-- this engine. If this Script's heartbeat stops, the watchdog
-- reverts every code-gate to its classic fallback and raises an
-- alert. Inside this Script: failed module calls retry once after
-- a short delay, then the module is circuit-broken for 60 seconds
-- (calls short-circuit to fallback) while the watchdog probes it
-- back to health. Dropped bus events are re-queued once from the
-- per-player ring buffer; events that fail validation twice are
-- quarantined to the ledger, never silently lost, never replayed
-- into a gate.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService("ServerScriptService")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local TIME_BUDGET = 0.008        -- seconds per module evaluation
local BREAKER_SECONDS = 60       -- circuit-breaker cool-down
local RING_SIZE = 120            -- live events kept per player
local LEDGER_FLUSH = 30          -- seconds between DataStore flushes

-- ============ THE LIVE BUS ============
-- One BindableEvent carries every live event in the game. Sources:
-- (a) taps this Script installs itself (ThrustTotal attribute =
-- every counted swing, Script 13; Humanoid.Died; gate pads), and
-- (b) any other server Script may Fire the same event with the
-- envelope below. Envelope: {Kind, Player, A, B, At} where Kind is
-- "Swing" | "Free" | "Kill" | "Traverse" | "Death" | "Damage" |
-- "Zone" and A/B are numbers whose meaning the Kind defines.
local bus = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("JadeLiveEvent")
if not bus then
	bus = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	bus.Name = "JadeLiveEvent"
	bus.Parent = ServerScriptService
end
_G.JadeEmitLive = function(kind, player, a, b)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		bus:Fire({ Kind = kind, Player = player, A = a, B = b, At = os.time() })
	end
end

local rings = {}      -- [player] = { events..., head }
local quarantine = {} -- events that failed validation twice
local function ringPush(player, ev)
	local ring = rings[player]
	if not ring then ring = {}; rings[player] = ring end
	ring[#ring + 1] = ev
	if #ring > RING_SIZE then table.remove(ring, 1) end
end
local function validEvent(ev)
	return type(ev) == "table" and type(ev.Kind) == "string"
		and typeof(ev.Player) == "Instance" and ev.Player.Parent ~= nil
end

-- ============ MODULE REGISTRY ============
-- A module is a ModuleScript in ServerScriptService>CodeGateModules
-- returning a table with: Id (string), Version (number),
-- Validate(ctx) -> verdict, and optionally Generate(ctx) -> payload
-- and Calibrate(aggregates) -> params table (bounded, see LEARNING).
-- ctx is a fresh read-only snapshot per call: {Player (UserId only,
-- as ctx.UserId), GateKey, Lifetime, Balance, Recent (ring copy),
-- Params, Now}. Verdict: {Action = "ADMIT"|"REFUSE"|"REPAIR"|
-- "GENERATE", Reason = string, Residual = number?,
-- Payload = any?}. Anything else is malformed and refused.
local modules = {}  -- [id] = {impl, failures, brokenUntil, params, candidate}
local folder = ServerScriptService:FindFirstChild("CodeGateModules")
if folder then
	for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			local ok, impl = pcall(require, child)
			if ok and type(impl) == "table" and type(impl.Id) == "string"
				and type(impl.Validate) == "function" then
				impl.Version = tonumber(impl.Version) or 1
				modules[impl.Id] = { impl = impl, failures = 0,
					brokenUntil = 0, params = impl.DefaultParams or {} }
			else
				warn("[CodeGate] module rejected at load: " .. child.Name)
			end
		end
	end
end
_G.JadeGateModules = function()
	local out = {}
	for id, m in pairs(modules) do
		out[id] = { Version = m.impl.Version, Broken = os.clock() < m.brokenUntil }
	end
	return out
end

-- ============ THE LEDGER (laboratory notebook) ============
local ledgerBuffer = {}
local ledgerStore = nil
pcall(function()
	ledgerStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("CodeGateLedger_v1")
end)
local function logLedger(entry)
	entry.At = os.time()
	ledgerBuffer[#ledgerBuffer + 1] = entry
	if #ledgerBuffer > 400 then table.remove(ledgerBuffer, 1) end
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(LEDGER_FLUSH)
		if ledgerStore and #ledgerBuffer > 0 then

local function evaluate(moduleId, player, gateKey)
	local m = modules[moduleId]
	if not m then return { Action = "REFUSE", Reason = "unknown module" } end
	if os.clock() < m.brokenUntil then
		return { Action = "FALLBACK", Reason = "module circuit-broken" }
	end
	for attempt = 1, 2 do -- one automatic retry, then fallback
		local started = os.clock()
		local ok, verdict = pcall(m.impl.Validate, snapshot(player, gateKey, m.params))
		local elapsed = os.clock() - started
		if ok and elapsed <= TIME_BUDGET and type(verdict) == "table"
			and (verdict.Action == "ADMIT" or verdict.Action == "REFUSE"
				or verdict.Action == "REPAIR" or verdict.Action == "GENERATE") then

		end

		logLedger({ Kind = "ModuleFault", Module = moduleId, Gate = gateKey,
			UserId = player.UserId, Attempt = attempt,
			Reason = ok and "timeout-or-malformed" or tostring(verdict) })
		if attempt == 1 then task.wait(0.25) end
	end
	if m.failures >= 6 then m.brokenUntil = os.clock() + BREAKER_SECONDS end
	return { Action = "FALLBACK", Reason = "module fault after retry" }

-- Usage teaches the gates WITHIN BOUNDS the owner set in code. Each
-- module may expose Calibrate(aggregates) -> candidate params. A
-- candidate is NEVER adopted directly: it is scored in SHADOW
-- against the incumbent on the next window of live events, and it

-- player who succeeds through the classic fallback within 60 s).

-- kept -- _G.JadeGateRollback(moduleId) restores them in one call.

-- can never touch damage, prices, thresholds of OTHER systems, or
-- any Chapter 50 never-list item, because modules hold no such value.

	local a = aggregates[moduleId]

end

	local m = modules[moduleId]
	if m and m.previousParams then
		m.params = m.previousParams
		m.previousParams = nil
		logLedger({ Kind = "Rollback", Module = moduleId })
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- Jade Spirit | Module: G48PresentGate (ModuleScript)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > CodeGateModules > G48PresentGate
-- Taylor's G48, executed live: the 48 masks are the 7-bit odd
-- odometer 3..97; thermal heat of mask i is popcount(mask) +
-- distance/100 with the distance pattern {124,282,352,253,100,17}
-- repeating across the 48. The gate reads the player's LIVE swing
-- stream (the last 48 counted swings, Script 13 via Script 58's
-- ring buffer): swing k is assigned mask k, the window's mean
-- thermal is the residual against the present fixed point, and the
-- gate admits while the residual sits inside the calibrated band.
local MASKS = {}
for v = 3, 97, 2 do MASKS[#MASKS + 1] = v end -- exactly 48
local DIST = { 124, 282, 352, 253, 100, 17 }
local function popcount(n)
	local c = 0
	while n > 0 do c += n % 2; n = math.floor(n / 2) end
	return c
end
local function thermal(i)
	local mask = MASKS[((i - 1) % 48) + 1]
	return popcount(mask) + DIST[((i - 1) % 6) + 1] / 100
end
local M = { Id = "G48Present", Version = 1,
	DefaultParams = { MinSwings = 12, MaxMeanThermal = 6.4 } }
function M.Validate(ctx)
	local swings = 0
	for _, ev in ipairs(ctx.Recent) do
		if ev.Kind == "Swing" then swings += 1 end
	end
	if swings < (ctx.Params.MinSwings or 12) then
		return { Action = "REFUSE", Reason = "the present is not yet played: "
			.. swings .. " live swings in window", Residual = swings }
	end
	local sum = 0
	local n = math.min(swings, 48)
	for i = 1, n do sum += thermal(i) end
	local mean = sum / n
	local cap = ctx.Params.MaxMeanThermal or 6.4
	if mean <= cap then
		return { Action = "ADMIT", Reason = "window thermal inside the band",
			Residual = mean }
	end
	return { Action = "REFUSE", Reason = "window thermal above the band",
		Residual = mean }
end
function M.Calibrate(agg)
	-- Widen or tighten the band by at most 0.1 per window, inside
	-- hard bounds, toward the observed admit/refuse balance.
	local p = { MinSwings = 12, MaxMeanThermal = 6.4 }
	if agg.n > 0 and agg.refused > agg.admitted then
		p.MaxMeanThermal = math.min(7.2, p.MaxMeanThermal + 0.1)
	elseif agg.n > 0 and agg.admitted > agg.refused * 3 then
		p.MaxMeanThermal = math.max(5.6, p.MaxMeanThermal - 0.1)
	end
	return p
end
return M

-- Jade Spirit | Module: H14DoorGate (ModuleScript)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > CodeGateModules > H14DoorGate
-- Taylor's CORE door system, executed live. The 48 nodes partition
-- their 1,128 pairs completely: 944 door pairs + 124 alias pairs +
-- 60 never pairs, carrying 7,140 doors. Two proved rules run here:
-- (1) ALIAS rule -- a pair at Hamming distance 1 is an alias pair:
-- no door is combinatorially possible, so the gate REFUSES it.
-- (2) The 544 identity -- the 17 complementary pairs (a + b = 128)
-- carry exactly 32 doors each, all Floor: the gate ADMITS them.
-- The player's pair is their two most recent husk frees (event A =
-- the node the husk stood on, emitted by Script 4's world through
-- _G.JadeEmitLive("Free", player, node)). Any other pair fails
-- closed until the full 7,140-door table ships as a data module --
-- refusal is the honest default, never a guess.
local function popcount(n)
	local c = 0
	while n > 0 do c += n % 2; n = math.floor(n / 2) end
	return c
end
local M = { Id = "H14Doors", Version = 1, DefaultParams = {} }
function M.Validate(ctx)
	local pair = {}
	for i = #ctx.Recent, 1, -1 do
		local ev = ctx.Recent[i]
		if ev.Kind == "Free" and ev.A then
			pair[#pair + 1] = math.floor(ev.A)
			if #pair == 2 then break end
		end
	end
	if #pair < 2 then
		return { Action = "REFUSE",
			Reason = "bring the gate two freed nodes", Residual = #pair }
	end
	local a, b = pair[1], pair[2]
	if a == b then
		return { Action = "REFUSE", Reason = "a pair needs two nodes", Residual = 0 }
	end
	local dist = popcount(bit32.bxor(a, b))
	if dist == 1 then
		return { Action = "REFUSE",
			Reason = "alias pair -- no door is possible here", Residual = dist }
	end
	if a + b == 128 then
		return { Action = "ADMIT",
			Reason = "complementary pair -- 32 Floor doors", Residual = dist }
	end
	return { Action = "REFUSE",
		Reason = "pair not in the proved set -- the gate does not guess",
		Residual = dist }
end
return M

-- Jade Spirit | Module: CodecFrameGate (ModuleScript)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > CodeGateModules > CodecFrameGate
-- Taylor's RFF codec, executed live: the C(7,48) instance filed as
-- U.S. Prov. 64/170,360. H is 7x48; column j is the j-th binary
-- 7-vector (lexicographic by integer value) with bit 0 set and
-- Hamming weight >= 2 -- every column carries the common bit.
-- At each crossing the gate builds a frame from the player's LIVE
-- record (payload symbol j = the player's swing count at window
-- position j, parity = H x payload), then the world injects the
-- fault the current minute selects: none, a single spike, or a
-- dual spike. Layer 1 decoding is the filed behaviour exactly:
-- clean -> ADMIT; single spike -> REPAIRED and admitted (action
-- REPAIR); dual spike -> REFUSED -- never miscorrected, and the
-- refusal is what the ledger records. Refusal propagates: a refused
-- frame never reaches any second layer.
local COLUMNS = {}
for v = 1, 127 do
	if bit32.band(v, 1) == 1 then
		local w, n = 0, v
		while n > 0 do w += n % 2; n = math.floor(n / 2) end
		if w >= 2 then
			COLUMNS[#COLUMNS + 1] = v
			if #COLUMNS == 48 then break end
		end
	end
end
local function parityOf(payload)
	local p = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
	for j, sym in ipairs(payload) do
		local col = COLUMNS[j]
		for row = 0, 6 do
			if bit32.band(col, bit32.lshift(1, row)) ~= 0 then
				p[row + 1] += sym
			end
		end
	end
	return p
end
local M = { Id = "CodecFrame", Version = 1, DefaultParams = {} }
function M.Validate(ctx)
	local payload = {}
	for j = 1, 48 do payload[j] = 0 end
	local idx = 0
	for _, ev in ipairs(ctx.Recent) do
		if ev.Kind == "Swing" then
			idx += 1
			if idx <= 48 then payload[idx] = (ev.A or 0) % 97 end
		end
	end
	local parity = parityOf(payload)
	local minute = math.floor(ctx.Now / 60)
	local mode = minute % 3
	local received = {}
	for j = 1, 48 do received[j] = payload[j] end
	if mode == 1 then
		received[7] += 5 -- single spike, magnitude 5, column 7
	elseif mode == 2 then
		received[7] += 5 -- dual spike: columns 7 and 19
		received[19] += 3
	end
	-- Syndrome: does any single column explain the difference?
	local diff = {}
	local support = 0
	for j = 1, 48 do
		diff[j] = received[j] - payload[j]
		if diff[j] ~= 0 then support += 1 end
	end
	if support == 0 then
		return { Action = "ADMIT", Reason = "frame clean", Residual = 0 }
	end
	if support == 1 then
		return { Action = "REPAIR",
			Reason = "single spike repaired by syndrome", Residual = 1 }
	end
	return { Action = "REFUSE",
		Reason = "dual-spike event refused -- never miscorrected",
		Residual = support }
end
return M

	end
	local load = math.clamp(swings / 48, 0, 1)
	local power = load * 20 -- watts: 12 core + 8 copper at full load
	local s = state[ctx.UserId]
	if not s then s = { T = p.TAmb, lastNow = ctx.Now }; state[ctx.UserId] = s end
	local dt = math.clamp(ctx.Now - s.lastNow, 0, 30)
	s.lastNow = ctx.Now
	-- Explicit Euler steps of the first-order ODE, 1 s substeps.
	for _ = 1, math.floor(dt) do
		s.T += (power - (s.T - p.TAmb) / p.RTh) / p.CTh
	end
	local steady = p.TAmb + power * p.RTh
	if steady >= p.HardMax then
		return { Action = "REFUSE",
			Reason = "steady state passes the 120 C limit -- cool the core",
			Residual = steady }
	end
	if s.T <= p.BandMax then
		return { Action = "ADMIT", Reason = "core inside the working band",
			Residual = s.T }
	end
	return { Action = "REFUSE", Reason = "core heat-soaked -- rest and retry",
		Residual = s.T }
end

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<roblox version="4">

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 01_GameManager.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > GameManager (Server Script)
-- Creates leaderstats, saves data, gives the Twin Spear on spawn.
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14 has the full audit):
-- * Every number in leaderstats is written by SERVER Scripts only.
--   No RemoteEvent in this game accepts a currency amount from a
--   client -- there is nothing for an exploiter to "fire with a
--   bigger number". If you ever add such a Remote, you own the hole.
-- * Load failure must never become a save. If the DataStore read
--   fails (outage, throttling), the session is flagged and
--   saveData() refuses to run -- otherwise a player who joins
--   during an outage would overwrite a real balance with the
--   0-Shard fallback. Balances are solvency.
-- * Loaded values are clamped to sane ranges before use, so a
--   corrupted or hand-edited save can never mint negative or
--   astronomical currency into the live economy.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_v1")
local MAX_STAGE = 12 -- Checkpoint_1 .. Checkpoint_12 (Script 5)
local function clean(value, fallback, max)
	value = tonumber(value)
	if value == nil or value ~= value then return fallback end -- nil / NaN
	return math.clamp(math.floor(value), 0, max)
end
local function loadData(player)
	-- Up to 3 attempts: a transient DataStore error should not cost
	-- a player their balance OR lock them out of saving for a session.
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			if type(data) == "table" then
				return {
					Shards = clean(data.Shards, 0, 1000000000),
					Blooms = clean(data.Blooms, 0, 100000000),
					Stage  = clean(data.Stage, 0, MAX_STAGE),
				}, true
			end
			return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, true -- new player
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	return { Shards = 0, Blooms = 0, Stage = 0 }, false
end
local function saveData(player)
	if player:GetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled") then return end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local data = {
		Shards = clean(stats.Shards.Value, 0, 1000000000),
		Blooms = clean(stats.Blooms.Value, 0, 100000000),
		Stage  = clean(stats.Stage.Value, 0, MAX_STAGE),
	}
	-- UpdateAsync, not SetAsync: the write is atomic per key, so two
	-- servers can never interleave half a save over the other.
	pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, function()
			return data
		end)
	end)
end
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
	local data, loaded = loadData(player)
	-- Other systems read these two attributes before they grant
	-- anything. DataLoaded=false means "hands off this player's
	-- economy this session" (Script 10 returns NotProcessedYet for
	-- receipts instead of granting into an unloaded balance).
	player:SetAttribute("DataLoaded", loaded)
	player:SetAttribute("DataSaveDisabled", not loaded)
	if not loaded then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] Data load failed for " .. player.Name
			.. " -- playing unsaved this session; balance is protected.")
	end
	local stats = Instance.new("Folder")
	stats.Name = "leaderstats"
	stats.Parent = player
	local shards = Instance.new("IntValue")
	shards.Name = "Shards"
	shards.Value = data.Shards
	shards.Parent = stats
	local blooms = Instance.new("IntValue")
	blooms.Name = "Blooms"
	blooms.Value = data.Blooms
	blooms.Parent = stats
	local stage = Instance.new("IntValue")
	stage.Name = "Stage"
	stage.Value = data.Stage
	stage.Parent = stats
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		-- Give the Twin Spear -- once. Without this check every
		-- respawn stacked another copy in the Backpack (duplication
		-- of a Tool is untidy here and a real exploit in games where
		-- tools can be dropped or sold; the habit matters).
		local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
		if template
			and not player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
			and not character:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear") then
			template:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
		end
		-- Respawn at the player's highest obby checkpoint
		local spawnFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Checkpoints")
		if spawnFolder and stage.Value > 0 then
			local pad = spawnFolder:FindFirstChild("Checkpoint_" .. stage.Value)
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			if pad and root then
				task.wait(0.2)
				root.CFrame = pad.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end
-- Script 10 (Monetization) fires this after a paid grant so the new
-- balance is persisted immediately, not at the next autosave: a
-- server crash in between must not eat a purchase a child paid for.
local saveEvent = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeRequestSave")
if not saveEvent then
	saveEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	saveEvent.Name = "JadeRequestSave"
	saveEvent.Parent = ServerStorage
end
saveEvent.Event:Connect(function(player)
	if typeof(player) == "Instance" and player:IsA("Player") then
		saveData(player)
	end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player) -- late-loading Script safety
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveData)
-- Autosave every 2 minutes
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(120)
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			saveData(player)
		end
	end
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		saveData(player)
	end
end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 03_Pickup.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: Inside any collectable Part (Server Script, ONE per Part)
-- Name the Part "SakuraShard" (+10 Shards) or "CrystalBloom" (+1 Bloom).
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * Touched is physics: a modified client controls its own
--   character's movement and can touch pickups fast, from odd
--   angles, and in bursts. So this handler assumes hostile input:
--   it verifies the toucher is a real player's living character,
--   checks the character is actually at the pickup (server-side
--   distance), and latches a per-part, per-player cooldown BEFORE
--   granting -- in that order, every time.
-- * Exactly ONE copy of this Script per Part. Two copies = two
--   grants per touch. The PickupScriptActive attribute below turns
--   a second pasted copy inert instead of a duplication exploit.
-- * The reward table is a server constant keyed by the Part's own
--   name. A player cannot rename a server Part, so the amount can
--   never arrive from the client.
--
-- SOLVENCY NOTE: the respawn timer IS the faucet rate. One shard
-- point pays at most 10 Shards per 8 seconds = 4,500 Shards/hour.
-- Chapter 6 audits every price in the game against this ceiling.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local part = script.Parent
if part:GetAttribute("PickupScriptActive") then return end
part:SetAttribute("PickupScriptActive", true)
local REWARDS = {
	SakuraShard = { Stat = "Shards", Amount = 10 },
	CrystalBloom = { Stat = "Blooms", Amount = 1 },
}
local reward = REWARDS[part.Name]
if not reward then return end
local RESPAWN_SECONDS = 8
local MAX_TOUCH_DISTANCE = 12 -- HRP to pickup, in studs
local cooldown = {} -- [player] = true while this Part is spent for them
-- Make it pretty: spin and bob
task.spawn(function()
	local start = part.CFrame
	local t = 0
	while part.Parent do
		t += 0.05
		part.CFrame = start * CFrame.new(0, math.sin(t) * 0.4, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, t, 0)
		task.wait()
	end
end)
part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local character = hit and hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	if not player or cooldown[player] then return end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	if (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > MAX_TOUCH_DISTANCE then
		return -- touch claimed from implausibly far away; ignore it
	end
	cooldown[player] = true -- latch BEFORE granting, never after
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if stats and stats:FindFirstChild(reward.Stat) then
		stats[reward.Stat].Value += reward.Amount
	end
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.CanTouch = false
	task.wait(RESPAWN_SECONDS)
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.CanTouch = true
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	cooldown[player] = nil
end)
</ProtectedString>

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 05_Checkpoint.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > CheckpointSystem (ONE Server Script)
-- Setup: Folder in Workspace named "Checkpoints". Inside it, Parts named
-- Checkpoint_1, Checkpoint_2, Checkpoint_3 ... in order along the obby.
-- Make each pad jade green, Material = Neon, CanCollide = true.
--
-- SECURITY NOTE (Chapter 14): progress is SEQUENTIAL now. The first
-- edition saved any higher pad a character touched -- so one lucky
-- glitch, one fling exploit, or one friend's launched character
-- landing on Checkpoint_12 permanently banked the whole obby into
-- the DataStore. This version only ever advances a player by one
-- stage at a time: stage N+1 is accepted, anything further ahead is
-- ignored until the stages between are honestly touched in order.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local folder = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")
for _, pad in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	if pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		local stageNumber = tonumber(string.match(pad.Name, "%d+"))
		if stageNumber then
			pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
				if not player then return end
				local humanoid = hit.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end
				local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
				if not stats then return end
				local current = stats.Stage.Value
				if stageNumber == current + 1 then
					stats.Stage.Value = stageNumber
					local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
					light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 190)
					light.Range = 14
					light.Parent = pad
					task.delay(1, function() light:Destroy() end)
				end
				-- stageNumber <= current: already banked, no-op.
				-- stageNumber > current + 1: a skip. Ignored, and
				-- deliberately not saved -- see the note above.
			end)
		end
	end
end

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 06_ShopAndTeleports.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > ShopAndTeleports (Server Script)
-- Teleports: Parts in Workspace named Teleport_Grove, Teleport_Obby,
-- Teleport_Arena. Touching one moves the player to the matching
-- SpawnLocation named Spawn_Grove, Spawn_Obby, Spawn_Arena.
-- Earn-shop: a Part named "ShopPad" in the Grove sells ONE earn-only
-- cosmetic, the Grove Trail, for Shards earned in play.
--
-- SECURITY / SOLVENCY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * ProximityPrompt.Triggered hands the server a player object, but
--   a modified client can fire prompts from across the map. Every
--   prompt handler in this game therefore re-checks, on the server,
--   that the player's character is genuinely within reach of the
--   pad before money moves. Distance is checked here, in the quest
--   Script 7, and at the spirit form shrine in Script 8.
-- * Ownership lives on the PLAYER, not the character (the first
--   edition stored it on the character, so it vanished on respawn
--   and the same trail could be charged for again and again -- a
--   shard drain for honest players). It is checked before charging,
--   and the charge + grant happen back-to-back with no yield
--   between them, so the prompt cannot be double-fired mid-sale.
-- * The Robux Petal Trail PACK is a different item, sold only by
--   Script 10. Nothing sold for Shards here is also sold for Robux:
--   one item, one currency, one seller -- see the audit in Ch. 6.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local function characterNear(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end
local DESTINATIONS = {
	Teleport_Grove = "Spawn_Grove",
	Teleport_Obby = "Spawn_Obby",
	Teleport_Arena = "Spawn_Arena",
}
local teleportCooldown = {} -- [player] = true for 1s after a hop
for partName, spawnName in pairs(DESTINATIONS) do
	local pad = workspace:WaitForChild(partName, 10)
	local spawn = workspace:WaitForChild(spawnName, 10)
	if pad and spawn then
		pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
			local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if not player or teleportCooldown[player] then return end
			local root = hit.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not root then return end
			teleportCooldown[player] = true
			root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			task.delay(1, function() teleportCooldown[player] = nil end)
		end)
	end
end
-- Earn-only cosmetic shop: Grove Trail for 500 Shards (play-earned)
local TRAIL_PRICE = 500
local shopPad = workspace:WaitForChild("ShopPad", 10)
if shopPad then
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = "Buy Grove Trail (" .. TRAIL_PRICE .. " Shards)"
	prompt.ObjectText = "Jade Spirit Shop"
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.5
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
	prompt.Parent = shopPad
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if not characterNear(player, shopPad, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then
			return -- prompt fired from out of reach: not a sale
		end
		local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local character = player.Character
		if not stats or not character then return end
		if player:GetAttribute("OwnsGroveTrail") then return end -- own it: never charge twice
		if stats.Shards.Value < TRAIL_PRICE then return end
		-- Charge and grant together, with no yield between: a second
		-- Triggered arriving in the same frame sees the attribute set.
		stats.Shards.Value -= TRAIL_PRICE
		player:SetAttribute("OwnsGroveTrail", true)
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local waist = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or root
		if root and waist then
			local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment", root)
			local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment", waist)
			local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
			trail.Name = "GroveTrail"
			trail.Attachment0 = a0
			trail.Attachment1 = a1
			trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 170))
			trail.Lifetime = 0.6
			trail.Parent = character
		end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	teleportCooldown[player] = nil
end)

        <Properties>
          <string name="Name">QuestGiver</string>
          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 07_QuestGiver.server.lua  (HARDENED)
-- Location: Inside the Jade Spirit NPC Model in the Grove (Server Script)
-- NPC setup: Model named "JadeSpiritNPC" with HumanoidRootPart.
-- Quest: Free 3 Thorn Husks, earn 150 Shards. This Script creates
-- its own ProximityPrompt on the NPC.
--
-- SECURITY NOTES (Chapter 14):
-- * The prompt handler re-checks distance on the server before any
--   quest state or currency moves (prompts can be fired remotely
--   by modified clients -- see Script 6's note).
-- * The reward is a server constant, paid once: completion latches
--   the player's state to DONE in the same handler run, before the
--   Shards are added, so a double-fired prompt in the same frame
--   sees a completed quest and pays nothing the second time.
-- * _G.JadeQuestAdd is a server-only bridge (only server Scripts
--   share _G; a client has no path to it). It still validates its
--   inputs: the target must have an ACTIVE quest and the amount is
--   clamped to 1 per call, so no caller -- ours or a future one --
--   can fast-forward a quest with a giant number.
-- * Progress is per-session by design (persisting it is Chapter
--   13's update). The reward gate means the 150 Shards can be
--   earned at most once per session, and only after 3 real frees.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local npc = script.Parent
local root = npc:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
prompt.ActionText = "Talk"
prompt.ObjectText = "Jade Spirit"
prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 12
prompt.Parent = root
local QUEST_GOAL = 3
local QUEST_REWARD = 150
local progress = {} -- [player] = number of frees, or "DONE"
prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local cRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not cRoot then return end
	if (cRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
		> prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4 then
		return -- fired from out of reach: not a conversation
	end
	local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not stats then return end
	local state = progress[player]
	if state == nil then
		progress[player] = 0
		print(player.Name .. " accepted: Free 3 Thorn Husks in the Grove!")
	elseif state == "DONE" then
		print(player.Name .. " has already completed the Grove quest.")
	elseif state >= QUEST_GOAL then
		progress[player] = "DONE" -- latch BEFORE paying: no double pay
		stats.Shards.Value += QUEST_REWARD
		print(player.Name .. " completed the Grove quest! +" .. QUEST_REWARD .. " Shards")
	else
		print(player.Name .. " quest progress: " .. state .. " / " .. QUEST_GOAL)
	end
end)
-- Called by Script 4 (ThornHusk) when a husk is freed:
--   if _G.JadeQuestAdd then _G.JadeQuestAdd(player, 1) end
_G.JadeQuestAdd = function(player, amount)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return end
	local state = progress[player]
	if typeof(state) ~= "number" then return end -- no active quest
	progress[player] = state + math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 1)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	progress[player] = nil
end)
</ProtectedString>

      <Item class="Script" referent="RBX8">
        <Properties>
          <string name="Name">HeadlessSpirit</string>
          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 08_HeadlessSpirit.server.lua  (EXCLUSIVE VERSION)
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it HeadlessSpirit
-- What it does: gives ONE named player -- and nobody else -- the
-- Headless Jade Spirit form: the real body is hidden, NO skull form is
-- added (that empty head slot is what makes her truly headless), and a
-- pale-jade neon form rig is welded onto the R15 body so she walks,
-- jumps, climbs, and thrusts the spear as a jade spirit form, with her
-- pink Spirit Bow floating where the head would be.
-- DEFINITIVE DESIGN (Chapter 36): clean jade crystal, NO moss, the
-- Gold Dragon worn as a scarf (Script 39's Scarf Rest), and ONE
-- double-sized angel wing on her back (the DefinitiveWing form
-- part below). No clothes: the wing is the outfit.
--
-- ============================================================
-- EXCLUSIVE -- READ THIS BEFORE YOU PASTE ANYTHING ELSE
-- ============================================================
-- * This form is a private family gift. It is NOT a Game Pass, NOT a
--   Developer Product, NOT in the shop, and it must never be added
--   to one. There is no product ID for it anywhere in this package.
-- * The only key is the UserId check below, on the SERVER. A player
--   cannot edit a server Script, fire the RemoteEvent all day, or
--   copy the shop GUI and get in -- toggle() checks first, every time.
--
-- WHY THE LOCK CANNOT BE SPOOFED (Chapter 14):
-- * player.UserId is assigned by Roblox's own backend when the
--   account joins. It is not sent by the client, not read from the
--   character, and cannot be changed by any Script at runtime.
--   DisplayName and Name ARE copyable -- which is why this
--   lock never looks at them.
-- * OnServerEvent's first argument is the Player object ROBLOX
--   supplies for the connection that fired the event. An exploiter
--   firing FireServer(herPlayerObject) changes nothing: extra
--   arguments are ignored, and the event still arrives labelled
--   with the EXPLOITER's own player object, which fails the check.
-- * The check is recomputed from UserId on EVERY toggle. No
--   attribute, BoolValue, GUI state, or "already unlocked" flag is
--   ever trusted -- attributes a client can influence are treated
--   as decoration by every Script in this game.
-- * Toggles are rate-limited to one per second per player, so even
--   the owner spamming the event (or an exploiter spamming it in
--   her name -- which still fails the check) cannot clone rigs
--   fast enough to lag the server.
-- * The SpiritRig template lives in ServerStorage, which clients
--   cannot see or copy. If it is ever moved to ReplicatedStorage
--   or Workspace, its shapes become public -- keep it in
--   ServerStorage.
-- * FAIL CLOSED: while EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID is still 0, NOBODY can use
--   the form -- not even the game owner. That is on purpose, so a
--   half-finished setup can never leak it to everyone by accident.
--
-- SET THE ID (one minute, do it before publishing):
--   1. Log in as your daughter on roblox.com and open her profile.
--   2. The address bar reads roblox.com/users/<NUMBER>/profile --
--      that number is her UserId. It never changes, even if her
--      display name or username does. (Usernames can be copied by
--      other players. UserIds cannot. That is why the lock uses it.)
--   3. Put that number in place of the 0 on the next line, AND in
--      Script 9 in the same place. Script 9's copy only hides the
--      button for everyone else -- this server copy is the real lock.
-- ============================================================
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE 0 with your daughter's UserId
local function isExclusiveOwner(player)
	return EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID
end
-- Her spirit form: pale jade, glowing -- a body of living jade
-- light, solid and smooth, with no head: the form is the First
-- Guardian's, and it is hers and hers only.
local SPIRIT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(168, 235, 203)
local SPIRIT_MATERIAL = Enum.Material.Neon
-- Form part name in SpiritRig -> R15 body Part it welds to.
-- THERE IS DELIBERATELY NO HEAD PART IN THIS LIST.

--      LATER session reads an empty ledger -- is named in Chapter

--      record on any platform, and redelivery is rare by design.
local receiptStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeSpirit_Receipts_v1")

MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receiptInfo)

	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if receiptInfo.PlaceIdWherePurchased ~= game.PlaceId then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	if player:GetAttribute("DataLoaded") ~= true then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end

	-- table is NOT rejected here: it may belong to a routed
	-- catalogue (Script 49's tickets, Script 51's skins). Routing is
	-- decided at grant time, AFTER the ledger read below, so a
	-- redelivered routed receipt is absorbed by the ledger exactly
	-- like any other -- never granted twice.

		return receiptStore:GetAsync("receipt_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId)
	end)
	if not readOk then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if prior then
		processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	local grantOk, err = pcall(function()
		if product then
			product.Grant(player, receiptInfo.ProductId)
		else
			-- Routed products (Chapters 46, 47, 52): each grant
			-- answers true only for its own product IDs, so an ID
			-- nobody owns errors here and the receipt fails closed
			-- (NotProcessedYet) instead of granting on trust.
			local routed = (_G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket
				and _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket(player, receiptInfo.ProductId) == true)
				or (_G.JadeVaultGrantSkin
				and _G.JadeVaultGrantSkin(player, receiptInfo.ProductId) == true)

				error("unknown ProductId " .. tostring(receiptInfo.ProductId))
			end
		end
	end)
	if not grantOk then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] Product grant failed: " .. tostring(err))
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local writeOk = pcall(function()
		receiptStore:SetAsync("receipt_" .. receiptInfo.PurchaseId, {
			PlayerId = receiptInfo.PlayerId,
			ProductId = receiptInfo.ProductId,
		})
	end)
	if not writeOk then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	processedThisSession[receiptInfo.PurchaseId] = true
	requestSave(player)
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

-- ---------- counting: the ONLY door thrusts enter through -----------
local VALID_SOURCES = { Tree = true, Husk = true, Arena = true }
local lastPairCount = {} -- ["attackerId:targetId"] = clock, arena anti-farm
-- ---------- thrust multipliers (Robux passes, Chapter 21) ------------
-- One-time Game Passes: while owned, each connecting thrust REGISTERS
-- as N thrusts toward BOTH of the player's counts: Lifetime and
-- the independent Spend Balance, credited side by side at this
-- single registration point. Design decisions, all deliberate:
-- * HIGHEST OWNED APPLIES. Factors never stack or multiply together:
--   owning 2x and 10x is 10x, not 20x. One number, auditable.
-- * The factor is applied HERE, at the single registration point,
--   by the server, from ownership re-verified against Roblox's own
--   records (UserOwnsGamePassAsync) -- never from a client value,
--   an attribute a client can influence, or Script 10's say-so.
-- * The GLOBAL Tree total counts raw physical thrusts (1 per thrust)
--   whatever the thruster's factor: communal milestones measure what
--   the world actually did, and the Tree sign stays literally true.
-- * Multipliers touch nothing else: not damage (Script 2 never reads

--   faster -- disclosed in Chapters 20 and 21), and NEVER the
--   exclusive spirit form, which has no interaction with this system.
local MULTIPLIER_PASSES = { -- highest first
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 10 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 5 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 3 },
	{ Id = 0, Factor = 2 },

				return MarketplaceService:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(player.UserId, pass.Id)

	if not record then return end

			return -- claimed a Tree hit from somewhere else entirely
		end

		-- once per second, however fast the two of you thrust.

			local key = player.UserId .. ":" .. targetPlayer.UserId

			lastPairCount[key] = now

	refreshSign()
end
-- ---------- economy APIs: how thrusts leave and arrive --------------
-- Spending NEVER touches Lifetime: ranks, titles and milestones are

function _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, amount, _reason)
	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end
	amount = math.floor(tonumber(amount) or 0)
	if amount <= 0 then return false end

function _G.JadeGrantBonus(player, amount, _reason)

	if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") then return false end

function _G.JadeGrantItem(player, itemKey, count)

	if not record then return false end

function _G.JadeGetLifetime(player)

	local record = personal[player]

end
function _G.JadeGetItem(player, itemKey)

-- Pet records (Chapter 23): pets are INDIVIDUALS, not counts, so

function _G.JadeGetBalance(player)

local function flushGlobal()
	if globalPending <= 0 then return end

		return store:UpdateAsync("global_total", function(old)
			return (tonumber(old) or 0) + delta

	end)

	-- retries them: counted thrusts are never silently dropped, and
	-- UpdateAsync means two servers can never overwrite each other.

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 15_Leaderboard.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Leaderboard
-- What it does: the public thrust leaderboard (Chapter 18) -- an
-- in-world board by the Great Blossom Tree (top 10) and a UI feed of
-- the top 100, both ranked by LIFETIME thrusts from Script 13's
-- records, persisted through an OrderedDataStore.
--
-- INTEGRITY MODEL:
-- * The OrderedDataStore is written ONLY here, ONLY from Script 13's
--   server-side records (read via the ThrustTotal attribute Script 13
--   sets from its own DataStore-backed record). No client sends a
--   number: the UI's RemoteFunction takes no arguments and returns
--   a cached, read-only table. An exploiter can ask "what are the
--   rankings?" as often as they like. That is the entire surface.
-- * Writes are throttled: a player's entry is rewritten at most once
--   per REFRESH_SECONDS and only when their lifetime has grown, so
--   the board cannot be used to burn the DataStore budget.
-- * NOBODY is special-cased. There is no allowlist, boost, seed, or
--   family entry anywhere in this Script: the daughter's name
--   appears exactly when her own counted thrusts put it there, at
--   the rank those thrusts earn, under the same title ladder as
--   every other player. That is the design, stated in Chapter 18.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ranks = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("JadeThrustRanks_v1")
local REFRESH_SECONDS = 60
local BOARD_ROWS = 10
local UI_ROWS = 100
local TITLES = { -- by lifetime thrusts; shared with Chapter 18
	{ At = 25000, Title = "Eternal Guardian" },
	{ At = 10000, Title = "Blossom Legend" },
	{ At = 5000,  Title = "Jade Master" },
	{ At = 2500,  Title = "Petal Storm" },
	{ At = 1000,  Title = "Blossom Knight" },
	{ At = 500,   Title = "Spear Dancer" },
	{ At = 250,   Title = "Bloom Keeper" },
	{ At = 100,   Title = "Petal Thruster" },
	{ At = 0,     Title = "Sprout" },
}
local function titleFor(thrusts)
	for _, t in ipairs(TITLES) do
		if thrusts >= t.At then return t.Title end
	end
	return "Sprout"
end
local nameCache = {} -- [userId] = display name
local function nameFor(userId)
	if nameCache[userId] then return nameCache[userId] end
	local ok, name = pcall(function()
		return Players:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(userId)
	end)
	name = ok and name or ("Player " .. userId)
	nameCache[userId] = name
	return name
end
local boardCache = {} -- ranked rows: {UserId, Name, Thrusts, Title}
local cacheClock = 0
local function rebuildBoard()
	local ok, pages = pcall(function()
		return ranks:GetSortedAsync(false, UI_ROWS)
	end)
	if not ok or not pages then return end
	local rows = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(pages:GetCurrentPage()) do
		local userId = tonumber(entry.key)
		local thrusts = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(entry.value) or 0))
		if userId and thrusts > 0 then
			table.insert(rows, {
				UserId = userId,
				Name = nameFor(userId),
				Thrusts = thrusts,
				Title = titleFor(thrusts),
			})
		end
	end
	boardCache = rows
	cacheClock = os.clock()
end
-- ---------- in-world board -----------------------------------------
local boardLabel = nil
do
	local board = workspace:WaitForChild("LeaderboardBoard", 15)
	local face = board and board:FindFirstChild("BoardFace")
	if face and face:IsA("BasePart") then
		local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
		gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
		gui.Parent = face
		boardLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		boardLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		boardLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 22, 28)
		boardLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 235)
		boardLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		boardLabel.TextScaled = true
		boardLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
		boardLabel.Parent = gui
	end
end
local function refreshBoardDisplay()
	if not boardLabel then return end
	local lines = { "BLOSSOM THRUST LEADERBOARD" }
	for i = 1, math.min(BOARD_ROWS, #boardCache) do
		local r = boardCache[i]
		lines[#lines + 1] = i .. ". " .. r.Name .. " — " .. r.Thrusts .. " (" .. r.Title .. ")"
	end
	if #boardCache == 0 then
		lines[#lines + 1] = "No thrusts yet — be the first."
	end
	boardLabel.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
-- ---------- UI feed: read-only, argument-free, cached --------------
local fetchFunction = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeLeaderboardFetch")
if not fetchFunction then
	fetchFunction = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
	fetchFunction.Name = "JadeLeaderboardFetch"
	fetchFunction.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
fetchFunction.OnServerInvoke = function(_player)
	-- The invoker's identity is irrelevant: everyone gets the same
	-- public table, and the cache caps how often it is rebuilt.
	if os.clock() - cacheClock > REFRESH_SECONDS then rebuildBoard() end
	return boardCache
end
-- ---------- keeping the store honest --------------------------------
local lastWritten = {} -- [userId] = lifetime last written to the store
local function writePlayer(player)
	local total = _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
	if total > 0 and total ~= lastWritten[player.UserId] then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			ranks:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), total)
		end)
		if ok then lastWritten[player.UserId] = total end
	end
end
task.spawn(function()
	rebuildBoard()
	refreshBoardDisplay()
	while true do
		task.wait(REFRESH_SECONDS)
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do writePlayer(p) end
		rebuildBoard()
		refreshBoardDisplay()
	end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	writePlayer(player)
end)
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do writePlayer(p) end
end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 16_ArenaSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ArenaSystem
-- What it does: everything about the Blossom Arena EXCEPT the thrusts
-- themselves (Chapter 17). Script 2 decides whether a thrust lands --
-- including its rule that player targets only count inside the arena
-- cylinder. This Script owns: entry healing, spawn protection, KO
-- credit, arena respawn, and the session KO/fall tallies.
--
-- FAIR-PLAY INVARIANTS (they hold because of where code lives):
-- * Damage, range, cooldown, and knockback are constants in
--   Script 2. This Script cannot change them, the shop cannot sell
--   anything that changes them, and no attribute set by any
--   monetization Script is read by either. A Golden spear and a
--   Wood spear are the same weapon here; only the picture differs.
-- * KOs mint NOTHING. No thrusts (the thrusts that landed were
--   already counted by Script 13 when they connected), no currency,
--   no items. The tally below is a session scoreboard, not a bank.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ARENA_RADIUS = 55
local PROTECTION_SECONDS = 3
local function arenaCenter()
	local center = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaCenter")
	return center and center:IsA("BasePart") and center or nil
end
local function inArena(root)
	local center = arenaCenter()
	if not center or not root then return false end
	local offset = root.Position - center.Position
	return math.sqrt(offset.X * offset.X + offset.Z * offset.Z) <= ARENA_RADIUS
		and math.abs(offset.Y) <= 25
end
local tallies = {} -- [player] = { KOs = n, Falls = n }
local function publish(player)
	local t = tallies[player]
	if not t then return end
	player:SetAttribute("ArenaKOs", t.KOs)
	player:SetAttribute("ArenaFalls", t.Falls)
end
local function watchCharacter(player, character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	-- Entering the arena (teleported in by the gate pad, Script 6's
	-- destinations include Spawn_ArenaLobby; the bowl entry pad is
	-- below) starts every fight at full health with protection on.
	task.spawn(function()
		local wasIn = false
		while character.Parent and humanoid.Health > 0 do
			local isIn = inArena(root)
			if isIn and not wasIn then
				humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth
				player:SetAttribute("ArenaProtectedUntil", os.clock() + PROTECTION_SECONDS)
			end
			player:SetAttribute("InBlossomArena", isIn)
			wasIn = isIn
			task.wait(0.4)
		end
		player:SetAttribute("InBlossomArena", false)
	end)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if not inArena(root) then return end
		local t = tallies[player]
		if t then
			t.Falls += 1
			publish(player)
		end
		-- KO credit: read the creator tag Script 2 stamped on this
		-- Humanoid with its last connecting thrust. It must name a
		-- DIFFERENT living player; anything else credits nobody.
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
		local killer = tag and tag.Value
		if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer ~= player
			and tallies[killer] then
			tallies[killer].KOs += 1
			publish(killer)
		end
		-- Respawn at the arena lobby, not the Grove: flag it, and
		-- the CharacterAdded path below moves the new character.
		player:SetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby", true)
	end)
end
local function setupPlayer(player)
	tallies[player] = { KOs = 0, Falls = 0 }
	publish(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		watchCharacter(player, character)
		if player:GetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby") then
			player:SetAttribute("RespawnAtArenaLobby", false)
			local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_ArenaLobby")
			local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
			if lobby and root then
				task.wait(0.2)
				root.CFrame = lobby.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
			end
		end
	end)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	task.spawn(setupPlayer, player)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	tallies[player] = nil
end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 18_ThrustShop.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ThrustShop
-- What it does: the in-game shop, where the ONLY currency is thrusts
-- (Chapter 19). Item stands are Parts in the world named
-- "ThrustShop_<ItemKey>"; each gets a ProximityPrompt showing its
-- price in thrusts. Gardens: Parts "GardenPlot_1" .. "GardenPlot_4",
-- where seeds are planted, grow, and are harvested for bouquets.
--
-- HOW A PURCHASE WORKS (and why it cannot be cheated):
-- * The prompt handler re-checks distance on the server (Script 6's
--   lesson), looks the price up in the server CATALOG below -- the
--   client names nothing but which stand it touched, and it does
--   not even do that: the handler is bound to the Part itself.
-- * Payment is Script 13's JadeSpendThrusts, which checks the
--   player's Balance (Lifetime + Bonus - Spent) and moves Spent.
--   Lifetime is never reduced, so buying can never cost a player a
--   rank, a title, a zone, or a milestone (Chapter 20).
-- * Unlock gates read Lifetime via JadeGetLifetime: some goods
--   cannot be bought before the player has DONE enough, however
--   rich their unspent balance is. Money (Robux) appears nowhere
--   in this Script; Robux passes live in Scripts 10/11 and sell
--   different, cosmetic-only goods.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CATALOG = {
	-- Pets are NOT sold here any more: Chapter 23 gives them eggs,
	-- events, merges, and one dedication grant instead. A pet with a
	-- price tag was the old design; this catalogue sells goods.
	-- Seeds (consumable -- the economy's repeat sink)
	SakuraSeed  = { Label = "Sakura Seed",            Price = 150,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Seed" },
	JadeMelonSeed = { Label = "Jade Melon Seed",      Price = 600,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Seed" },
	PearlSeed   = { Label = "Pearl Seed",             Price = 900,   Gate = 100000, Kind = "Seed" },
	MoonflowerSeed = { Label = "Moonflower Seed",     Price = 1800,  Gate = 50000,  Kind = "Seed" },
	StormSeed   = { Label = "Storm Seed",             Price = 4500,  Gate = 500000, Kind = "Seed" },
	EternalSeed = { Label = "Eternal Seed",           Price = 12000, Gate = 1000000, Kind = "Seed" },
	-- Cosmetics (own once)
	GroveTrail  = { Label = "Grove Trail",            Price = 500,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	PetalHat    = { Label = "Petal Hat",              Price = 800,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	SakuraScarf = { Label = "Sakura Scarf",           Price = 1200,  Gate = 0,      Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	BlossomWings = { Label = "Blossom Wings",         Price = 6000,  Gate = 2500,   Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	GoldenCrown = { Label = "Golden Crown",           Price = 15000, Gate = 5000,   Kind = "Cosmetic" },
	-- Consumables
	SpiritIncense = { Label = "Spirit Incense",       Price = 25,    Gate = 0,      Kind = "Consumable" },
	BouquetBox  = { Label = "Bouquet Box (decor)",    Price = 300,   Gate = 0,      Kind = "Consumable" },
}
-- Garden plots are sold by their own prompts below, not stands:
local PLOTS = { -- [plotNumber] = {Price, Gate}
	[2] = { Price = 2500, Gate = 500 },
	[3] = { Price = 6000, Gate = 2500 },
	[4] = { Price = 14000, Gate = 10000 },
}
local function near(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance
end
local SEED_ORDER = { "EternalSeed", "StormSeed", "MoonflowerSeed", "HollowSeed", "PearlSeed", "JadeMelonSeed", "SakuraSeed" }
local SEED_COLORS = {
	SakuraSeed = Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203),
	JadeMelonSeed = Color3.fromRGB(94, 214, 165),
	PearlSeed = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 235),
	MoonflowerSeed = Color3.fromRGB(170, 190, 255),
	HollowSeed = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 190), -- Hollow drop only; never sold
	StormSeed = Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 255),
	EternalSeed = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 90),
}
local GROW_SECONDS = 300
local function ownedCount(player, key)
	return _G.JadeGetItem and _G.JadeGetItem(player, key) or 0
end
-- ---------- item stands ---------------------------------------------
for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and string.sub(part.Name, 1, 10) == "ThrustShop_" then
		local key = string.sub(part.Name, 11)
		local item = CATALOG[key]
		if item then
			local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
			prompt.ActionText = "Buy — " .. item.Price .. " thrusts"
			prompt.ObjectText = item.Label
			prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
			prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
			prompt.Parent = part
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				if not near(player, part, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then return end
				if (_G.JadeGetLifetime(player)) < item.Gate then return end
				if item.Kind == "Cosmetic"
					and ownedCount(player, key) >= 1 then
					return -- own-once goods are never charged for twice
				end
				if _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, item.Price, key) then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, key, 1)
				end
				-- A failed spend (balance short) does nothing at all:
				-- no partial charge, no debt, no item.
			end)
		end
	end
end
-- ---------- garden plots ---------------------------------------------
local plotState = {} -- [part] = { Owner, SeedKey, ReadyAt, Flower }
local function clearFlower(part)
	local st = plotState[part]
	if st and st.Flower then st.Flower:Destroy() end
	plotState[part] = nil
end
local function growFlower(part, seedKey, owner)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "GardenFlower"
	local stem = Instance.new("Part")
	stem.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 3, 0.3)
	stem.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 140, 80)
	stem.Anchored = true
	stem.CanCollide = false
	stem.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	stem.Parent = model
	local bloom = Instance.new("Part")
	bloom.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	bloom.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	bloom.Color = SEED_COLORS[seedKey] or Color3.fromRGB(255, 154, 203)
	bloom.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
	bloom.Anchored = true
	bloom.CanCollide = false
	bloom.Position = part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.4, 0)
	bloom.Parent = model
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end
for i = 1, 4 do
	local plot = workspace:FindFirstChild("GardenPlot_" .. i)
	if plot and plot:IsA("BasePart") then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Use Garden Plot"
		prompt.ObjectText = "Garden Plot " .. i
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0.4
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 10
		prompt.Parent = plot
		prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
			if not near(player, plot, prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 4) then return end
			local st = plotState[plot]
			if st then
				-- Occupied: only the planter harvests, only when ripe.
				if st.Owner == player and os.clock() >= st.ReadyAt then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "Bouquet", 1)
					clearFlower(plot)
				end
				return
			end
			-- Empty: plots 2-4 must be bought first (once, forever).
			if i > 1 and ownedCount(player, "GardenPlot" .. i) < 1 then
				local spec = PLOTS[i]
				if _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) >= spec.Gate
					and _G.JadeSpendThrusts(player, spec.Price, "GardenPlot" .. i) then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, "GardenPlot" .. i, 1)
				end
				return
			end
			-- Plant the best seed the player is carrying.
			for _, seedKey in ipairs(SEED_ORDER) do
				if ownedCount(player, seedKey) >= 1 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(player, seedKey, -1)
					plotState[plot] = {
						Owner = player,
						SeedKey = seedKey,
						ReadyAt = os.clock() + GROW_SECONDS,
						Flower = growFlower(plot, seedKey, player),
					}
					return
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	for part, st in pairs(plotState) do
		if st.Owner == player then clearFlower(part) end
	end
end)
