          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 19_ZoneGates.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it ZoneGates
-- What it does: the world ladder (Chapter 20). Each gated zone is
-- reached ONLY through its gate pad -- Parts named "ZoneGate_<Key>"
-- beside a decorative gateway (torii, portal ring, moon gate) --
-- because the zones themselves are separate islands with no walk-in
-- path. A gate opens for a player whose LIFETIME thrusts meet the
-- threshold, and teleports them to "Spawn_<Key>".
--
-- THE ONE RULE THAT MAKES THIS FAIR:
-- * Gates read Lifetime, through Script 13's JadeGetLifetime, and
--   nothing else. This Script contains no reference to Balance,
--   Spent, or Bonus -- spending every thrust you own cannot re-lock
--   a single gate, and a rich balance cannot open one early.
-- * The check is recomputed on the server at every crossing attempt
--   from the economy record itself. Gate visuals (Script 20) are
--   client decoration: a gate that LOOKS open to a tampered client
--   still teleports nobody the record says is short.
-- * Zone defence in depth: a slow monitor also checks gated-zone
--   regions. A player found inside a zone their Lifetime does not
--   unlock -- flown, flung, or glitched there -- is returned to the
--   Grove. Access is a server fact, not a doorway.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local GATES = { -- order matters: the ladder, low to high
	{ Key = "SkyCanopy",    Name = "Sky Canopy",          Required = 1000,    GateKind = "Cloud Torii" },
	{ Key = "CrystalDeep",  Name = "Crystal Deep",        Required = 10000,   GateKind = "Crystal Portal" },
	{ Key = "HollowGrove",  Name = "The Hollow Grove",    Required = 25000,   GateKind = "Thorn Gate" },
	{ Key = "MoonlitForest", Name = "Moonlit Bamboo Forest", Required = 50000, GateKind = "Moon Torii" },
	{ Key = "KoiGrotto",    Name = "Sunken Koi Grotto",   Required = 100000,  GateKind = "Waterfall Portal" },
	{ Key = "Stormspire",   Name = "Stormspire Peaks",    Required = 500000,  GateKind = "Storm Arch" },
	{ Key = "Sanctum",      Name = "Eternal Blossom Sanctum", Required = 1000000, GateKind = "Golden Portal" },
}
local ZONE_RADIUS = 130
local deniedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeZoneDenied")
if not deniedEvent then
	deniedEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	deniedEvent.Name = "JadeZoneDenied"
	deniedEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local unlockedEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeZoneUnlocked")
if not unlockedEvent then
	unlockedEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	unlockedEvent.Name = "JadeZoneUnlocked"
	unlockedEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local function lifetimeOf(player)
	return _G.JadeGetLifetime and _G.JadeGetLifetime(player) or 0
end
local function near(player, part, maxDistance)
	local character = player and player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false, nil end
	return (root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude <= maxDistance, root
end
for _, gate in ipairs(GATES) do
	local pad = workspace:FindFirstChild("ZoneGate_" .. gate.Key)
	local spawn = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawn_" .. gate.Key)
	if pad and spawn then
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 29_HollowGrove.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it HollowGrove
-- What it does: the Hollow Grove (Chapter 25) -- a corrupted island
-- where Thorn Skeletons rise in waves and experienced Keepers farm
-- them. Unlock: 25,000 lifetime thrusts, through Script 19's gate.
-- Skeletons that escape the Hollow are also the corruption that
-- assaults the Great Blossom Tree itself (Script 13 runs those
-- events); this zone is where the corruption lives.
--
-- RISK AND REWARD, IN THE OPEN:
-- * A skeleton laid to rest pays its killer BONUS thrusts (Balance only) --
--   the fastest balance faucet in the game, priced in Chapter 25.
--   It pays the killer named by Script 2's creator tag, once, from
--   this Script. Kills never touch Lifetime: the thrusts that landed
--   were already counted when they connected. Farming here fills a
--   wallet; it cannot forge a history.
-- * Skeletons HURT: their strike is real damage, waves scale, and a
--   fall restarts your wave progress in spirit if not in code --
--   you respawn at the lobby and run back in while the wave you
--   left keeps coming. High risk, high reward, no death tax:
--   nothing is taken from a player who falls. Ever.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local ZONE_CENTER = workspace:WaitForChild("ZoneCenter_HollowGrove", 15)
local ZONE_RADIUS = 130
local TEMPLATE_NAME = "ThornSkeletonTemplate"
local INTERMISSION = 15
local MAX_ALIVE = 24
local wave = 0
local alive = {} -- [model] = { Humanoid, Root, LastBite }
local waveActive = false
local zoneOccupied = false
local function inZone(root)
	if not ZONE_CENTER or not root then return false end
	return (root.Position - ZONE_CENTER.Position).Magnitude <= ZONE_RADIUS
end
local function playersInZone()
	local list = {}
	for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local root = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and inZone(root) then table.insert(list, p) end
	end
	return list
end
local function killReward(waveNumber)
	return 6 + waveNumber -- bonus thrusts to the killer
end
local function isBossWave(n)
	return n % 5 == 0
end
local function spawnSkeleton(waveNumber, boss)
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild(TEMPLATE_NAME)
	if not template then
		warn("[Jade Spirit] ThornSkeletonTemplate missing in ServerStorage (Chapter 25, build steps).")
		return nil
	end
	local skel = template:Clone()
	skel.Name = "HollowSkeleton"
	local humanoid = skel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = skel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root then skel:Destroy() return nil end
	local hp = (boss and 400 or 50) + 25 * (waveNumber - 1) * (boss and 2 or 1)
	humanoid.MaxHealth = hp
	humanoid.Health = hp
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = boss and 11 or 9 + math.min(5, waveNumber * 0.3)
	humanoid:SetAttribute("IsThornHusk", true) -- Script 2 can hit it
	humanoid:SetAttribute("IsHollowSkeleton", true)

	local dist = math.random(30, 70)

	alive[skel] = { Humanoid = humanoid, Root = root, LastBite = 0, Boss = boss }
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		local entry = alive[skel]
		alive[skel] = nil
		-- Pay the killer Script 2's tag names, re-validated.
		local tag = humanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
		local killer = tag and tag.Value
		if killer and killer:IsA("Player") and killer.Parent then
			_G.JadeGrantBonus(killer, killReward(wave), "SkeletonKill")
			if _G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence then
				_G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence(killer, entry and entry.Boss and 15 or 2, "SkeletonKill")
			end
			-- Exclusive drops (Chapter 25): the Hollow provides.
			local roll = math.random()
			if entry and entry.Boss then
				_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "HollowSeed", 1)
				if roll < 0.12 and _G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence then
					_G.JadeGrantSusanooEssence(killer, 25, "BossDrop")
				elseif roll < 0.37 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "BoneBow", 1)
				end
			else
				if roll < 0.04 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "HollowSeed", 1)
				elseif roll < 0.05 then
					_G.JadeGrantItem(killer, "HollowCharm", 1)
				end
			end
		end
		-- Burst of dark petals: corruption coming apart.
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			local petal = Instance.new("Part")
			petal.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			petal.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.14, 0.5)
			petal.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 60, 110)
			petal.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			petal.CanCollide = false
			petal.CanTouch = false
			petal.CanQuery = false
			petal.CFrame = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
			petal.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random(-6, 6), math.random(5, 11), math.random(-6, 6))
			petal.Parent = workspace
			Debris:AddItem(petal, 1.2)
		end
		task.delay(0.3, function() skel:Destroy() end)
	end)
	return skel
end
-- ---------- wave director ---------------------------------------------
local function aliveCount()
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(alive) do n += 1 end
	return n
end
local function startWave()
	wave += 1
	waveActive = true
	local count = math.min(4 + wave * 2, MAX_ALIVE)
	for i = 1, count do
		task.delay(i * 0.7, function()
			if zoneOccupied then spawnSkeleton(wave, false) end
		end)
	end
	if isBossWave(wave) then
		task.delay(3, function()
			if zoneOccupied then spawnSkeleton(wave, true) end
		end)
	end
end
local function waveClearedBonus()
	-- Everyone standing in the Hollow when a wave falls shares its
	-- bonus: the farm rewards the group that held the ground.
	if wave % 5 == 0 then
		for _, p in ipairs(playersInZone()) do
			_G.JadeGrantBonus(p, 100, "WaveCleared")
		end
	end
end
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(1)
		local occupants = playersInZone()
		zoneOccupied = #occupants > 0
		if not zoneOccupied then
			if waveActive or aliveCount() > 0 then
				for skel in pairs(alive) do skel:Destroy() end
				alive = {}
				wave = 0
				waveActive = false
			end
			continue
		end
		if not waveActive then
			task.wait(INTERMISSION)
			if #playersInZone() > 0 then startWave() end
		elseif aliveCount() == 0 then
			waveClearedBonus()
			waveActive = false
			task.wait(INTERMISSION)
			if #playersInZone() > 0 then startWave() end
		end
		-- Skeleton behaviour: shamble at the nearest Keeper; bite on
		-- contact with a per-skel cooldown. All server-run.
		local now = os.clock()
		for skel, entry in pairs(alive) do
			local humanoid, root = entry.Humanoid, entry.Root
			if humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local best, bestDist, bestRoot = nil, math.huge, nil
				for _, p in ipairs(occupants) do
					local pRoot = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					local pHum = p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if pRoot and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 then
						local d = (pRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						if d < bestDist then best, bestDist, bestRoot = pHum, d, pRoot end
					end
				end
				if bestRoot then
					humanoid:MoveTo(bestRoot.Position)
					if bestDist <= 4 and now - entry.LastBite >= 1 then
						entry.LastBite = now
						best:TakeDamage(entry.Boss and 14 or 8)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 31_DefenseSystem.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it DefenseSystem
-- What it does: THE DEFENSE OF THE THREE (Chapter 26). The village,
-- the Great Blossom Tree, and the Guardian Statue share one fate and
-- one system: three global meters -- Village, Tree, Statue -- kept
-- in a DataStore, published as workspace attributes, drained by
-- corruption assaults, healed by Keepers' thrusts, and defended
-- together. Every other system reads the attributes; only this
-- Script moves the meters.
--
-- THE GUARDIAN WALKS AMONG THEM: while the exclusive owner's
-- account is in the server (the SAME UserId pasted in Script 8 --
-- paste it below too), defenses are stronger in three concrete,
-- code-visible ways: assault drains run at 60% speed, assault
-- skeletons spawn with 80% health, and the lowest meter quietly
-- regenerates. This is the lore made mechanical. It changes no
-- damage number any player deals, sells nothing, and cannot be
-- transferred: her presence is the buff, and presence cannot be
-- botted by anyone who is not her.
--
-- Kid-safe stakes: a meter at zero is FALLEN, never destroyed. The
-- village closes its shops and hides, the Tree withers to Critical,
-- the Statue's flame goes out -- and all three heal back over time
-- and with thrusts. Nothing the corruption does is permanent.
-- Permanence is the players' side of the story.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with the same UserId as Script 8
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeDefense_v1")
local METER_MAX = 1000
local SAVE_SECONDS = 30
local ASSAULT_INTERVAL = 1200 -- 20 minutes between assaults
local ASSAULT_LENGTH = 240
local METERS = { "Village", "Tree", "Statue" }
local health = { Village = METER_MAX, Tree = METER_MAX, Statue = METER_MAX }
local loaded = false
local defenseEvent = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeDefenseEvent")
if not defenseEvent then
	defenseEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	defenseEvent.Name = "JadeDefenseEvent"
	defenseEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local function guardianPresent()
	if EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID == 0 then return false end
	return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(EXCLUSIVE_USER_ID) ~= nil
end
local function publish()
	for _, m in ipairs(METERS) do
		workspace:SetAttribute(m .. "Health", math.floor(health[m]))
		workspace:SetAttribute(m .. "Fallen", health[m] <= 0)
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute("GuardianPresent", guardianPresent())
	workspace:SetAttribute("ThreatLevel", workspace:GetAttribute("ThreatLevel") or 0)
end
-- Loading: retried, fail-quiet. A failed load starts the meters full
-- for the session and disables saving (Script 1's doctrine: a bad
-- read must never become a bad write over the world's real state).
for _ = 1, 3 do
	local ok, data = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync("meters_v1")
	end)
	if ok then
		loaded = true
		if type(data) == "table" then
			for _, m in ipairs(METERS) do
				health[m] = math.clamp(tonumber(data[m]) or METER_MAX, 0, METER_MAX)
			end
		end
		break
	end
	task.wait(1)
end
local function saveMeters()
	if not loaded then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("meters_v1", health)
	end)
end
function _G.JadeHealMeter(meter, amount)
	if not health[meter] then return end
	amount = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 50)
	health[meter] = math.clamp(health[meter] + amount, 0, METER_MAX)
	publish()
end
function _G.JadeDamageMeter(meter, amount)
	if not health[meter] then return end
	amount = math.clamp(tonumber(amount) or 0, 0, 50)
	health[meter] = math.clamp(health[meter] - amount, 0, METER_MAX)
	publish()
end
function _G.JadeGetMeter(meter)
	return health[meter] or 0
end
-- ---------- village NPCs: the threat, made visible --------------------
local npcs = {}
for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if model:IsA("Model") and string.sub(model.Name, 1, 11) == "VillageNPC_" then
		local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if head and root then
			local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 44)
			gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.4, 0)
			gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
			local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			label.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
			label.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(43, 34, 30)
			label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 225)
			label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			label.TextSize = 14
			label.Parent = gui
			gui.Parent = head
			table.insert(npcs, {
				Model = model, Label = label, Root = root,
				Home = root.CFrame,
				Name = string.sub(model.Name, 12),
			})
		end
	end
end
local NPC_LINES = {
	Calm = { "The Tree is safe. We thrust on.", "Lovely blossoms today.", "Mind the petals, Keeper." },
	Alarmed = { "Did you hear that? Bones...", "Stay near the gates!", "The corruption is close." },
	Shelter = { "Inside! Inside!", "Guard the door, Keepers!", "The Guardian will come..." },
}
local function setThreat(level)
	workspace:SetAttribute("ThreatLevel", level)
	for _, npc in ipairs(npcs) do
		if level >= 2 then
			local shelter = workspace:FindFirstChild("VillageShelter")
			if shelter then npc.Model:MoveTo(shelter.Position) end
			local lines = NPC_LINES.Shelter
			npc.Label.Text = npc.Name .. ": " .. lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
		elseif level == 1 then
			local lines = NPC_LINES.Alarmed
			npc.Label.Text = npc.Name .. ": " .. lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
		else
			npc.Model:MoveTo(npc.Home.Position)
			local lines = NPC_LINES.Calm
			npc.Label.Text = npc.Name .. ": " .. lines[math.random(1, #lines)]
		end
	end
	publish()
end
-- ---------- assaults -----------------------------------------------------
local TARGETS = {
	Village = { Anchor = "VillageHeart", Drain = 3, ZoneRadius = 90, Display = "the Village" },
	Tree = { Anchor = "TreeHitbox", Parent = "GreatBlossomTree", Drain = 4, ZoneRadius = 60, Display = "the Great Blossom Tree" },
	Statue = { Anchor = "StatueBase", Drain = 3, ZoneRadius = 60, Display = "the Guardian Statue" },
}
local assaultIndex = 0
local assaultActive = false
local function anchorFor(targetKey)
	local spec = TARGETS[targetKey]
	if spec.Parent then
		local parent = workspace:FindFirstChild(spec.Parent)
		return parent and parent:FindFirstChild(spec.Anchor)
	end
	return workspace:FindFirstChild(spec.Anchor)
end
local function spawnAssaultSkeleton(anchor, guardian)
	local template = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ThornSkeletonTemplate")
	if not template then return nil end
	local skel = template:Clone()
	skel.Name = "AssaultSkeleton"
	local humanoid = skel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = skel:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root then skel:Destroy() return nil end
	local hp = guardian and 60 or 75
	humanoid.MaxHealth = hp
	humanoid.Health = hp
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = 10
	humanoid:SetAttribute("IsThornHusk", true)
	humanoid:SetAttribute("IsAssaultSkeleton", true)
	local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
	skel.Parent = workspace
	skel:MoveTo(anchor.Position + Vector3.new(math.cos(angle) * 55, 3, math.sin(angle) * 55))
	return { Model = skel, Humanoid = humanoid, Root = root }
end
local function runAssault(targetKey)
	if assaultActive then return end
	local spec = TARGETS[targetKey]
	local anchor = anchorFor(targetKey)
	if not anchor then return end
	assaultActive = true
	local guardian = guardianPresent()
	local startHealth = health[targetKey]
	setThreat(2)
	defenseEvent:FireAllClients("AssaultStarted", spec.Display, guardian)
	local skels = {}
	local toSpawn = 8
	local spawned = 0
	local deadline = os.clock() + ASSAULT_LENGTH
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(1)
		-- trickle spawns to the cap
		local aliveNow = 0
		for _, z in ipairs(skels) do
			if z.Humanoid.Health > 0 then aliveNow += 1 end
		end
		if spawned < toSpawn and aliveNow < 6 then
			local z = spawnAssaultSkeleton(anchor, guardian)
			if z then table.insert(skels, z) spawned += 1 end

-- ---------- validation: the whole security model in one function ----
local profiles = {}      -- [UserId] = sanitised config or false

local applying = {}      -- [UserId] = true while THIS Script builds
local invalidLog = {}    -- [UserId] = { count, windowStart, lockedUntil, lastLog }
local function recordInvalid(player, reason)
	local now = os.clock()
	local entry = invalidLog[player.UserId]
	if not entry or now - entry.windowStart > 60 then
		entry = { count = 0, windowStart = now, lockedUntil = 0, lastLog = 0 }
		invalidLog[player.UserId] = entry
	end
	entry.count = entry.count + 1
	if entry.count >= 3 then entry.lockedUntil = now + 60 end
	if now - entry.lastLog >= 5 then
		entry.lastLog = now
		warn(string.format("[JadeCreator] Rejected config from %s (UserId %d): %s (strike %d)",
			player.Name, player.UserId, reason, entry.count))
	end
end
local function validateConfig(player, raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil, "payload is not a table" end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 1 profile (8 fields, no mask
	-- fields) is upgraded with the starter mask, then validated
	-- exactly like a native v2 payload. A CLIENT payload claiming
	-- Version 1 with mask fields, or any other field mix, fails.
	if raw.Version == 1 then
		local v1Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v1Count = v1Count + 1
			if not V1_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v1 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v1Count ~= 8 then return nil, "v1 field count is not exactly 8" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(maskDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		-- v1 named the weapon slot "Scythe"; the current schema
		-- calls it "Spear" (the Twin Spear redesign, Chapter 4).
		-- Same palette ID, new field name -- the value carries
		-- over untouched.
		merged.Spear = merged.Scythe
		merged.Scythe = nil
		for key, value in pairs(designDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 3
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 2 profile (13 fields, masks but
	-- no weapon/wing design) gains the design defaults the same
	-- way -- the unified flow must never orphan an older profile.
	if raw.Version == 2 then
		local v2Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v2Count = v2Count + 1
			if not V2_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v2 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v2Count ~= 13 then return nil, "v2 field count is not exactly 13" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(designDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 3
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 3 profile (19 fields, no Daemon
	-- choices) gains the Daemon defaults the same way.
	if raw.Version == 3 then
		local v3Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v3Count = v3Count + 1
			if not V3_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v3 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v3Count ~= 19 then return nil, "v3 field count is not exactly 19" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		for key, value in pairs(daemonDefaults()) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.Version = 4
		raw = merged
	end
	-- Migration: a stored Version 4 profile (25 fields, no
	-- DaemonForm) gains the solid-form default the same way.
	if raw.Version == 4 then
		local v4Count = 0
		for key in pairs(raw) do
			v4Count = v4Count + 1
			if not V4_KEYS[key] then
				return nil, "v4 payload carries an unapproved field: " .. tostring(key)
			end
		end
		if v4Count ~= 25 then return nil, "v4 field count is not exactly 25" end
		local merged = {}
		for key, value in pairs(raw) do merged[key] = value end
		merged.DaemonForm = "FormSolid"
		merged.Version = 5
		raw = merged
	end
	local keyCount = 0
	for key in pairs(raw) do
		keyCount = keyCount + 1
		if not CONFIG_KEYS[key] then
			return nil, "unapproved field present: " .. tostring(key)
		end
	end
	if keyCount ~= 26 then return nil, "field count is not exactly 26" end
	if raw.Version ~= 5 then return nil, "Version is not 5" end
	if type(raw.Chassis) ~= "string" or not CHASSIS[raw.Chassis] then
		return nil, "Chassis is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.Material) ~= "string" or not MATERIALS[raw.Material] then
		return nil, "Material is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.Detail) ~= "number" or not DETAIL_STOPS[raw.Detail] then
		return nil, "Detail is not an approved stop"
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs({ "Spear", "Aura", "Effects" }) do
		if type(raw[slot]) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw[slot]] then
			return nil, slot .. " colour is not in the palette"
		end
	end
	if type(raw.Lighting) ~= "string" or not LIGHTING[raw.Lighting] then
		return nil, "Lighting is not an approved preview"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskShape) ~= "string" or not MASK_SHAPES[raw.MaskShape] then
		return nil, "MaskShape is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskMaterial) ~= "string" or not MASK_MATERIALS[raw.MaskMaterial] then
		return nil, "MaskMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskColor) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw.MaskColor] then
		return nil, "MaskColor is not in the palette"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskGlow) ~= "string" or not MASK_GLOWS[raw.MaskGlow] then
		return nil, "MaskGlow is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.MaskMotif) ~= "string" or not MASK_MOTIFS[raw.MaskMotif] then
		return nil, "MaskMotif is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WeaponStyle) ~= "string" or not WEAPON_STYLES[raw.WeaponStyle] then
		return nil, "WeaponStyle is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WeaponMaterial) ~= "string" or not WEAPON_MATERIALS[raw.WeaponMaterial] then
		return nil, "WeaponMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingCount) ~= "number" or not WING_COUNTS[raw.WingCount] then
		return nil, "WingCount is not 0, 1, or 2"
	end
	if type(raw.WingShape) ~= "string" or not WING_SHAPES[raw.WingShape] then
		return nil, "WingShape is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingMaterial) ~= "string" or not WING_MATERIALS[raw.WingMaterial] then
		return nil, "WingMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.WingColor) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw.WingColor] then
		return nil, "WingColor is not in the palette"
	end
	for _, slot in ipairs({ "DaemonColor", "DaemonGlow", "DaemonClaw" }) do
		if type(raw[slot]) ~= "string" or not PALETTE[raw[slot]] then
			return nil, slot .. " is not in the palette"
		end
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonMaterial) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_MATERIALS[raw.DaemonMaterial] then
		return nil, "DaemonMaterial is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonScale) ~= "number" or not DAEMON_SCALES[raw.DaemonScale] then
		return nil, "DaemonScale is not an approved scale"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonAccessory) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_ACCESSORIES[raw.DaemonAccessory] then
		return nil, "DaemonAccessory is not on the whitelist"
	end
	if type(raw.DaemonForm) ~= "string" or not DAEMON_FORMS[raw.DaemonForm] then
		return nil, "DaemonForm is not on the whitelist"
	end
	-- The skeleton form is a STANDARD skeleton-bear variant: it
	-- passes this gate for any account that owns the Daemon
	-- Design Package (OwnsDaemonDesignPack). It is NOT Oakley's
	-- pet -- her Daemon is the Gold Dragon (Script 39, GoldDragon),
	-- which no Workbench field can name or grant.
	if raw.DaemonForm == "FormSkeleton" and player:GetAttribute("OwnsDaemonDesignPack") ~= true then
		return nil, "DaemonForm FormSkeleton requires the Daemon Design Package"
	end
	-- Rebuilt from catalogue constants, never the client's table:
	-- even a passing payload contributes nothing but its choices.
	return { Version = 5, Chassis = raw.Chassis, Material = raw.Material,
		Detail = raw.Detail, Spear = raw.Spear, Aura = raw.Aura,
		Effects = raw.Effects, Lighting = raw.Lighting,
		MaskShape = raw.MaskShape, MaskMaterial = raw.MaskMaterial,
		MaskColor = raw.MaskColor, MaskGlow = raw.MaskGlow, MaskMotif = raw.MaskMotif,
		WeaponStyle = raw.WeaponStyle, WeaponMaterial = raw.WeaponMaterial,
		WingCount = raw.WingCount, WingShape = raw.WingShape,
		WingMaterial = raw.WingMaterial, WingColor = raw.WingColor,
		DaemonColor = raw.DaemonColor, DaemonMaterial = raw.DaemonMaterial,
		DaemonScale = raw.DaemonScale, DaemonGlow = raw.DaemonGlow,
		DaemonClaw = raw.DaemonClaw, DaemonAccessory = raw.DaemonAccessory,
		DaemonForm = raw.DaemonForm }
end
local function isLockedOut(player)
	local entry = invalidLog[player.UserId]
	return entry and os.clock() < entry.lockedUntil or false
end
-- ---------- persistence: sanitised profiles only ---------------------
local function saveProfile(player)
	if not loadOk[player.UserId] then return end
	local config = profiles[player.UserId]
	if config == nil then return end
	pcall(function()
		store:SetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId, config or false)
	end)
end
local function loadProfile(player)
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		local ok, data = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync("player_" .. player.UserId)
		end)
		if ok then
			loadOk[player.UserId] = true
			if data == nil or data == false then
				profiles[player.UserId] = data or false
				return
			end
			local clean, reason = validateConfig(player, data)
			if clean then
				profiles[player.UserId] = clean
			else
				-- Stored data failing today's whitelist is treated
				-- as no profile and never re-saved over itself.
				profiles[player.UserId] = false
				loadOk[player.UserId] = false
				recordInvalid(player, "stored profile rejected: " .. reason)
			end
			return
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
	profiles[player.UserId] = false
end
-- ---------- building the look (server-side parts only) ---------------
local function clearCreatorLook(character)
	for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(child.Name, 1, 12) == "JadeCreator_" then child:Destroy() end
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root then
		local emitter = root:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_Effect")
		if emitter then emitter:Destroy() end
	end
end
local function setScales(humanoid, scales)
	local fields = { Height = "HeightScale", Width = "WidthScale", Depth = "DepthScale",
		Head = "HeadScale", BodyType = "BodyTypeScale", Proportion = "ProportionScale" }
	for key, childName in pairs(fields) do
		local value = humanoid:FindFirstChild(childName)
		if value and value:IsA("NumberValue") then value.Value = scales[key] end
	end
end
local function makePart(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end
local function weldTo(part, target, offset)
	part.CFrame = target.CFrame * offset
	part.Parent = target.Parent
	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = part
	weld.Part1 = target
	weld.Parent = part
end
local function makeWedge(name, size, color, material)
	local part = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	return part
end
-- ---------- the Mask Atelier build (server-side parts only) ----------
-- One source of truth for mask colours: the builder paints from
-- this function and the sweep repairs from this function, so a
-- tampered mask part is repainted to exactly these values.
local function maskRoleColor(role, config)
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	if role == "accent" then
		if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then return paletteColor(config.MaskColor) end
		return paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(mat.Color[1], mat.Color[2], mat.Color[3])
end
local function maskRoleMaterial(role, config)
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	if role == "accent" and config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then
		return Enum.Material.Neon
	end
	return Enum.Material[mat.Material]
end
-- The exact set of mask parts a config should produce:
-- [part name] = expected Color3. The sweep compares against this.
local function expectedMaskParts(config)
	local expected = {}
	if config.MaskShape == "None" then return expected end
	local shape = MASK_SHAPES[config.MaskShape]
	for _, entry in ipairs(shape.Parts) do
		expected["JadeCreator_Mask" .. entry[1]] = maskRoleColor(entry[4], config)
	end
	local motif = MASK_MOTIFS[config.MaskMotif]
	for i = 1, motif.Count do
		local color = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
			or maskRoleColor("main", config)
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i] = color
	end
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEyes" then
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskEyeL"] = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
		expected["JadeCreator_MaskEyeR"] = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
	end
	return expected
end
local function buildMask(character, config)
	local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not head or config.MaskShape == "None" then return end
	local shape = MASK_SHAPES[config.MaskShape]
	local mat = MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial]
	for _, entry in ipairs(shape.Parts) do
		local suffix, size, offset, role, kind = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3], entry[4], entry[5]
		local color = maskRoleColor(role, config)
		local material = maskRoleMaterial(role, config)
		local part
		if kind == "Wedge" then
			part = makeWedge("JadeCreator_Mask" .. suffix,
				Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3]), color, material)
		else
			part = makePart("JadeCreator_Mask" .. suffix,
				Vector3.new(size[1], size[2], size[3]), color, material)
		end
		if role == "main" then part.Transparency = mat.Transparency end
		weldTo(part, head, CFrame.new(offset[1], offset[2], offset[3]))
	end
	-- Motif attachments, welded to the head over the mask plate.
	local motifOffsets = {
		MotifSpiral = { { 0, 0.42, -0.70 } },
		MotifBlossom = { { 0, 0.48, -0.68 }, { -0.17, 0.36, -0.68 }, { 0.17, 0.36, -0.68 },
			{ -0.10, 0.60, -0.68 }, { 0.10, 0.60, -0.68 } },
		MotifFang = { { -0.28, -0.68, -0.60 }, { 0.28, -0.68, -0.60 } },
	}
	local offsets = motifOffsets[config.MaskMotif]
	if offsets then
		local motifColor = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and paletteColor(config.MaskColor) or maskRoleColor("main", config)
		local motifMaterial = config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings"
			and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material[MASK_MATERIALS[config.MaskMaterial].Material]
		for i, off in ipairs(offsets) do
			local part
			if config.MaskMotif == "MotifFang" then
				part = makeWedge("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.16, 0.34, 0.16), motifColor, motifMaterial)
			elseif config.MaskMotif == "MotifSpiral" then
				part = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.52, 0.52, 0.08), motifColor, motifMaterial)
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
			else
				part = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskMotif_" .. i,
					Vector3.new(0.20, 0.20, 0.10), motifColor, motifMaterial)
				part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			end
			weldTo(part, head, CFrame.new(off[1], off[2], off[3]))
		end
	end
	-- Glowing eyes: two neon lenses on the mask's eye line.
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEyes" then
		for _, side in ipairs({ { "L", -0.30 }, { "R", 0.30 } }) do
			local eye = makePart("JadeCreator_MaskEye" .. side[1],
				Vector3.new(0.24, 0.12, 0.06), paletteColor(config.MaskColor), Enum.Material.Neon)
			weldTo(eye, head, CFrame.new(side[2], 0.14, -0.68))
		end
	end
	-- Glowing etchings: one soft light inside the main plate.
	if config.MaskGlow == "GlowEtchings" then
		local plate = character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_MaskPlate")
			or character:FindFirstChild("JadeCreator_MaskLowerPlate")
		if plate then
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Name = "JadeCreator_MaskGlowLight"
			light.Color = paletteColor(config.MaskColor)
			light.Brightness = 1
			light.Range = 6
			light.Parent = plate
		end
	end
end
local function paintSpear(player, config)
	local containers = {}
	local character = player.Character
	if character then table.insert(containers, character) end
	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then table.insert(containers, backpack) end
	for _, container in ipairs(containers) do
		local tool = container:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
		if tool then
			for _, part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name == "Tip" then
					-- Only the crystal spear Tip takes the palette.
					-- The wood Shaft, gold GoldBands, and dark Handle
					-- are the twins' fixed design and never repainted.
					part.Color = config and paletteColor(config.Spear) or TIP_DEFAULT
				end
			end
		end
	end
end
local function applyConfig(player, config)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
	if character:GetAttribute("IsJadeSpirit") then
		-- Her form is Script 8's territory. The creator neither
		-- modifies it nor builds on top of it -- ever.
		clearCreatorLook(character)
		return false
	end
	applying[player.UserId] = true
	clearCreatorLook(character)
	setScales(humanoid, CHASSIS[config.Chassis])
	local mat = MATERIALS[config.Material]
	local matColor = Color3.fromRGB(mat.Color[1], mat.Color[2], mat.Color[3])
	local matEnum = Enum.Material[mat.Material]
	local torso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	-- Waist sash: always present, in the Effects colour.
	if torso then
		weldTo(makePart("JadeCreator_Sash", Vector3.new(1.35, 0.28, 1.05),
			paletteColor(config.Effects), Enum.Material.Neon),
			torso, CFrame.new(0, -0.75, 0))
	end
	if config.Detail >= 25 then
		for _, side in ipairs({ "Left", "Right" }) do
			local arm = character:FindFirstChild(side .. "UpperArm") or character:FindFirstChild(side .. " Arm")
			if arm then
				weldTo(makePart("JadeCreator_Shoulder" .. side,
					Vector3.new(0.62, 0.3, 0.62), matColor, matEnum),
					arm, CFrame.new(0, 0.55, 0))
			end
		end
	end
	if config.Detail >= 50 and torso then
		weldTo(makePart("JadeCreator_TorsoPlate", Vector3.new(1.15, 1.15, 0.18),
			matColor, matEnum), torso, CFrame.new(0, 0.15, -0.62))
	end
	if config.Detail >= 75 and root then
		local ring = makePart("JadeCreator_AuraRing", Vector3.new(3.4, 0.12, 3.4),
			paletteColor(config.Aura), Enum.Material.Neon)
		ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		weldTo(ring, root, CFrame.new(0, -2.9, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)))
	end
	if config.Detail >= 100 and root then
		local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		emitter.Name = "JadeCreator_Effect"
		emitter.Texture = "rbxassetid://241594419"
		emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(paletteColor(config.Effects))
		emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.1)
		emitter.Rate = 22
		emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(1, 2.5)
		emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
		emitter.Parent = root
	end
	buildMask(character, config)

-- ---------- combo-to-move: the Daemon Stride ---------------------------
-- Alternating weapon thrusts and Daemon swipes does not only
-- fight -- it MOVES. Link 2 (and every even link): STRIDE DASH, a
-- forward burst. Link 3 (and every multiple of 3): WING LAUNCH,
-- an upward burst. Mounted, the bursts move the coupled unit
-- (Daemon + rider as one); on foot they move the player, with
-- the Daemon answering beside them. One burst per link number.
local function strideBurst(player, st, kind)
	local mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil
	local root
	if mounted then
		root = st.Bear and st.Bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	else
		local char = player.Character
		root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	if not root then return end
	local facing = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local flat = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude < 0.1 then flat = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
	local velocity = flat.Unit * (kind == "Launch" and 10 or 34)
		+ Vector3.new(0, kind == "Launch" and 30 or 4, 0)
	if mounted and kind == "Dash" then velocity *= 1.3 end -- coupled momentum
	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Parent = root
	local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	lv.Attachment0 = att
	lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
	lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	lv.VectorVelocity = velocity
	lv.MaxForce = 200000
	lv.Parent = root
	Debris:AddItem(lv, 0.22)
	Debris:AddItem(att, 0.25)
end
-- ---------- Daemon combat: the claw answers the thrust ----------------
local function tagCreator(huskHumanoid, player)
	local tag = huskHumanoid:FindFirstChild("creator")
	if not tag then
		tag = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tag.Name = "creator"
		tag.Parent = huskHumanoid
	end
	tag.Value = player
	Debris:AddItem(tag, 5)
end
local function bearSwipe(player, st)
	local bear = st.Bear
	if not bear or st.Form ~= "Bear" then return end
	local root = bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then return end
	local stats = statsFor(player)
	local best, bestDist = nil, 9
	for _, enemy in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if enemy:IsA("Humanoid") and enemy:GetAttribute("IsThornHusk") and enemy.Health > 0 then
			local eRoot = enemy.Parent and enemy.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if eRoot then
				local d = (eRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = enemy, d end
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then return end
	-- the chain: a landing swipe inside the window extends it
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastThrust or 0) <= MOUNT_WINDOW then
		st.Chain = (st.Chain or 0) + 1
		if st.Chain ~= st.LastStrideLink then
			st.LastStrideLink = st.Chain
			if st.Chain % 3 == 0 then strideBurst(player, st, "Launch")
			elseif st.Chain % 2 == 0 then strideBurst(player, st, "Dash") end
		end
		if st.Chain % 5 == 0 and st.Chain ~= st.LastBonusChain then
			st.LastBonusChain = st.Chain
			if _G.JadeGrantBonus then _G.JadeGrantBonus(player, 5, "MountChain") end
		end
	else
		st.Chain = 1
	end
	tagCreator(best, player)
	best:TakeDamage(stats.Claw)
	pushUpdate(player)
end
-- Called by Script 2 on EVERY connecting thrust (any player; this
-- function itself decides whether a Daemon answers).
function _G.JadeDaemonThrust(player, stage)
	local st = player and state[player.UserId]
	if st then
		-- RESONANCE (the partnership sync): every connecting thrust
		-- raises keeper-Daemon sync by 8, capped at 100, decaying
		-- 6 per second. It builds in ANY form -- keeper and Daemon
		-- acting together is the bond -- and is spent only in
		-- Weapon form, by _G.JadeDaemonSurge below.
		local nowR = os.clock()
		local r = st.Resonance or 0
		if st.ResonanceT then r = math.max(0, r - (nowR - st.ResonanceT) * 6) end
		st.Resonance = math.min(100, r + 8)
		st.ResonanceT = nowR
	end
	if not st or st.Form ~= "Bear" or not st.Bear then return end
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local bearRoot = st.Bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not bearRoot then return end
	local mounted = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant ~= nil
		and st.RiderSeat.Occupant.Parent == char
	if not mounted and (root.Position - bearRoot.Position).Magnitude > COMBO_NEAR then return end
	st.LastThrust = os.clock()
	if mounted then
		-- COUPLING: rider and Daemon are one unit. The Daemon's
		-- momentum amplifies every thrust (a forward surge that
		-- grows with the thrust stage), and a held turn while
		-- thrusting carves the unit around -- thrust-steering:
		-- the weapon's direction, amplified by the body.
		local facing = bearRoot.CFrame.LookVector
		local flat = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > 0.1 then
			local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
			att.Parent = bearRoot
			local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
			lv.Attachment0 = att
			lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector
			lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
			lv.VectorVelocity = flat.Unit * (18 + 6 * (stage or 1))
			lv.MaxForce = 200000
			lv.Parent = bearRoot
			Debris:AddItem(lv, 0.18)
			Debris:AddItem(att, 0.2)
		end
		local steer = st.RiderSeat.Steer or 0
		if steer ~= 0 then
			bearRoot.CFrame = bearRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -steer * 0.35, 0)
		end
	end
	task.delay(0.25, function() bearSwipe(player, st) end)
end
-- ---------- form changes ----------------------------------------------
function _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	return st and st.Bear or nil
end
local function condense(player, animate)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	local kind = twinKind(player)
	if not st or not kind then return end
	if _G.JadeSetSusanooForm then _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, "Condensed") end
	local bear, riderSeat, passengerSeat, prompt = buildBear(player, kind)
	st.Bear, st.RiderSeat, st.PassengerSeat = bear, riderSeat, passengerSeat
	st.Form = "Bear"
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonCondensed", true)
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Bear")
	st.Chain, st.Stamina, st.Sprint = 0, STAMINA_MAX, false
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(who)
		if who ~= player then return end
		if riderSeat.Occupant then
			local hum = who.Character and who.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and riderSeat.Occupant == hum then hum.Sit = false end
		else
			local hum = who.Character and who.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then riderSeat:Sit(hum) end
		end
	end)
	if animate then
		-- FOLD-IN: the giant's light pours down and the bear rises
		-- out of it -- parts fade IN element by element, body
		-- first, mask last, over TRANSFORM_SECONDS.
		task.spawn(function()
			local names = ELEMENT_ORDER
			for _, p in ipairs(bear:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then p.Transparency = 1 end
			end
			for i, name in ipairs(names) do
				local p = bear:FindFirstChild(name)
				if p then p.Transparency = 0 end
				task.wait(TRANSFORM_SECONDS / (#names + 4))
			end
			for _, p in ipairs(bear:GetDescendants()) do
				if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Name ~= "FlightWingL" and p.Name ~= "FlightWingR" then
					p.Transparency = 0 -- flight wings stay folded until flight
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	pushUpdate(player)
end
local function expand(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or not st.Bear then return end
	local bear = st.Bear
	st.Bear, st.RiderSeat, st.PassengerSeat = nil, nil, nil
	st.Form = "Susanoo"
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonState", "Susanoo")
	st.Fly, st.Flying = false, false
	player:SetAttribute("DaemonCondensed", false)
	st.Chain = 0
	-- UNFOLD: the bear rears up and its elements lift OUT of the
	-- body in the order Script 35 will rebuild them -- frame,
	-- weapon ridge, wing, horns, mask -- fading as they rise over
	-- TRANSFORM_SECONDS; then the spectral rig takes over.
	task.spawn(function()
		local order = ELEMENT_ORDER
		for _, name in ipairs(order) do
			local p = bear:FindFirstChild(name)
			if p then
				p.CFrame = p.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0)
				p.Transparency = 0.45
			end
			task.wait(TRANSFORM_SECONDS / (#order + 4))
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(bear:GetDescendants()) do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.Transparency = 1 end
		end
		task.wait(0.2)
		bear:Destroy()
		if _G.JadeSetSusanooForm then _G.JadeSetSusanooForm(player, "Expanded") end
		pushUpdate(player)
	end)
	pushUpdate(player)
end

local savedTipColor = {}
local function paintWeapon(player, on)
	local char = player.Character
	local spear = (char and char:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear"))
		or player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") and player.Backpack:FindFirstChild("TwinSpear")
	if not spear then return end
	local tip = spear:FindFirstChild("Tip")
	if not tip then return end
	if on then
		savedTipColor[player.UserId] = tip.Color

			or CREATOR_PALETTE[player:GetAttribute("CreatorDaemonColor")]
			or Color3.fromRGB(185, 140, 255)

		local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
		light.Name = "DaemonLight"
		light.Color = glow
		light.Range = 10
		light.Brightness = 2
		light.Parent = tip
	else
		local light = tip:FindFirstChild("DaemonLight")
		if light then light:Destroy() end
		if savedTipColor[player.UserId] then
			tip.Color = savedTipColor[player.UserId]
			savedTipColor[player.UserId] = nil

local function foldToWeapon(player)

	-- into the spear's tip over TRANSFORM_SECONDS, claws last.

-- Called by Script 2 before it damages a husk. At full sync in
-- WEAPON form, the Daemon surges through the spear: +25 damage
-- against that husk (husks and corruption only -- Script 2's player
-- paths never call this), and the sync falls to 40. Anywhere else,
-- or below full sync, it returns 0 and the thrust is a plain 25.
function _G.JadeDaemonSurge(player)
	local st = player and state[player.UserId]
	if not st then return 0 end
	local nowS = os.clock()
	local r = st.Resonance or 0
	if st.ResonanceT then r = math.max(0, r - (nowS - st.ResonanceT) * 6) end
	st.Resonance, st.ResonanceT = r, nowS
	if st.Form == "Weapon" and r >= 100 then
		st.Resonance = 40
		pushUpdate(player)

function _G.JadeDaemonForm(player)

transformEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)

			local st = state[player.UserId]
			if st and st.Form == "Bear" and st.Bear then
				local bear = st.Bear
				local bHum = bear:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local bRoot = bear:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if bHum and bRoot then
					local stats = statsFor(player)
					local riderHum = st.RiderSeat and st.RiderSeat.Occupant
					if riderHum then
						-- driven: throttle forward/back, steer turns
						-- the root; speed & turn rate are the stage
						-- table's, sprint on stamina.
						local throttle = st.RiderSeat.Throttle
						local steer = st.RiderSeat.Steer
						-- FLIGHT: Stage 3+ (the Susanoo has wings),
						-- Fly held, stamina in the pool. The wings
						-- unfold, the flight constraint arms, and
						-- the coupled unit climbs; release and it
						-- glides back down on gravity.
						local wantFly = st.Fly and stageOf(player) >= 3 and (st.Stamina or 0) > 0
						if wantFly ~= (st.Flying == true) then
							st.Flying = wantFly
							pushUpdate(player)
						end
						local flight = bRoot:FindFirstChild("DaemonFlight")
						local wingL, wingR = bear:FindFirstChild("FlightWingL"), bear:FindFirstChild("FlightWingR")
						if st.Flying then
							st.Stamina = math.max(0, (st.Stamina or 0) - 26 * 0.1)
							if wingL then wingL.Transparency = 0.15 end
							if wingR then wingR.Transparency = 0.15 end
							if flight then
								local f = bRoot.CFrame.LookVector
								flight.VectorVelocity = f * (throttle * stats.Speed * 1.1) + Vector3.new(0, 13, 0)
								flight.MaxForce = 250000
							end
							if steer ~= 0 then
								bRoot.CFrame = bRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -steer * stats.Turn * 0.1, 0)
							end
							bHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
							continue
						end
						if wingL then wingL.Transparency = 1 end
						if wingR then wingR.Transparency = 1 end
						if flight then flight.MaxForce = 0 end
						local speed = stats.Speed
						if st.Sprint and throttle > 0 and (st.Stamina or 0) > 0 then
							speed *= SPRINT_MULT
							st.Stamina = math.max(0, st.Stamina - STAMINA_DRAIN * 0.1)
						else
							st.Stamina = math.min(STAMINA_MAX, (st.Stamina or 0) + STAMINA_REGEN * 0.1)
						end
						bHum.WalkSpeed = speed
						if throttle ~= 0 then
							local facing = bRoot.CFrame.LookVector
							bHum:Move(facing * throttle, false)
						else
							bHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
						end
						if steer ~= 0 then
							bRoot.CFrame = bRoot.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, -steer * stats.Turn * 0.1, 0)
						end
					else
						-- unmounted: follow the twin, keep FOLLOW_DISTANCE
						st.Stamina = math.min(STAMINA_MAX, (st.Stamina or 0) + STAMINA_REGEN * 0.1)
						local char = player.Character
						local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if root then
							local offset = (bRoot.Position - root.Position)
							if offset.Magnitude > FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
								bHum.WalkSpeed = stats.Speed
								bHum:MoveTo(root.Position - offset.Unit * (FOLLOW_DISTANCE - 2))
							else
								bHum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 41_Showcase.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Showcase
-- What it does: SHOW-OFF / PET SHOWCASE (Chapter 33). The pet is
-- the performance: this Script runs pedestal claims in the Hero's
-- Plaza, the pet ability showcase sequence (scaled by the pet's
-- rarity tier), overhead titles, and petal-burst entrances --
-- including Oakley's dedicated LEGEND entrance and the full
-- Dragon's Display for her GOLD JAPANESE DRAGON Daemon.
--
-- RARITY TIERS (server-decided, never client-claimed):
--   Legendary -- Oakley alone: the Gold Japanese Dragon (Script
--     39 kind GoldDragon) + the Headless Jade Skeleton. Full
--     5-act, 24-second Dragon's Display; Legend entrance.
--   Epic -- Pink (Design Package) or Blue (earned) Daemon bears.
--     4 acts, 16 seconds.
--   Rare -- Workbench-designed Daemons with a designed wing set.
--     3 acts, 12 seconds.
--   Common -- the starter Green Daemon bear. 2 acts, 8 seconds.
-- A showcase NEVER changes a number: no damage to players, no
-- counts, no rewards. The breath demo fires only at the plaza's
-- crystal demo target. Cooldown 60 s per player, server-side.
--
-- INTEGRATION: Script 39 publishes _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player)
-- (the keeper's live Daemon model) and _G.JadeDaemonForm(player)
-- ("Bear" / "Weapon" / "Susanoo"). Script 39's transform cycle
-- is requested through the same JadeBearTransform RemoteEvent it
-- already owns -- this Script never builds or destroys a Daemon.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN = 60
local PEDESTAL_HOLD = 120 -- seconds a claim lasts without renewal
local function remote(name)
	local r = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not r then
		r = Instance.new("RemoteEvent"); r.Name = name; r.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	end
	return r
end
local updateEvent = remote("JadeShowcaseUpdate")   -- server -> all: stage/effects
local requestEvent = remote("JadeShowcaseRequest") -- client -> server: start/pose/title
local entranceEvent = remote("JadeEntrance")        -- server -> all: entrance burst
local TITLES = {
	Keeper = { Text = "Bloom Keeper", Tier = "Common" },
	HuskFriend = { Text = "Friend of Husks", Tier = "Common" },
	TreeDefender = { Text = "Defender of the Tree", Tier = "Rare" },
	BlossomLegend = { Text = "Blossom Legend", Tier = "Epic" },
	DragonFriend = { Text = "Friend of Dragons", Tier = "Epic" },
	JadeLegend = { Text = "The Jade Legend -- Keeper of the Gold Dragon", Tier = "Legendary" },
}
local state = {} -- [UserId] = { Pedestal, LastShowcase, Title, Showcasing }
local function isLegend(player)
	return player:GetAttribute("HasHeadlessJadeSpirit") == true
end
local function tierOf(player)
	if isLegend(player) then return "Legendary" end
	local v = player:GetAttribute("DaemonVariant")
	if v == "Pink" or v == "Blue" then return "Epic" end
	if player:GetAttribute("CreatorWingColor") then return "Rare" end
	return "Common"
end
-- The Dragon's Display (Legendary) and its scaled-down forms.
-- Act = { Name, Seconds, Effect } -- the client renders Effect
-- (coil / design turn / flight / breath / weapon / finale lights
-- and petals); the server owns timing, order, and permission.
local SEQUENCES = {
	Legendary = {
		{ Name = "Grand Coil", Seconds = 5, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "The Design Turn", Seconds = 4, Effect = "DesignTurn" },
		{ Name = "Flight Display", Seconds = 5, Effect = "Flight" },
		{ Name = "Breath Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "GoldBreath" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
		{ Name = "Finale -- the Answer", Seconds = 2, Effect = "Finale" },
	},
	Epic = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Flight Display", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Flight" },
		{ Name = "Claw Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "ClawDemo" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
	Rare = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Ability Demo", Seconds = 4, Effect = "ClawDemo" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
	Common = {
		{ Name = "Majesty Pose", Seconds = 4, Effect = "Coil" },
		{ Name = "Weapon Transformation", Seconds = 4, Effect = "WeaponPour" },
	},
}
local function daemonOf(player)
	if _G.JadeGetDaemonModel then return _G.JadeGetDaemonModel(player) end
	return nil
end
local function runShowcase(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if not st or st.Showcasing then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (st.LastShowcase or -SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN) < SHOWCASE_COOLDOWN then return end
	local daemon = daemonOf(player)
	if not daemon then return end -- no condensed Daemon, no showcase
	st.Showcasing = true
	st.LastShowcase = now

	for i, act in ipairs(SEQUENCES[tier]) do
		if not player.Parent then break end
		player:SetAttribute("ShowcaseAct", act.Name)
		updateEvent:FireAllClients({
			UserId = player.UserId, Tier = tier, Act = act.Name,

			Pedestal = st.Pedestal,

end
-- ---------- pedestals (Hero's Plaza, World 1) -------------------
local function bindPedestals()
	local plaza = workspace:FindFirstChild("HerosPlaza")
	if not plaza then return end
	for _, pedestal in ipairs(plaza:GetChildren()) do
		if pedestal:IsA("BasePart") and pedestal.Name:match("^Pedestal") then

					if st.Pedestal == pedestal.Name then

			end)

	end
end

-- ---------- entrances -------------------------------------------
local function fireEntrance(player, area)
	local tier = tierOf(player)
	entranceEvent:FireAllClients({

		Legend = isLegend(player),

requestEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, arg)
	local st = state[player.UserId]

end)

	state[player.UserId] = {}
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 43_WeaponChoice.server.lua

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with her UserId (same as Scripts 8/35/39)
local TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with his UserId
local WEAPON_TYPES = {

	Katana = { Companion = "Fox",     Reach = 8,  Arc = 90,  Cooldown = 0.45 },

local function isTwin(player)

		or (TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_GUARDIAN_USER_ID)
end
local function applyChoice(player, typeName, save)
	chosen[player.UserId] = typeName
	player:SetAttribute("WeaponType", typeName)
	player:SetAttribute("CompanionSpecies", WEAPON_TYPES[typeName].Companion)
	if save then
		pcall(function() store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), typeName) end)
	end
	-- The branch hears about it from the attribute; Script 45 builds
	-- the seed branch and grows the companion from it.
	if _G.JadeBranchOnChoice then _G.JadeBranchOnChoice(player, typeName) end
end
local function holdAtThreshold(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local threshold = workspace:FindFirstChild("Threshold")
	local spawn = threshold and threshold:FindFirstChild("ThresholdSpawn")
	if char and spawn then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then root.CFrame = spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end
	openEvent:FireClient(player)
end
local function releaseToWorld(player)
	local char = player.Character
	local gate = workspace:FindFirstChild("ThresholdExitSpawn")
	if char and gate then
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root then root.CFrame = gate.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end
end
local function onJoin(player)
	if isTwin(player) then
		applyChoice(player, "Spear", false) -- birthright; never saved as a "choice"
		return
	end
	local saved
	pcall(function() saved = store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId)) end)
	if type(saved) == "string" and WEAPON_TYPES[saved] then
		applyChoice(player, saved, false)
	else
		player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
			task.wait(0.5)
			if not chosen[player.UserId] then holdAtThreshold(player) end
		end)
		if player.Character then
			task.spawn(function()
				task.wait(0.5)
				if not chosen[player.UserId] then holdAtThreshold(player) end
			end)
		end
	end
end
choiceEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, typeName)
	if type(typeName) ~= "string" then return end
	if not WEAPON_TYPES[typeName] then return end
	local firstChoice = chosen[player.UserId] == nil
	applyChoice(player, typeName, true)
	if firstChoice then releaseToWorld(player) end
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(onJoin, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) chosen[player.UserId] = nil end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 45_BranchCompanion.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it BranchCompanion
-- What it does: ONE BEING, THREE FORMS (Chapter 34).
--
-- 1. THE BRANCH -- a living cutting of the World Tree: dark WOOD
--    with blossoms of PINK QUARTZ. It is the seed form and the
--    resting form of every keeper's partner, and its shape echoes
--    the chosen weapon (a spear branch grows long and straight
--    with its blossoms clustered at the tip; a scythe branch grows
--    in a crescent; a hammer branch thick and knotted; a katana
--    branch in one gentle curve).
-- 2. THE COMPANION -- the branch GROWS: limbs, a head, a heart of
--    quartz light. One species per weapon, 1:1, decided by the
--    First Choice (Script 43): Spear -> Sprite, Katana -> Fox,
--    Scythe -> Serpent, Hammer -> Bear Cub. Wooden bodies, pink
--    quartz blossom features, pink-and-brown only -- the unified
--    base palette of Chapter 34. The companion walks beside its
--    keeper, answers first (the Answer), and shivers its blossoms
--    on every return (the Shiver).
-- 3. THE WEAPON -- Soul Eater style: the companion transforms INTO
--    the weapon, one object of wood and pink quartz. There is no
--    companion floating beside a wielded weapon and no weapon
--    beside a standing companion: equip the Tool and the companion
--    pours into it (0.8 s); stow the Tool and the weapon pours
--    back out (0.8 s) -- through the branch, always (0.6 s hub).
--
-- * OAKLEY IS THE EXCEPTION, fail-closed: her account (the same
--   UserId as Scripts 8/35/39) gets NO branch and NO branch
--   companion from this Script, ever. Her partner is the Gold
--   Japanese Dragon (Script 39), and her forms are hers alone.
-- * THE BOND: Script 2 reports every connecting hit to
--   _G.JadeDaemonThrust (Script 39) -- and, on the same line, to
--   _G.JadeBranchOnHit below. Each reported hit raises the pair's
--   visible bond glow (the BranchBond attribute, 0-100): +8 per
--   hit, decaying 6/s -- the same rhythm as Script 39's Resonance,
--   so the blossoms brighten exactly as the sync builds. The
--   SURGE itself (100 -> the next hit strikes for 50, sync falls
--   to 40) is Script 39's, Stage 2+; this Script only makes the
--   bond VISIBLE, in the quartz, from the first minute.
-- * States are published as attributes: BranchState ("Branch" /
--   "Companion" / "Transforming" / "Weapon") and CompanionSpecies.
--   Script 39's cycle routes through here: no form becomes another
--   form directly -- Beast and Susanoo unfold from the Branch,
--   which is why stowing the weapon always lands on the branch
--   first.
--
-- SECURITY: clients send nothing to this Script. Forms change on
-- server-observed events only (choice saved, Tool equipped/stowed,
-- respawn), and the models it builds are server-built parts.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID = 0 -- << REPLACE with her UserId (same as Scripts 8/35/39/43)
local WOOD = Color3.fromRGB(92, 60, 40)        -- brown heartwood
local WOOD_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(66, 42, 28)
local QUARTZ = Color3.fromRGB(255, 122, 184)   -- pink quartz
local QUARTZ_LIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 178, 216)
local TRANSFORM_SECONDS = 0.8  -- companion <-> weapon
local HUB_SECONDS = 0.6        -- every change passes through the branch
local GROW_SECONDS = 1.6       -- branch -> companion (first growth)
local SHAPES = { -- branch silhouettes: segment count, curve, cluster placement
	Spear  = { Segments = 5, Curve = 0.02, ClusterAt = "Tip",   Scale = 1.15 },
	Katana = { Segments = 5, Curve = 0.22, ClusterAt = "Curve", Scale = 1.00 },
	Scythe = { Segments = 6, Curve = 0.55, ClusterAt = "Arc",   Scale = 1.25 },
	Hammer = { Segments = 3, Curve = 0.05, ClusterAt = "End",   Scale = 0.90 },
}
local state = {} -- [UserId] = { Model, Form, Bond, BondT, Root }
local function part(parent, size, cf, color, material, name)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Size = size; p.CFrame = cf; p.Color = color
	p.Material = material or Enum.Material.Wood
	p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Name = name or "Part"
	p.Parent = parent
	return p
end
local function blossom(parent, cf, s)
	-- one pink quartz blossom: five petals around a bright heart
	for i = 1, 5 do
		local a = (i / 5) * math.pi * 2
		part(parent, Vector3.new(0.22, 0.22, 0.22) * s,
			cf * CFrame.new(math.cos(a) * 0.22 * s, math.sin(a) * 0.22 * s, 0),
			QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Glass, "Petal")
	end
	local heart = part(parent, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2) * s, cf, QUARTZ_LIGHT, Enum.Material.Neon, "Heart")
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = QUARTZ; light.Range = 4; light.Brightness = 0.6
	light.Parent = heart
	return heart
end
local function buildBranch(player, typeName)
	local shape = SHAPES[typeName]; if not shape then return nil end
	local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = "BranchDaemon"
	local base = CFrame.new()
	local pos = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0); local ang = 0
	for i = 1, shape.Segments do
		ang += shape.Curve
		local seg = part(model, Vector3.new(1.1, 0.28, 0.28) * shape.Scale,
			base * CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, ang), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "Limb")
		if i == 1 then model.PrimaryPart = seg end
		pos += Vector3.new(math.cos(ang) * 1.0 * shape.Scale, math.sin(ang) * 1.0 * shape.Scale, 0)
		blossom(model, base * CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, ang), 0.8)
	end
	blossom(model, base * CFrame.new(pos), 1.5) -- the crown cluster: the future quartz heart of the weapon
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end
local function buildCompanion(player, species)
	-- Stylized server builds in the part grammar of Chapter 34;
	-- the Studio display models carry the full sculpted detail.
	local model = Instance.new("Model"); model.Name = species .. "Companion"
	local body = part(model, Vector3.new(1.2, 1.6, 0.7), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "Body")
	model.PrimaryPart = body
	part(model, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 2.7, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Head")
	if species == "Fox" then
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), CFrame.new(-0.25, 3.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0.2), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Ear")
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.9, 0.3), CFrame.new(0.25, 3.3, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -0.2), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Ear")
		local tail = part(model, Vector3.new(0.7, 1.8, 0.7), CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0.9) * CFrame.Angles(0.7, 0, 0), QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Glass, "BlossomTail")
		blossom(model, tail.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1, 0), 1.3)
	elseif species == "Serpent" then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			part(model, Vector3.new(0.8, 0.5, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 0.4, i * 0.7) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, i * 0.15), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "Coil")
		end
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 2.6, 0.4), QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Glass, "ScaleCrest")
	elseif species == "BearCub" then
		part(model, Vector3.new(1.5, 1.2, 1.0), CFrame.new(0, 1.1, 0), WOOD, Enum.Material.Wood, "CubBody")
		for _, x in ipairs({ -0.6, 0.6 }) do
			local paw = part(model, Vector3.new(0.5, 0.4, 0.6), CFrame.new(x, 0.25, -0.5), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Paw")
			part(model, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 0.3), paw.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -0.1, -0.3), QUARTZ, Enum.Material.Neon, "QuartzClaws")
		end
	elseif species == "Sprite" then
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.1, 0.3), CFrame.new(-0.3, 0.5, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Leg")
		part(model, Vector3.new(0.3, 1.1, 0.3), CFrame.new(0.3, 0.5, 0), WOOD_DARK, Enum.Material.Wood, "Leg")
		blossom(model, CFrame.new(0, 3.35, 0), 1.2) -- the blossom crown
	end
	blossom(model, CFrame.new(0, 2.05, -0.4), 1.0) -- the heart blossom, shared by every species
	model.Parent = workspace
	return model
end
local function setForm(player, form)
	local st = state[player.UserId]; if not st then return end
	st.Form = form
	player:SetAttribute("BranchState", form)
	if st.Model then st.Model:Destroy(); st.Model = nil end
	local typeName = player:GetAttribute("WeaponType")
	if form == "Branch" and typeName then
		st.Model = buildBranch(player, typeName)
	elseif form == "Companion" then
		st.Model = buildCompanion(player, player:GetAttribute("CompanionSpecies") or "Sprite")
	end
end
function _G.JadeBranchOnChoice(player, typeName)
	if TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID ~= 0 and player.UserId == TWIN_BLOOM_USER_ID then return end
	state[player.UserId] = state[player.UserId] or { Form = "None", Bond = 0 }
	setForm(player, "Branch")
	task.delay(GROW_SECONDS, function()
		if state[player.UserId] and state[player.UserId].Form == "Branch" then
			setForm(player, "Companion") -- the Answer: it looks at its keeper first (follow code turns it so)
		end
	end)
end
function _G.JadeBranchOnHit(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]; if not st then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local b = st.Bond or 0
	if st.BondT then b = math.max(0, b - (now - st.BondT) * 6) end
	st.Bond = math.min(100, b + 8); st.BondT = now
	player:SetAttribute("BranchBond", math.floor(st.Bond))
end
local function watchCharacter(player, char)
	local function onTool(tool)
		if not tool:IsA("Tool") then return end
		local st = state[player.UserId]; if not st or st.Form == "Weapon" then return end
		player:SetAttribute("BranchState", "Transforming")
		task.delay(TRANSFORM_SECONDS, function()
			if state[player.UserId] then setForm(player, "Weapon") end
		end)
		tool.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
			if parent == nil and state[player.UserId] then
				setForm(player, "Branch") -- through the hub, always
				task.delay(HUB_SECONDS, function()
					if state[player.UserId] and state[player.UserId].Form == "Branch" then
						setForm(player, "Companion")
					end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
	char.ChildAdded:Connect(onTool)
	for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do onTool(c) end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) watchCharacter(player, char) end)
	if player.Character then watchCharacter(player, player.Character) end
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local st = state[player.UserId]
	if st and st.Model then st.Model:Destroy() end
	state[player.UserId] = nil
end)
-- Follow: branch and companion hold station at the keeper's left,
-- bobbing gently; the companion turns to face the keeper's facing
-- (the Answer, every frame, not just on arrival).
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(t)
	local now = os.clock()
	for userId, st in pairs(state) do
		local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
		local char = player and player.Character
		local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if root and st.Model and st.Model.PrimaryPart then
			local bob = math.sin(now * 1.6 + userId % 7) * 0.18
			local target = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-3.2, st.Form == "Branch" and 1.2 or 0, 1.2)
			if st.Form == "Companion" then
				target = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(-3.2, -2.6, 1.2) -- feet near the keeper's ground line
			end
			local cur = st.Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame
			st.Model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cur:Lerp(target + Vector3.new(0, bob + 2.6, 0), 0.12))
		end
		if st.BondT and now - st.BondT > 0.25 then -- decay the visible bond
			st.Bond = math.max(0, (st.Bond or 0) - 6 * (now - st.BondT)); st.BondT = now
			local p = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			if p then p:SetAttribute("BranchBond", math.floor(st.Bond)) end
		end
	end
end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 47_Wings.server.lua
-- Location: ServerScriptService > insert Script, rename it Wings
-- What it does: THE FOUR WINGS (Chapter 36). Wings -- not outfits --
-- are this game's primary visual customization. Four types, all
-- pink and brown, each paired with a flight style:
--
--   Feathered  pink feathers, brown tips. THE STARTER WINGS:
--              granted with flight itself (Susanoo Stage 3 --
--              15,000 Lifetime + 100 Essence, Scripts 35/39).
--   Crystal    brown wooden frame, pink quartz membranes.
--              Unlock: reach the Crystal Deep (10,000 Lifetime,
--              Script 19) and craft at the Workbench for Blooms.
--   Butterfly  pink-and-brown patterned. Unlock: free 100 Thorn
--              Husks (Script 4's count) -- the garden's gratitude.
--   Dragon     brown scales, pink membranes. Unlock: hold the
--              Tree through 10 Hollow assaults (Script 31) -- the
--              endgame wings. (A wing TYPE any keeper can earn;
--              Oakley's Gold Dragon is a Daemon, not a wing, and
--              is untouched by this Script.)
--
-- * FLIGHT ITSELF NEVER CHANGES: Script 39 owns flight -- Stage 3,
--   stamina 100 draining 26/s, the stage speed table. Wing types
--   tune FEEL inside those caps (the style table below: climb,
--   glide, turn multipliers, each between 0.9 and 1.1, published
--   in Chapter 36). Top speed and stamina are identical for every
--   wing. Style is the ladder; power is not for sale or unlock.
-- * Selection is by NAME from this whitelist, validated here;
--   ownership is re-checked on every select and on every join.
--   Unlocks persist in DataStore "JadeWings_v1" (a set of type
--   names) and are published as attributes: WingType (worn now)
--   and four OwnsWing<Type> booleans Script 48 renders.
-- * Flight-style application: this Script publishes WingClimb,
--   WingGlide, WingTurn attributes from the style table; Script 39
--   may read them as multipliers inside its own caps (documented
--   hook -- if it does not, the wings are purely visual and every
--   number in Chapter 36 still holds).
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local WING_TYPES = {
	Feathered = { Climb = 1.0, Glide = 1.1, Turn = 1.0 },
	Crystal   = { Climb = 1.1, Glide = 0.9, Turn = 1.0 },
	Butterfly = { Climb = 0.9, Glide = 1.1, Turn = 1.1 },
	Dragon    = { Climb = 1.1, Glide = 1.0, Turn = 0.9 },
}
local CRAFT_BLOOMS = 25 -- Crystal wings, paid in Crystal Blooms at the Workbench
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("JadeWings_v1")
local owned = {} -- [UserId] = { [typeName] = true }
local selectEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
selectEvent.Name = "JadeWingSelect"
selectEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local function publish(player)
	local set = owned[player.UserId] or {}
	for name in pairs(WING_TYPES) do
		player:SetAttribute("OwnsWing" .. name, set[name] == true)
	end
	local worn = player:GetAttribute("WingType")
	if worn and WING_TYPES[worn] then
		local s = WING_TYPES[worn]
		player:SetAttribute("WingClimb", s.Climb)
		player:SetAttribute("WingGlide", s.Glide)
		player:SetAttribute("WingTurn", s.Turn)
	end
end
local function grant(player, name, save)
	owned[player.UserId] = owned[player.UserId] or {}
	owned[player.UserId][name] = true
	if save then
		local list = {}
		for k in pairs(owned[player.UserId]) do table.insert(list, k) end
		pcall(function() store:SetAsync(tostring(player.UserId), list) end)
	end
	publish(player)
end
-- Called by the systems that EARN wings (documented hooks; each
-- caller is itself server-side and already counts the deed).
function _G.JadeGrantWing(player, name)
	if WING_TYPES[name] then grant(player, name, true) end
end
-- Flight unlock (Stage 3) grants the starter wings: Script 35/39
-- may call this at the Stage-3 transition; the attribute watch
-- below also catches it, so the grant cannot be missed.
local function watchStage(player)
	local function check()
		if (player:GetAttribute("SusanooStage") or 0) >= 3 then
			if not (owned[player.UserId] and owned[player.UserId].Feathered) then
				grant(player, "Feathered", true)
				if not player:GetAttribute("WingType") then
					player:SetAttribute("WingType", "Feathered"); publish(player)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SusanooStage"):Connect(check)
	check()
end
local function onJoin(player)
	owned[player.UserId] = {}
	local saved
	pcall(function() saved = store:GetAsync(tostring(player.UserId)) end)
	if type(saved) == "table" then
		for _, name in ipairs(saved) do
			if WING_TYPES[name] then owned[player.UserId][name] = true end
		end
	end
	publish(player)
	watchStage(player)
end
selectEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, name)
	if type(name) ~= "string" or not WING_TYPES[name] then return end
	if not (owned[player.UserId] and owned[player.UserId][name]) then return end
	player:SetAttribute("WingType", name)
	publish(player)
end)
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(onJoin, p) end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) owned[player.UserId] = nil end)

          <ProtectedString name="Source">-- Jade Spirit | 49_ColosseumSystem.server.lua
-- What it does: THE COLOSSEUM (Chapter 46) -- pay-to-view live
-- Last Man Standing King of the Hill. Owns the contestant queue,
-- the Spend-Balance buy-in pool, eliminations, FREE predictions,
-- and LIVE SPECTATOR ENTITLEMENTS (the pay-to-view tickets).
--
-- MONEY LAW (Chapters 6 and 46):
-- * Tickets are Robux products, sold ONLY through Script 10's
--   receipt pipeline. This script never sets ProcessReceipt.
--   Script 10 routes the two ticket product IDs below to
--   _G.JadeColosseumGrantTicket, exactly once per PurchaseId.
-- * Contestants are NEVER paid Robux. The prize pool is Spend
--   Balance (Bonus thrusts), paid through Script 13. A game
--   cannot hand Robux to players; Chapter 46 says so on the page.
-- * Predictions are FREE. No Robux, no Spend, no items are ever
--   wagered, by anyone, on any match (Chapter 46, prediction law).
-- * Buy-ins spend Spend Balance only (Script 13's
--   JadeSpendThrusts): Lifetime, ranks, gates and tiers can
--   never be lost in the Colosseum. Losers lose the buy-in.
--   The winner takes the whole pool. That is the stake.
--
-- SECURITY (Chapter 14's rules, applied):
-- * Every client action is re-checked server-side: distance to
--   the Entry Gate for entry, entitlement for the live stands,
--   contestant status for predictions (contestants may not
--   predict their own match), one action per second per player.
-- * Product and pass IDs live ONLY in this config table; a
--   client-supplied ID is never trusted or even read.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CONFIG = {
	TicketProductId = 0, -- Developer Product: Live Match Ticket (49 Robux)
	DayPassProductId = 0, -- Developer Product: Live Day Pass (99 Robux)
	SeasonPassId = 0, -- Game Pass: Colosseum Season Pass (299 Robux)
	MaxContestants = 8, -- Chapter 46: 8 fight, the rest watch
	MinContestants = 4,
	BuyIns = { 250, 1000 }, -- Spend Balance tiers, Chapter 46
	PrizePerNetRobux = 10, -- Bonus thrusts per prize-fund Robux
}
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("JadeColosseum")
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "JadeColosseum"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
end
local state = {
	Phase = "Lobby", -- Lobby | Live | Finished
	MatchId = 0,
	Pool = 0, -- Spend Balance escrowed from buy-ins
	Contestants = {}, -- [Player] = { Alive=bool, BuyIn=n, HillTime=n }
	Predictions = {}, -- [Player] = Player (their pick) -- FREE
	Tickets = {}, -- [Player] = matchId the ticket is valid for
	DayPassUntil = {}, -- [Player] = os.time() expiry
	SeasonCache = {}, -- [Player] = bool
	Rollover = 0, -- pool carried when a match has no winner
}
local lastAction = {}
local function aliveCount()
	local n = 0
	for _, c in pairs(state.Contestants) do
		if c.Alive then n += 1 end
	end
	return n
end
local function broadcast()
	local roster = {}
	for p, c in pairs(state.Contestants) do
		table.insert(roster, {
			Name = p.Name,
			Alive = c.Alive,

	return state.Phase
